The plug-in term separates the conditioning contribution from the learned unconditional dynamics, offering a transparent view of how the condition steers generation of the target distribution. Building on this, we derive explicit conditional reverse-time SDEs and approximate probability-flow ODEs, enabling principled and directly comparable conditional samplers. To reduce the induced ODE--SDE discrepancy, we introduce a log-Fokker--Planck residual regularization that improves ODE sampling quality. Experiments on conditional image generation tasks demonstrate competitive performance and support the effectiveness of the plug-in conditioning view. Additional ODE--SDE comparison experiments show that the log-Fokker--Planck residual regularization improves deterministic ODE sampling.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于目标与条件多速联合扩散的扩散模型条件作用机制。该机制学习一个无条件联合分数网络，在推理阶段通过插件校正项实现条件作用。插件项将条件贡献与学习到的无条件动力学分离开来，可清晰展示条件如何引导目标分布的生成。基于该框架，本文推导了显式条件反向随机微分方程（SDE）与近似概率流常微分方程（ODE），得到原理清晰、可直接对比的条件采样器。为了降低ODE与SDE之间的差异，本文引入对数福克-普朗克残差正则化，提升ODE采样质量。条件图像生成任务的实验结果显示该方法性能具备竞争力，验证了插件式条件作用视角的有效性。额外的ODE-SDE对比实验表明，对数福克-普朗克残差正则化可提升确定性ODE的采样效果。

title: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
title_zh: 面向多任务操作的自演示生成式控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调
authors: Prachi Garg, Steve Xing, Prahit Yaugand, Saurabh Gupta, Derek Hoiem
abstract: State-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ exhibit strong semantic understanding, instruction following and task behavior. However, when deployed on new robots, even minor mismatches in hardware configuration relative to pretraining can cause severe performance drops. Finetuning the VLA on in-domain expert data from the new embodiment improves performance on the expert task but leads to a loss in its original instruction following and behavioral priors. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised method that generates online interaction rollouts from the zero-shot VLA as additional training data for finetuning. Our experiments show this finetuning scheme yields strong multi-task policies that, on the target robot, (1) inherit prior tasks distilled from the zero-shot model, (2) enable generalist instruction following, while (3) learning new skills from expert data with improved sample efficiency. We demonstrate the success of our approach across test sets probing generalization on a real ALOHA robot and a new simulation benchmark in RoboTwin. Video results are available at https://self-supervised-control.pages.dev/
summary_zh: 当前最优的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如$\pi_{0.5}$具备出色的语义理解、指令遵循与任务执行能力，但部署到新机器人平台时，即使硬件配置与预训练场景存在微小不匹配，也会导致性能严重下降。在新实体的域内专家数据上微调VLA可提升专家任务性能，但会损失模型原有的指令遵循能力与行为先验。本文提出一种自监督方法，利用零样本VLA生成在线交互轨迹作为额外训练数据用于微调。实验表明，该微调方案得到的多任务策略在目标机器人上可实现三点效果：1）继承从零样本模型中蒸馏得到的先验任务能力；2）具备通用指令遵循能力；3）以更高的样本效率从专家数据中学习新技能。本文在真实ALOHA机器人与RoboTwin仿真基准上的泛化性测试集上验证了所提方法的有效性，相关视频结果可访问：https://self-supervised-control.pages.dev/。

title: VideoRun2D Demo: Markerless Body Tracking for Biomechanical Analysis of Running
title_zh: VideoRun2D演示系统：用于跑步生物力学分析的无标记人体跟踪
authors: Luis F. Gomez, Julian Fierrez, Roberto Daza, Ruben Tolosana, Aythami Morales, Gonzalo Garrido, Javier Rueda, Enrique Navarro
abstract: Human pose estimation has advanced significantly due to the development of deep learning models, increased data availability, and improved computing resources. These developments have led to highly accurate body tracking systems with direct applications in sports analysis and performance evaluation. The VideoRun2D Demo performs a biomechanical analysis during sprints using different human pose estimators. The proposed framework was evaluated using human pose trackers and expert manual annotations. The tested framework uses 314 sprints from 44 professional runners, focusing on two key joint angles in sprint biomechanics: 1) hip flexion/extension and 2) knee flexion/extension. The framework also includes a post-processing module for outlier detection. The tested results demonstrate that the average root-mean-square errors range from 11.46{\deg} to 5.83{\deg} for the best trackers. When integrated with the post-processing modules, these errors can be reduced to 9.87{\deg} and 5.30{\deg}, respectively. The VideoRun2D Demo findings suggest that human pose-tracking approaches can be valuable resources for the biomechanical analysis of running.
summary_zh: 随着深度学习模型发展、数据可用性提升与计算资源优化，人体姿态估计技术取得了显著进展，已衍生出精度极高的人体跟踪系统，可直接应用于运动分析与性能评估场景。VideoRun2D演示系统可使用不同人体姿态估计器完成短跑过程中的生物力学分析。所提框架通过人体姿态跟踪器与专家人工标注完成评估，测试数据集包含44名专业运动员的314段短跑数据，重点关注短跑生物力学中的两个关键关节角度：1）髋关节屈/伸角度；2）膝关节屈/伸角度。该框架还包含用于异常值检测的后处理模块。测试结果表明，最优跟踪器的平均均方根误差范围为5.83°到11.46°，接入后处理模块后，两类误差可分别降至5.30°与9.87°。VideoRun2D演示系统的结果表明，人体姿态跟踪方法可作为跑步生物力学分析的有效工具。

title: HiRA-CAM: Preserving Fine-Grained Spatial Relevance in Gradient-Based Visual Explanations
title_zh: 超越识别：结合候选选择分析与证据留存审核的轻量多域阿拉伯手稿手写文本识别（HTR）
authors: Manasi Nerurkar, Ali A. Minai
abstract: Deep Learning models can include billions of parameters or more, making it difficult to explain their internal transformations and outputs. However, explainability is increasing in importance due to the use of AI in crucial applications. This paper focuses on the interpretability of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Building on the popular gradient based method LayerCAM for extracting internal features in CNNs, we propose an improved method named HiRA-CAM, and show that it outperforms both LayerCAM and Grad-CAM on creating useful saliency maps for object classification. The main feature of HiRA-CAM is its adaptive use of activation maps from all the layers of the CNN to arrive at a more focused saliency map.
summary_zh: 历史阿拉伯手稿转录并非单纯的识别问题，实用的学术系统需要应对多变的笔迹与版式，保留不确定的识别结果，区分视觉证据与语言合理性，同时记录研究者的最终决策。本文提出参数量为499万的CNN-BiLSTM-CTC识别器Phoenix，以及围绕其构建的具备证据感知能力的审核工作流Athar。Phoenix通过文档感知重放、扩展至81符号的编解码器、遗忘防护机制（拒绝以不可接受的代价损失旧域性能来提升新域性能的检查点），在档案、马格里布字体、历史手稿多个域上完成适配。在预先设定的留出集对比实验中，评估前冻结上一版检查点，使用贪心解码与原始参考数据打分，Phoenix在10594行Agapet数据集上将字符错误率（CER）从22.12%降至17.86%，在11684行Omar数据集上将CER从17.72%降至11.84%，仅在164行TariMa数据集上CER从10.39%小幅升至10.72%。在两个大型留出集上，字符加权CER从19.98%降至14.93%，相对误差降低25.3%。相同协议下的开发集诊断实验显示，Phoenix在全部4个可比域上的CER均为最低值，非加权宏CER达9.59%。N-best诊断实验显示，束解码与Oracle@25之间存在2.15个百分点的oracle差距，而神经文本重排序器、共识最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）、CTC后验质量估计、局部CTC前隐状态质量估计仅能弥补该差距的不到4%。因此Athar保留视觉识别结果，展示有限候选集，保守使用局部语言模型，检索具备唯一、歧义或弃权状态的同源参考文本，最终输出可审计的TEI与PAGE-XML格式记录。实验结果表明，手稿HTR任务应当作为可审计的证据管理任务而非静默文本替换任务来评估。

title: Beyond Recognition: Compact Multi-Domain Arabic Manuscript HTR with Candidate-Selection Analysis and Evidence-Preserving Review
title_zh: 超越识别：融合候选选择分析与证据保留审核的紧凑型多领域阿拉伯手稿HTR（手写文本识别）
authors: Abdullah Ahmed Ali, Mohammed Thamer Abdulhadi, Ali Haider Safaa, Dhulfiqar Mahdi Wadi
abstract: Historical Arabic manuscript transcription is not only a recognition problem. A usable scholarly system must cope with shifting hands and layouts, preserve uncertain readings, distinguish visual evidence from linguistic plausibility, and record the researcher's final decision. We present Phoenix, a 4.99-million-parameter CNN-BiLSTM-CTC recognizer, and Athar, an evidence-aware review workflow built around it. Phoenix is adapted across archival, Maghrebi, and historical manuscript domains using document-aware replay, an expanded 81-symbol codec, and forgetting guards that reject checkpoints that improve a new domain at unacceptable cost to previous domains. In a pre-specified held-out comparison against the preceding checkpoint, frozen before evaluation and scored with greedy decoding and raw references, Phoenix reduced CER from 22.12% to 17.86% on 10,594 Agapet lines and from 17.72% to 11.84% on 11,684 Omar lines, while regressing from 10.39% to 10.72% on 164 TariMa lines. Across the two large held-out sets, character-weighted CER fell from 19.98% to 14.93%, a 25.3% relative error reduction. A separate same-protocol development diagnostic found the lowest CER for Phoenix on four of four comparable domains (9.59% unweighted macro CER). An N-best diagnostic revealed a 2.15-point oracle gap between beam decoding and Oracle@25, while neural text rerankers, consensus MBR, CTC-posterior quality estimation, and local pre-CTC hidden-state quality estimation recovered less than 4% of this gap. Athar therefore preserves the visual reading, exposes bounded alternatives, uses local language models conservatively, retrieves source parallels with unique, ambiguous, or abstain states, and exports auditable TEI and PAGE-XML records. The results support evaluating manuscript HTR as auditable evidence management rather than silent text replacement.
summary_zh: 历史阿拉伯手稿转录并非单纯的识别问题，面向学术研究的实用系统需要应对多变的书写风格与版式、保留不确定的识别结果、区分视觉证据与语言合理性，同时记录研究者的最终判定结果。本文提出参数规模仅499万的CNN-BiLSTM-CTC识别器Phoenix，以及围绕其构建的具备证据感知能力的审核工作流Athar。Phoenix采用文档感知重放机制、扩展至81符号的编解码器、以及遗忘防护机制（会拒绝那些为提升新领域性能而导致旧领域性能出现不可接受下降的检查点），实现了在档案文献、马格里布手写体、历史手稿三类领域上的适配。在预先设定的留出集对比实验中，以评估前冻结的上一版检查点为对照，采用贪心解码与原始参考标准评分的条件下，Phoenix在10594行Agapet数据集上将字符错误率（CER）从22.12%降至17.86%，在11684行Omar数据集上将字符错误率从17.72%降至11.84%，仅在164行TariMa数据集上出现性能回落，字符错误率从10.39%升至10.72%。在两个大规模留出集上，字符加权字符错误率从19.98%降至14.93%，相对错误降幅达25.3%。另一组采用相同协议的开发集诊断实验显示，Phoenix在全部4个可比领域上的字符错误率均为最低值，非加权宏平均字符错误率为9.59%。N-best诊断实验显示，束解码结果与Oracle@25结果之间存在2.15个百分点的理论最优差距，而神经文本重排序器、最小贝叶斯风险共识（MBR）、CTC后验质量估计、局部CTC前隐藏状态质量估计等方法最多仅能弥补该差距的4%。因此Athar系统保留原始视觉识别结果、给出有限范围的候选选项、保守使用局部语言模型、可检索对应源文本并标注确定/歧义/弃权三类状态，最终输出可审计的TEI与PAGE-XML格式记录。实验结果表明，手稿HTR系统的评估应当面向可审计的证据管理场景，而非单纯的静默文本替换任务。

title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
title_zh: CAViAR：面向真实场景细粒度事故推理的因果视频数据集
authors: Sparsh Garg, Yi-Wen Chen, Vijay Kumar B G, Abhishek Aich
abstract: While modern autonomous driving systems excel at perception tasks such as object detection and trajectory prediction, they lack the high-level causal reasoning required to interpret traffic accidents. In particular, determining responsibility, such as identifying who is at fault and which traffic rule was violated, remains largely unexplored in current benchmarks. To this end, we introduce CAViAR (Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository), a human-annotated dashcam benchmark comprising 2,249 real-world accident videos collected from CarCrashDataset (CCD) and Nexar. Each video is annotated with structured labels spanning environmental conditions, accident type, causal explanation, apparent At-Fault Agent, affected agent, and apparent rule-violation category. We benchmark state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs), including Cosmos-Reason2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3. Once class imbalance is accounted for with majority/random baselines and balanced metrics, perceptual competence is uneven--lighting is nearly solved, whereas weather and road-condition accuracy fall at or below the majority-class baseline---and all models degrade sharply on accident type and responsibility reasoning. Overall, CAViAR exposes a practical Perception--Reasoning Gap: current VLMs may recognize salient context, but do not reliably map visible agent actions to annotated rule-relevant responsibility categories in safety-critical driving scenarios. Code, annotation schema, prompts, and evaluation scripts are available at: https://github.com/nec-labs-ma/CAViAR
summary_zh: 当前自动驾驶系统在目标检测、轨迹预测等感知任务上表现优异，但缺乏解读交通事故所需的高层因果推理能力，尤其是定责任务，比如识别过错方、判定违反的交通规则，在现有基准中仍鲜有探索。针对该问题，本文提出CAViAR（Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository，因果事故视频与事件分析库），这一人工标注的行车记录仪基准数据集包含从CarCrashDataset（CCD）与Nexar收集的2249段真实事故视频，每段视频均标注了覆盖环境条件、事故类型、因果解释、明显过错方、受影响方、明显违规类别的结构化标签。本文对包括Cosmos-Reason2、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3在内的当前最优视觉语言模型（VLM）进行基准测试，通过多数/随机基线与平衡指标消除类别不平衡影响后发现：模型感知能力不均衡，光照条件识别问题已基本解决，但天气与道路状况识别准确率仅能达到或低于多数类基线，所有模型在事故类型与责任推理任务上性能均出现大幅下降。总体而言，CAViAR揭示了现实存在的感知-推理鸿沟：当前VLM可识别显著上下文信息，但在安全关键的驾驶场景中，无法可靠地将可见的智能体行为映射到与规则相关的标注责任类别中。代码、标注模式、提示词与评估脚本可访问：https://github.com/nec-labs-ma/CAViAR。

title: Does Marginal Coverage Guarantee Class-Conditional Safety for Zero-Shot VLMs Under Shift?
title_zh: 分布偏移下边际覆盖度能否保障零样本视觉语言模型的类条件安全性？
authors: Jai Kumar Sharma, Amartya Dutta
abstract: Split-conformal prediction provides marginal coverage under exchangeability and is increasingly used as an abstention layer for zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs). We audit this practice under deployment shift for CLIP, OpenCLIP, and SigLIP across ImageNet and non-ImageNet settings. Marginal coverage can remain relatively high while class-conditional tail coverage collapses: on ImageNet-Sketch, worst-class coverage falls to $\approx 0$ and 10-12% of classes lie below a finite-sample null floor, despite marginal coverage of about 0.86. The failure is aligned with target-domain class accuracy but is not predicted by the source-domain diagnostics we test. Source-side Mondrian calibration improves the in-distribution tail but does not transfer, while clustered conformal and Conf-OT improve marginal or average metrics without recovering the worst-class tail. Target-side class calibration substantially lifts the tail, but requires labels for every class and remains set-size-intensive. We further identify a 2-3$\times$ cross-family efficiency gap and show that native SigLIP sigmoid scores remove APS's probability-mass interpretation. The findings persist across the tested model scale, pretraining corpus, prompt, miscoverage level $\alpha$, and shifted non-ImageNet settings. Marginal conformal coverage should therefore be treated as an average reliability statistic, not as a safety guarantee for the class tail.
summary_zh: 拆分共形预测可在可交换性假设下提供边际覆盖度，正越来越多地被用作零样本视觉语言模型（VLM）的弃权层。本文在分布偏移部署场景下，针对ImageNet与非ImageNet设置，对CLIP、OpenCLIP与SigLIP三类模型的该实践进行审计。结果发现，边际覆盖度可维持在较高水平，但类条件尾部覆盖度会完全崩溃：在ImageNet-Sketch数据集上，尽管边际覆盖度约为0.86，但最差类覆盖度降至接近0，且10%~12%的类别覆盖度低于有限样本空基线。该失效现象与目标域类别准确率相关，但无法通过测试的源域诊断方法预测。源侧Mondrian校准可提升分布内尾部性能，但无法迁移到分布外场景；聚类共形与Conf-OT方法可提升边际或平均指标，但无法恢复最差类尾部性能。目标侧类别校准可大幅提升尾部覆盖度，但需要获取所有类别的标签，且集合大小开销极高。本文进一步发现不同模型家族之间存在2~3倍的效率差距，且原生SigLIP的sigmoid分数破坏了APS方法的概率质量解释。上述结论在所有测试的模型规模、预训练语料、提示词、错误覆盖水平$\alpha$与偏移非ImageNet场景下均成立。因此边际共形覆盖度应当被视为平均可靠性统计量，而非类别尾部的安全性保障。

title: GRACE: Grounded Reasoning via Adapter Composition and Evidence-Aware Calibration for Educational Visual Question Answering
title_zh: GRACE：面向教育视觉问答的基于适配器组合与证据感知校准的落地推理框架
authors: Xinjin Li, Yudi Xia, Xi Zhao, Yiliu Xu, Yining Liu, Cheng Lu, Yujian Long, Yu Ma, Jinghan Cao, Liang Fan, Yeyun Xu
abstract: Educational visual question answering, or VQA, requires models to solve curriculum-oriented multiple-choice questions using both language and visual evidence. Compared with conventional open-ended VQA, educational examples often include structured assessment metadata, diagrams or image contexts, and semantically close answer options, creating strong opportunities for question-option shortcuts. We develop and evaluate a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for a frozen multimodal large language model in this setting. We introduce GRACE, Grounded Reasoning via Adapter Composition and Evidence-Aware Calibration, a framework that uses the pedagogical state of each question to specialize lightweight language and vision adaptation. The state combines inference-visible subject, grouped skill, grade, visual-context, question-intent, and option-structure cues. GRACE uses factor-specific prompts and lightweight visual adapters, then applies evidence-aware option calibration to score all candidates under a shared multimodal context. On ScienceQA, GRACE improves a shared-adapter baseline from 90.5 percent to 93.1 percent overall accuracy and from 88.7 percent to 91.2 percent on image-context questions. Removing pedagogical composition, option calibration, or the visual adapter reduces overall accuracy by 1.4, 1.0, and 1.5 points, respectively. These controlled results show that structured educational state is an effective routing signal for parameter-efficient multimodal adaptation.
summary_zh: 教育视觉问答（VQA）要求模型同时利用文本和视觉证据解答面向课程的多项选择题。与传统的开放式视觉问答相比，教育类样本通常包含结构化评估元数据、图表或图像上下文，以及语义高度相近的候选答案选项，极易催生问题-选项捷径偏差。本文针对该场景，面向冻结参数的多模态大语言模型开发并验证了一种参数高效的适配框架。我们提出GRACE（全称为Grounded Reasoning via Adapter Composition and Evidence-Aware Calibration，即基于适配器组合与证据感知校准的落地推理框架），该框架利用每道题目的教学状态对轻量级语言和视觉适配模块进行专业化定制，该状态融合了推理可见的学科、分组技能、年级、视觉上下文、问题意图和选项结构线索。GRACE使用因子专属提示词和轻量级视觉适配器，随后应用证据感知选项校准，在统一的多模态上下文下对所有候选答案打分。在ScienceQA数据集上，GRACE将共享适配器基线模型的总体准确率从90.5%提升至93.1%，图像上下文类问题的准确率从88.7%提升至91.2%。移除教学组合模块、选项校准模块或视觉适配器后，总体准确率分别下降1.4、1.0和1.5个百分点。上述对照实验结果表明，结构化教育状态是参数高效多模态适配的有效路由信号。

title: SceneGTMM: A Conformal Mapping-based Scene-Aware Transferable GNN-Transformer Dual-Graph Interaction Framework for Map Matching
title_zh: SceneGTMM：面向地图匹配的基于共形映射的场景感知可迁移GNN-Transformer双图交互框架
authors: Yongliang Zhang, Feng Song, Ji Chen, Lishuai Guo, Yong Deng, Yue Zheng, Tianyi Liu, Zhixiong Chen, Qixin Zhang
abstract: Map matching is a key technology connecting positioning data with high precision road networks, but it faces challenges in noise robustness, cross regional transfer, and interpretability. To addr ess the limitations of existing methods in local global fusion, dynamic road network adaptation, and reliance on black box mod els, this paper proposes SceneGTMM, a transferable GNN Transformer dual graph interaction map matching framework based on a conformal mapping based scene relative strategy. 1) Conformal mapping based scene relative strategy: constructs trajectory centric local coordinate systems to reduce dependence on the training road network, supporting cross regional transfer and dynamic road network updates; 2) GNN Transformer dual graph interaction architecture: a GNN modeled road graph captures local topological constraints, while a Transformer modeled trajectory graph captures global temporal dependencies, and cross graph attention achieves noise suppression and semantic alignment; 3) CRF enhanced structured prediction: combines the global context of the Transformer with the topological transition constraints of CRF to improve path connectivity and robustness. Experiments show that SceneGTM achieves over 80% accuracy on multi source trajectories with positioning errors of 16 50 meters, representing a 5.3% improvement over HMM. In cross city transfer scenarios, it outperforms MTrajRec, GraphMM, and TMM, and enhances interpretability through attention and relative coordinate visualization. This study provides a new paradigm for high precision, transferable map matching for real time traffic perception and autonomous driving path planning.
summary_zh: 地图匹配是将定位数据与高精度路网关联的核心技术，当前该领域在噪声鲁棒性、跨区域迁移性和可解释性方面仍面临诸多挑战。为解决现有方法在局部-全局融合、动态路网适配以及依赖黑盒模型方面的局限性，本文提出SceneGTMM，一种基于共形映射场景相对策略的可迁移图神经网络（GNN）-Transformer双图交互地图匹配框架，核心创新包括三点：1）基于共形映射的场景相对策略：构建以轨迹为中心的局部坐标系，降低对训练路网的依赖，支持跨区域迁移和动态路网更新；2）GNN-Transformer双图交互架构：采用GNN建模的道路图捕获局部拓扑约束，采用Transformer建模的轨迹图捕获全局时间依赖，通过跨图注意力实现噪声抑制和语义对齐；3）条件随机场（CRF）增强的结构化预测：将Transformer的全局上下文与CRF的拓扑转移约束相结合，提升路径连通性和鲁棒性。实验结果表明，针对定位误差为16~50米的多源轨迹数据，SceneGTMM的准确率超过80%，相比隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）提升了5.3%；在跨城市迁移场景下，其性能优于MTrajRec、GraphMM和TMM等现有模型，同时可通过注意力机制和相对坐标可视化提升可解释性。本研究为面向实时交通感知和自动驾驶路径规划的高精度、可迁移地图匹配提供了新范式。

title: Clustering and Token Denoising for Faster and More Robust VLMs
title_zh: 面向更快、更鲁棒视觉语言模型的聚类与Token去噪方法
authors: Baptiste Rossigneux, Inna Kucher, Vincent Lorrain, Emmanuel Casseau
abstract: Recent Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have enhanced the capabilities of pre-trained LLMs by adding vision tokens alongside text, with approaches like LLaVA showing impressive results. However, the computational burden of processing up to 576 or 729 visual tokens makes edge deployment challenging. While various token pruning techniques require retraining, some are training-free and thus can easily adapt to architecture changes. We introduce ClustRS, a two-part, training-free algorithm for robust token pruning. Its first component is an attention-weighted, clustering algorithm that selects representative tokens from each semantic cluster. The second component, Residual Shrinkage, is a one-pass denoising step on the selected tokens. These training-free lightweight steps make LLaVA ready for real-world data, improving robustness to a wide range of image-noise types and intensities. Experimental results on the ScienceQA-IMG and MM-VET benchmarks show our method outperforms attention- and diversity-based methods by up to 20\% under extreme noise and token conditions (reducing tokens by 97\%, down to 16 tokens) on LLaVA 1.5 7b and achieves exceptional results on LLaVA-OneVision, where we match baseline performance with fewer than one-third of their tokens under mild noise conditions. Our study demonstrates a simple yet powerful alternative to both score-only and diversity-only pruning rules, paving the way for compute-efficient and noise-resilient VLM deployment.
summary_zh: 近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）通过在文本输入旁添加视觉Token增强了预训练大语言模型的能力，代表性方法如LLaVA已取得优异效果。但处理最多576或729个视觉Token带来的计算负担，给边缘端部署带来了挑战。各类Token剪枝技术中，部分方案无需训练，可轻松适配架构变化。本文提出ClustRS，一种由两部分组成的无训练鲁棒Token剪枝算法：第一部分为注意力加权聚类算法，从每个语义簇中选择代表性Token；第二部分为残差收缩模块，是对选中Token执行的单次通过去噪步骤。这些无训练的轻量级步骤可让LLaVA适配真实场景数据，提升对各类图像噪声类型和强度的鲁棒性。在ScienceQA-IMG和MM-VET基准上的实验结果表明，在极端噪声条件和Token数量压缩至原有的3%（仅保留16个Token）的场景下，本文方法在LLaVA 1.5 7b模型上的性能相比基于注意力和基于多样性的剪枝方法最高提升20%；在LLaVA-OneVision模型上，温和噪声条件下仅使用不足三分之一的Token即可匹配基线模型的性能。本研究提出了一种同时优于纯打分规则和纯多样性剪枝规则的高效替代方案，为实现计算高效、抗噪声的视觉语言模型部署铺平了道路。

title: Spiking Local Interaction and Adaptive Complementary Fusion for Spiking Transformer
title_zh: 面向脉冲Transformer的脉冲局部交互与自适应互补融合方法
authors: Dongcheng Zhao, Sicheng Shen, Zhenyu Yang, Zhiyuan Li, Jinyan Yu, Yongjian Wang, Tiechui Yao, Wenli Zhang, Tielin Zhang
abstract: Spiking Transformers model token interactions primarily through spiking self-attention (SSA). However, binary query and key representations map continuous similarities to sparse and discrete relation responses, which may suppress weak relations and limit the propagation of local spatial context. To address this limitation, we introduce Spiking Local Interaction (SLI) and Adaptive Complementary Fusion (ACF). SLI establishes an attention-independent pathway for direct information exchange among neighboring spiking tokens using lightweight depthwise--pointwise transformations. ACF integrates SSA and SLI through layer-specific, channel-wise coefficients that adaptively balance their contributions at different network depths. The proposed design preserves the original attention formulation and can be incorporated into different Spiking Transformer architectures with modest parameter overhead. Experiments on ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CIFAR10-DVS, and ADE20K show consistent improvements across image classification, event-based recognition, and semantic segmentation. In particular, QKFormer with SLI and ACF achieves $84.37\%$ Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K and $37.5\%$ mIoU on ADE20K, where the segmentation model is trained without ImageNet pretraining. Ablation studies and qualitative analyses further indicate that SSA and SLI capture complementary interaction patterns and that learnable fusion consistently outperforms fixed weighting.
summary_zh: 脉冲Transformer主要通过脉冲自注意力（SSA）建模Token间的交互。但二值化的查询和键表示会将连续相似度映射为稀疏离散的关系响应，可能抑制弱关系，限制局部空间上下文的传播。为解决该局限性，本文提出脉冲局部交互（SLI）和自适应互补融合（ACF）两个模块：SLI利用轻量级深度-逐点变换，构建了一条与注意力无关的通路，实现相邻脉冲Token间的直接信息交换；ACF通过按层、按通道的系数将SSA和SLI的输出相融合，在不同网络深度下自适应平衡二者的贡献。该设计保留了原始注意力的表达形式，仅引入少量参数开销，可嵌入不同的脉冲Transformer架构中。在ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CIFAR10-DVS和ADE20K数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在图像分类、基于事件的识别和语义分割任务上均取得一致提升。特别地，嵌入SLI和ACF的QKFormer在ImageNet-1K上取得84.37%的Top-1准确率，在未经过ImageNet预训练的情况下，语义分割任务在ADE20K上取得37.5%的mIoU指标。消融实验和定性分析进一步表明，SSA和SLI可捕获互补的交互模式，可学习的融合策略性能始终优于固定加权策略。

title: NepOOC-M: Bilingual Nepali-English Benchmark and Comparative Analysis of Multimodal Architectures for OOC Detection
title_zh: NepOOC-M：面向上下文外（OOC）检测的尼泊尔语-英语双语基准数据集及多模态架构对比分析
authors: Sanjeev Khatiwada
abstract: Out-of-context (OOC) misinformation pairs authentic images with misleading captions to construct false narratives without image manipulation, making detection a problem of multimodal alignment rather than image forensics. Despite the prevalence and consequences of OOC misinformation in Nepal, no public benchmark exists for Nepali. We introduce NepOOC, the first publicly available Nepali-dominant multilingual OOC benchmark, comprising 1,090 image-caption pairs (545 pristine, 545 OOC) annotated across five typologies (fabricated, miscaptioned, temporal mismatch, geographic mismatch, identity mismatch) with inter-annotator agreement kappa = 0.84. Systematic evaluation of five multimodal architectures alongside text-only and image-only baselines reveals that caption semantics appear sufficient for strong performance at the current dataset scale. A text-only mBERT model achieves 94.65+/-0.20% Macro-F1, statistically equivalent to the best multimodal system (ResNet-50+mBERT, 94.65+/-0.20%; McNemar median p = 1.000, 0/5 seeds significant at alpha = 0.05). Image-only models perform near chance (33-50%), while training-size scaling suggests that dataset expansion is a more direct path to progress than architectural sophistication or regional specialisation.
summary_zh: 上下文外（OOC）错误信息通过将真实图像与误导性标题配对构建虚假叙事，无需篡改图像，因此其检测属于多模态对齐问题而非图像取证问题。尽管OOC错误信息在尼泊尔广泛传播且危害显著，但目前尚无面向尼泊尔语的公开基准数据集。本文提出NepOOC，首个公开可用的以尼泊尔语为主的多语言OOC基准数据集，包含1090组图像-标题对（545组真实样本，545组OOC样本），覆盖5类标注类型（编造内容、标题错配、时间错配、地理错配、身份错配），标注者间一致性Kappa值为0.84。我们对5种多模态架构以及纯文本、纯图像基线模型开展系统评估，结果表明在当前数据集规模下，仅靠标题语义即可实现优异性能：纯文本mBERT模型的Macro-F1达到94.65±0.20%，与性能最优的多模态系统（ResNet-50+mBERT，94.65±0.20%）统计上无差异（McNemar检验中位数p=1.000，5个随机种子下均无结果在α=0.05水平上显著）。纯图像模型的性能接近随机水平（33%~50%），而训练集规模缩放实验表明，相比架构优化或区域专业化设计，扩展数据集是提升性能更直接的路径。

title: When Irrelevant Text Matters: Affine Margin Shifts in Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: 当无关文本产生影响：多模态大语言模型中的仿射边际偏移现象
authors: Yinfeng Wang, Zhiyuan Yao, Zheren Fu, Lei Zhang, Zhendong Mao
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are frequently exposed to auxiliary textual context, the impact of which on visually grounded tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate the influence of task-irrelevant context by formulating it as a controlled intervention within a binary visual judgment framework. By maintaining an invariant prompt structure while varying auxiliary inputs, we observe that irrelevant text consistently biases model predictions across diverse benchmarks. To move beyond performance metrics, we characterize this sensitivity through a decision margin defined by the log-probability difference between binary candidates. Our analysis reveals a robust geometric regularity: contextconditioned margins follow a consistent affine transformation of their context-free counterparts. This finding demonstrates that irrelevant context does not manifest as unstructured stochastic noise but as a estimable distortion of model preference. We further interpret the fitted affine parameters as metrics for visual commitment preservation and directional answer bias. These findings provide a margin-level diagnostic view of irrelevant-context effects in MLLMs and offer a basis for future studies on noisy-context robustness
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）经常接触各类辅助文本上下文，但这类上下文对视觉落地任务的影响尚未得到充分研究。本文将任务无关上下文的影响建模为二值视觉判断框架下的受控干预，开展系统性探究。在保持提示结构不变的前提下改变辅助输入，我们观察到无关文本会在多个基准数据集上持续偏置模型预测结果。为超越传统性能指标的分析维度，我们基于二值候选答案的对数概率差定义决策边际，刻画模型对无关上下文的敏感性。分析结果揭示了一个稳健的几何规律：带上下文条件的边际是无上下文基准边际的一致仿射变换。该发现表明，无关上下文的影响并非无结构的随机噪声，而是可估计的模型偏好扭曲。我们进一步将拟合得到的仿射参数解释为视觉承诺保留度和定向答案偏置的度量指标。上述研究结果从边际层面揭示了多模态大语言模型中的无关上下文效应，为后续开展噪声上下文鲁棒性研究提供了基础。

title: PartialBiGrasp: Inferring Hidden Local Geometry for Bimanual Grasping from Partial Views
title_zh: PartialBiGrasp：从局部视图推断隐藏局部几何以实现双臂抓取
authors: Ayush Kaura, Vignesh Vembar, Md Faizal Karim, Keshab Patra, K Madhava Krishna
abstract: Dual-arm robotic grasping is essential for manipulating large, heavy, and geometrically complex objects that cannot be reliably handled using a single manipulator. These large objects often contain only sparse graspable regions determined by local geometric properties such as thickness, edge structure, and gripper clearance. Prior bimanual grasping methods assume access to a full point cloud of the object which inherently contains this geometric information, but may not be accessible in real scenarios. This work proposes PartialBiGrasp, a dual-arm grasp generation framework that operates directly on partial point cloud observations. Our model learns geometric features implicitly through convolutional occupancy networks, enabling local reasoning about graspability, collision-free contact regions, and object thickness. We leverage this understanding to generate force-closure compliant grasp pairs, which are further refined using a sampling-based optimization to correct for ambiguity caused by incomplete geometry. We evaluate our approach using analytical force-closure metrics, large-scale simulation experiments, and real-world robot evaluations on noisy partial point clouds of novel objects, demonstrating robust and physically stable dual-arm grasp generation.
summary_zh: 双臂机器人抓取是操作大尺寸、大重量、几何结构复杂物体的核心技术，这类物体无法通过单机械臂可靠处理。大尺寸物体的可抓取区域通常十分稀疏，由厚度、边缘结构、夹爪间隙等局部几何属性决定。现有双臂抓取方法假设可获取物体的完整点云（天然包含上述几何信息），但该条件在真实场景中往往无法满足。本文提出PartialBiGrasp，一种可直接基于局部点云观测生成双臂抓取位姿的框架。该模型通过卷积占用网络隐式学习几何特征，实现对可抓取性、无碰撞接触区域和物体厚度的局部推理。基于该能力，模型生成满足力封闭约束的抓取位姿对，进一步通过基于采样的优化步骤修正几何信息不完整带来的歧义。我们通过解析力封闭指标、大规模仿真实验和真实机器人在含噪局部点云的新物体上开展评估，结果表明该方法可生成鲁棒且物理稳定的双臂抓取位姿。

title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ADEPT：基于强化学习的预训练与后训练加速灵巧操作能力
authors: Jayjun Lee, Jessica Yin, Asif Rana, Nicholas Blauch, Sam Mady, Mohak Bhardwaj, Nima Fazeli, Nathan Ratliff, Karl Van Wyk, Ankur Handa
abstract: We introduce Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training (ADEPT), a large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning sim-to-real transferable dexterity across high degree-of-freedom (DoF) robot embodiments that can solve long-horizon tasks directly from raw visuo-tactile perception. ADEPT pretrains a dexterous policy on a generic object reposing task, then post-trains downstream policies with this pretrained behavior as a prior. ADEPT enables learning new behaviors that are otherwise difficult to discover from scratch on multi-fingered robots and avoids learning the same set of skills over again for every new downstream task. The pretrained policy zero-shots the reposing phase of downstream tasks, but na\"ive RL fine-tuning rapidly degrades this capability during transfer. We address this with a stable post-training recipe combining behavior-cloning distillation, critic warm-up, and conservative on-policy updates. To safely exploit the full kinematic dexterity, we introduce a joint-space Geometric Fabric that mediates between the RL policy and the robot. We distill post-trained teachers into perceptive students that zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on two embodiments: a 23 DoF Kuka-Allegro with two RGB cameras, and a 29 DoF Flexiv-Sharpa with two RGB cameras and five vision-based tactile sensors, and can solve long-horizon tasks from challenging initial states with dexterity at human-level speed.
summary_zh: 本文提出ADEPT（全称为Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training），一种面向高自由度机器人实体的大规模强化学习（RL）框架，可直接从原始视觉-触觉感知输入学习具备仿真到真实场景迁移能力的灵巧操作，完成长周期任务。ADEPT首先在通用物体重定向任务上预训练灵巧策略，随后以该预训练行为为先验对下游策略开展后训练。ADEPT支持学习多手指机器人上从零开始难以习得的新行为，无需为每个下游任务重复学习相同的基础技能。预训练策略可零样本完成下游任务的重定向阶段，但直接采用原始强化学习微调的方式会在迁移过程中快速损失该能力。本文提出融合行为克隆蒸馏、评论家预热和保守在线更新的稳定后训练流程解决该问题。为安全利用完整的运动学灵巧性，我们引入关节空间几何结构层，作为强化学习策略和机器人之间的中间调度模块。我们将后训练得到的教师模型蒸馏为感知型学生模型，在两个机器人实体上实现了零样本仿真到真实场景迁移：分别是配备2个RGB相机的23自由度Kuka-Allegro机器人，以及配备2个RGB相机和5个视觉触觉传感器的29自由度Flexiv-Sharpa机器人，可从极具挑战性的初始状态出发，以类人操作速度完成长周期灵巧任务。

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
title_zh: DA-WAM：面向驾驶世界模型的决策对齐未来隐变量框架
authors: Ruiguo Zhong, Benshan Ma, Xiaolong Chen, Lang Zhang, Mingyue Feng, Yaonong Wang, Pei Liu, Jun Ma
abstract: Anticipating how scenes evolve under ego actions is fundamental to safe autonomous driving, yet the full potential of world models for decision-making remains unrealized. The critical challenge lies in ensuring that future modeling is not merely predictive, but decision-informative: the predicted future must directly shape which trajectory is selected. Existing approaches decouple future representation learning from planning optimization, or share predicted states across trajectory candidates, thereby diluting the action-specific consequences that ought to guide selection. To bridge this gap, we propose DA-WAM, a framework that unifies predictive representation learning, action-conditioned future modeling, and trajectory scoring under a single decision-making objective. DA-WAM maintains predictive supervision throughout planner optimization via an online encoder and a stable momentum target, allowing future representations to co-evolve with the driving task. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent state per trajectory candidate, which is then evaluated by a future-latent-conditioned factorized scorer. For the expert-matched trajectory, the predicted future latent is supervised by the observed future representation, while safety-critical hard negatives provide additional supervision near planning boundaries. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablations and diagnostic analyses validate the key components.
summary_zh: 预测自车动作下的场景演化规律是自动驾驶安全的基础，但当前世界模型在决策任务上的潜力尚未得到充分发挥。核心挑战在于确保未来建模不只是具备预测性，还需具备决策指导性：预测得到的未来信息必须直接作用于轨迹选择过程。现有方法将未来表示学习与规划优化解耦，或者在不同轨迹候选间共享预测状态，弱化了本应指导选择过程的动作专属后果信息。为解决该问题，本文提出DA-WAM框架，在统一的决策目标下融合预测表示学习、动作条件未来建模和轨迹打分三个模块。DA-WAM通过在线编码器和稳定动量目标，在整个规划器优化过程中保持预测监督，让未来表示与驾驶任务协同演化。动作条件预测器为每个轨迹候选生成独立的未来隐状态，随后由基于未来隐变量的因子化打分器完成评估。对于与专家轨迹匹配的样本，预测得到的未来隐变量通过观测到的未来表示进行监督，而安全关键难例样本则在规划边界附近提供额外监督信号。在NAVSIM-v1和NAVSIM-v2数据集上的大量实验表明该方法取得了当前最优性能，消融实验和诊断分析进一步验证了核心模块的有效性。

title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
title_zh: LT-Mem：面向终身场景理解的感知时空记忆框架
authors: Yumin Lee, Hyoseok Ju, Giseop Kim
abstract: Long-term robot operation in evolving environments requires object-level understanding that persists across repeated revisits. Existing systems either overwrite history to maintain an up-to-date map or store semantic snapshots without consistent cross-session object identity, resulting in temporal amnesia: the systematic loss of object history that prevents answering queries such as "Where has the green chair been across all sessions?" We propose LT-Mem, a volatility-aware memory evolution framework that unifies spatially aligned instance-level 3D perception with volatility-conditioned temporal reasoning. First, a multi-session SLAM backbone provides spatially aligned per-object observations across sessions. Second, a reasoning layer governs how object memory evolves: deterministic evidence scoring preserves cross-session identity, and a volatility-aware policy selects among overwrite, hold, and multi-hypothesis actions based on each object's dynamics. Third, the resulting Tri-Memory structure (Live, Delta, Meta) preserves both current states and event histories, enabling longitudinal object-centric reasoning. We further introduce LT-VQA, a dataset and evaluation suite comprising multi-session recordings, persistent identity annotations, and temporal QA pairs. Experiments show that LT-Mem consistently outperforms baselines across all metrics while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens, and ablations confirm that gains are driven by the structured memory architecture rather than LLM capacity.
summary_zh: 机器人在动态环境中的长期运行需要具备跨多次重访的物体级持续理解能力。现有系统要么覆盖历史信息以维护最新地图，要么存储语义快照但无法保证跨会话的物体身份一致性，进而引发时间遗忘问题：物体历史信息的系统性丢失，导致无法回答如“绿色椅子在所有会话中曾出现在哪些位置”这类查询。本文提出LT-Mem，一种感知记忆演化框架，将空间对齐的实例级3D感知与感知条件的时间推理相融合。首先，多会话同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）骨干网络提供跨会话空间对齐的逐物体观测结果；其次，推理层管控物体记忆的演化过程：通过确定性证据打分保留跨会话身份，基于每个物体的动态特性，采用感知策略在覆盖、保留和多假设操作间做选择；最后，生成的Tri-Memory结构（包含实时记忆、增量记忆和元记忆）同时保留当前状态和事件历史，支持以物体为中心的长时序推理。本文进一步提出LT-VQA数据集与评估套件，包含多会话录制数据、持久化身份标注和时序问答对。实验结果表明，LT-Mem在所有指标上的性能始终优于基线模型，同时占用的Token数量比基线少一个数量级，消融实验证实性能提升来自结构化记忆架构而非大语言模型的容量。

title: Autonomous Agricultural Tractor: Integrated Weed Detection and LiDAR Navigation for Precision Paddy Farming
title_zh: 自主农业拖拉机：面向精准水田作业的杂草检测与激光雷达（LiDAR）导航集成系统
authors: Benjamin Merryman-Smith, Tony Nguyen, Bilal Dogutas, Krish Shah, Anthony Raphael, Sudip Dhakal
abstract: Simulation experiments demonstrate continuous position tracking through a 20-second GNSS outage, crop row detection confidence above 0.9 throughout operation, and rice-detection confidences from 0.32 to 0.95 across paddy, aerial, and post-flood imagery. The LiDAR ROI constraint reduces detection inference region by an estimated 30 to 50 percent.
summary_zh: 仿真实验表明，在全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）中断20秒的场景下，系统可实现连续位置跟踪，全作业过程中作物行检测置信度高于0.9，在水田影像、航拍影像和洪水后影像中水稻检测置信度分布在0.32至0.95之间。通过激光雷达感兴趣区域（LiDAR ROI）约束，可将检测推理区域的范围缩减30%至50%左右。

title: RoboEdit: Turning Human Manipulation Videos into Scalable Robot Experience
title_zh: RoboEdit：将人类操作视频转化为可扩展机器人经验的框架
authors: Yaowei Guo, Zeng Tao, Yuxin Jiang, Yunuo Chen, Zhiyang Dou, Yuxiang Ma, Yin Yang, Demetri Terzopoulos, Ying Jiang, Chenfanfu Jiang
abstract: Collecting robot hand-object interaction data is costly and embodiment-specific, yet abundant human-object videos remain unusable for robot training. We present RoboEdit, a human-to-robot video editing suite that transforms human manipulation videos into action-consistent, physically plausible robot videos with aligned 3D hand states. To enable scalable supervision, we introduce RoboEdit-ADC, an automatic pipeline that reconstructs and retargets 3D interactions from RGB videos across embodiments. This pipeline generates RoboEdit-14M, a large-scale dataset of 174K aligned video pairs (14M frames) spanning seven robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and interaction types. The core editing engine, RoboEdit-Trans, employs cross-embodiment adaptation modules to preserve temporal coherence while adapting appearance and motion. It further integrates a 3D Robot-State Decoder to recover per-frame hand states for structured motion supervision. Experiments show that RoboEdit achieves state-of-the-art editing quality and supports downstream robot control policies in real-world manipulation tasks. Ultimately, the RoboEdit suite unlocks the vast potential of unlabeled human videos, providing scalable, high-fidelity visual and 3D motion supervision for generalizable robot learning.
summary_zh: 机器人手-物交互数据采集成本高昂且仅适用于特定具身平台，而海量的人-物交互视频目前仍无法直接用于机器人训练。本文提出RoboEdit——一款人到机器人视频编辑套件，可将人类操作视频转换为动作一致、物理合理且3D手部状态对齐的机器人视频。为实现可扩展监督，本文提出RoboEdit-ADC这一自动化流水线，可从跨具身平台的RGB视频中重建并重定向3D交互信息。该流水线生成了大规模数据集RoboEdit-14M，包含17.4万组对齐视频对（共1400万帧），覆盖7种机器人具身平台、多样场景与交互类型。核心编辑引擎RoboEdit-Trans采用跨具身适配模块，在适配外观与运动特征的同时保留时间一致性，还集成了3D机器人状态解码器，可逐帧恢复手部状态以实现结构化运动监督。实验结果表明，RoboEdit达到了当前最优的编辑质量，可支撑下游机器人控制策略完成真实世界操作任务。最终，RoboEdit套件充分释放了未标注人类视频的巨大潜力，为具备泛化能力的机器人学习提供可扩展、高保真的视觉与3D运动监督信号。

title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
title_zh: 超越摆放与关节活动：面向具身交互的使用驱动型代码场景生成
authors: Zijian Xiao, Zipeng Ye, Jinkun Hao, Xiong Yang, Yuchen Xie, Ran Yi
abstract: Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functional usage of scenes largely unmodeled. To address this problem, we present RoomWright, an agentic usage-driven framework for generating 3D scenes represented entirely as code for embodied interaction. RoomWright performs usage-driven object reasoning, which treats each anchor as a task centre and admits task-required objects and their affordances. A code agent further enables multi-part interaction by compiling each interaction into a trigger, condition, effect rule that updates structured object states, capturing causal dependencies across objects. Moreover, since manipuland orientation is ambiguous and hard to recover from pixels, RoomWright alleviates this via annotation-informed usage-guided orientation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The resulting scenes are executable, editable, and simulation-ready, providing interactive environments for embodied AI and policy learning.
summary_zh: 室内场景合成为具身人工智能、机器人操作与基于仿真的策略学习提供了必要环境。现有基于代码的场景生成方法可生成可编辑、可扩展的环境，但仍聚焦于视觉构建与对象级关节活动，场景的功能使用特性大多未被建模。针对该问题，本文提出RoomWright——一款由使用驱动的智能体框架，可生成完全以代码表征的3D场景，用于具身交互任务。RoomWright执行使用驱动的对象推理，将每个锚点视为任务中心，纳入任务所需对象及其可供性特征。代码智能体进一步将每类交互编译为「触发-条件-效果」规则，更新结构化对象状态，捕捉对象间的因果依赖关系，从而支持多部件交互。此外，由于可操作对象的朝向具有歧义性且难以从像素中恢复，RoomWright通过标注引导、使用驱动的朝向生成机制缓解该问题。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性，生成的场景可执行、可编辑且可直接用于仿真，为具身人工智能与策略学习提供了交互式环境。

title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: Dream2Reward：面向机器人操作的基于正演示的转移对齐奖励模型
authors: Haoyu Zhang, Zecui Zeng, Bin Wang, Lusong Li, Liang Lin, Long Cheng
abstract: Learning robotic policies requires dense rewards that remain informative when behavior departs from successful demonstrations. Progress-based rewards estimate how far an observation has advanced along a nominal successful trajectory, but may remain high after an incorrect transition. We introduce Dream2Reward, which learns a language-conditioned successful latent transition field from positive demonstrations. Given the visual history up to a transition start, the model predicts the latent displacement associated with successful execution and scores the observed displacement through signed directional and symmetric magnitude agreement. This transition-level comparison penalizes wrong-direction, overshooting, and stagnant motion even when the resulting observation appears to show progress. Dream2Reward requires no failure annotations, progress labels, or synthetic negatives, and produces a dense causal reward. Across mechanism diagnostics and shared-trajectory evaluations, it provides stronger success-failure separation and more informative feedback on low-quality behavior than progress-based alternatives. Across online and offline policy learning, the same frozen reward model reduces reward hacking and supports stronger downstream performance, including in real-robot manipulation. These results show that comparing realized motion with predicted successful change provides an effective way to convert positive demonstrations into dense rewards for robot learning.
summary_zh: 学习机器人策略需要密集奖励信号，该信号在行为偏离成功演示时仍能保持有效信息量。基于进度的奖励可估计观测值沿标称成功轨迹的推进程度，但在发生错误转移后仍可能输出高值。本文提出Dream2Reward，可从正演示中学习语言条件下的成功潜在转移场。给定转移起始前的视觉历史，该模型预测与成功执行相关的潜在位移，通过有向方向一致性与对称幅度一致性对观测到的位移进行评分。这种转移层面的比较可对方向错误、运动超调与运动停滞进行惩罚，即使最终观测看似呈现出进展也不例外。Dream2Reward无需失败标注、进度标签或合成负样本，即可生成密集的因果奖励信号。在机制诊断与共享轨迹评估中，该方法相比基于进度的替代方案可实现更优的成功-失败区分度，对低质量行为提供更具信息量的反馈。在在线与离线策略学习场景中，同一冻结的奖励模型可减少奖励黑客现象，提升下游任务性能，包括真实机器人操作任务的表现。上述结果表明，将实际运动与预测的成功变化进行比较，是将正演示转化为机器人学习密集奖励的有效途径。

title: Engineering Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles: A Systems-Theoretic Framework for Psychological Safety in Autonomous Vehicles and its Validation in Real-World Scenarios
title_zh: 自动驾驶汽车心理安全工程：面向自动驾驶汽车的系统论心理安全框架及其真实场景验证
authors: Yandika Sirgabsou, Benjamin Hardin, Fran\c{c}ois Leblanc, Efi Raili, David Jackson, Pericle Salvini, Lars Kunze, Marina Jirotka
abstract: Despite rapid technological advances, the societal acceptability of autonomous vehicles (AVs) remains limited by psychological barriers that extend beyond traditional concerns of physical safety. While factors such as trust and perceived safety are known to influence user acceptance, there is a lack of formalized mechanisms and engineering methods to systematically identify, assess, and mitigate psychological risks arising from human-AV interactions. To address this gap, this work proposes and validates a systems-theoretic framework for the assessment of psychological safety in autonomous vehicles. First, a comprehensive psychological safety risk model is defined, extending the Systems-Theoretic Accident Model and Processes (STAMP) to incorporate key psychological constructs such as trust, perceived control, predictability, and perceived support. Based on this model, a hazard analysis method (AV-PsySafe) is developed to systematically identify psychological hazards, unsafe control actions, and loss scenarios, while introducing a Psychological Safety Integrity Level (PsySIL) to support risk prioritization. Second, the applicability and relevance of the framework are evaluated through its deployment in realistic autonomous vehicle scenarios. A structured validation approach is implemented, including a methodological guide, standardized analysis templates, and the collection of analyst feedback. The results demonstrate that the framework can be consistently applied by practitioners, producing meaningful insights into psychological risks. Overall, this work establishes both the theoretical foundations and practical feasibility of a unified approach to co-assessing psychological and physical safety in autonomous systems, contributing to more human-centred and trustworthy AV development.
summary_zh: 尽管技术发展迅速，自动驾驶汽车（AV）的社会接受度仍受限于传统物理安全范畴之外的心理障碍。尽管已知信任与感知安全性等因素会影响用户接受度，但目前缺乏可系统识别、评估和缓解人-自动驾驶交互引发的心理风险的规范化机制与工程方法。针对该缺口，本文提出并验证了一套用于评估自动驾驶汽车心理安全的系统论框架。首先，本文定义了完备的心理安全风险模型，扩展了系统论事故模型与过程（STAMP），纳入信任、感知控制感、可预测性与感知支持度等核心心理构念。基于该模型，开发了危险分析方法AV-PsySafe，可系统识别心理危险、不安全控制动作与损失场景，同时引入心理安全完整性等级（PsySIL）支持风险优先级判定。其次，通过在真实自动驾驶场景中部署该框架，评估其适用性与相关性，采用包含方法指南、标准化分析模板与分析师反馈收集的结构化验证方案。结果表明，该框架可被从业者稳定应用，生成关于心理风险的有效洞见。总体而言，本研究建立了在自主系统中协同评估心理与物理安全的统一方法的理论基础与实践可行性，助力开发更以人为本、更可信的自动驾驶汽车。

title: To Go Far, Go Together: Diverse Preferences Induce a Curriculum for Reward Optimization
title_zh: 欲致远，共前行：多元偏好生成奖励优化课程
authors: Taehyung Kim, Jongeun Choi
abstract: Learning a reward model from human feedback and optimizing a policy against it is one approach to aligning AI systems with individual users. From a fairness perspective, existing work improves such alignment by developing data-efficient and accurate reward models that capture minority preferences despite scarce data. We push this line of inquiry one step further and argue that data-efficient and accurate per-user reward models are not sufficient: users whose reward models are difficult to \textit{optimize} at the policy level can become a new underserved group. We start from the observation that one user's reward model can be easy to optimize from the initial policy while another's is not. We argue that, given a sufficiently diverse user population, a curriculum naturally emerges between easy- and hard-to-optimize reward models. Building on this insight, we propose CurriPO, which grows a tree-structured curriculum to accommodate diverse user-specific objectives, covering the population in a single traversal. Specifically, CurriPO automatically constructs a curriculum over diverse user reward models, allowing it to branch from the existing curriculum and reuse reward models previously incorporated into the curriculum. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly exploit multi-user structure to address optimization in AI alignment. Extensive experiments on personalized continuous control in a simulated environment show that CurriPO achieves $1.2$--$2.1\times$ the population satisfaction of the strongest baseline while substantially reducing training time. Additional analysis attributes much of this improvement to the users left underserved by conventional optimization.
summary_zh: 从人类反馈中学习奖励模型并针对其优化策略，是使AI系统与个体用户对齐的主流方法之一。从公平性角度出发，现有研究通过开发数据高效、精度高的奖励模型，在数据稀缺的条件下捕捉少数群体偏好，提升这类对齐效果。本文将该方向的研究进一步推进，提出仅具备数据高效、高精度的单用户奖励模型并不足够：那些在策略层面难以优化其奖励模型的用户，会成为新的未被充分服务的群体。本文基于如下观察：部分用户的奖励模型可从初始策略出发轻松完成优化，而另一部分用户的奖励模型则难以优化。本文提出，在用户群体足够多元的前提下，易优化与难优化的奖励模型之间会自然形成课程。基于该洞见，本文提出CurriPO，通过生成树状结构课程适配多元用户特定目标，仅需一次遍历即可覆盖全部用户群体。具体而言，CurriPO针对多元用户奖励模型自动构建课程，可从现有课程分支扩展，复用此前已纳入课程的奖励模型。据我们所知，这是首项明确利用多用户结构解决AI对齐中优化问题的研究。在仿真环境个性化连续控制任务上的大量实验表明，CurriPO的群体满意度达到最优基线方法的1.2至2.1倍，同时大幅缩短训练时间。额外分析表明，性能提升很大程度上来源于传统优化方法未充分服务的用户群体。

title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
title_zh: SoftVTBench：面向可变形物体操作的形变感知视觉触觉数据集与基准
authors: Bowen Jing, Mingxin Wang, Ruiyang Hao, Chenchen Ge, Hanwen Shen, Junjie He, Yang Cui, Yiming Hou, Weitao Zhou, Jiawei Wang, Minglei Li, Dandan Zhang, Ding Zhao, Houde Liu, Xiaofan Li, Si Liu, Ping Luo, Haibao Yu
abstract: Physical interaction quality is central to deformable-object manipulation, yet most benchmarks evaluate task success alone. A policy may complete the task while allowing slip or causing excessive compression. A primary bottleneck is the absence of visuo-tactile datasets that pair policy-visible contact observations with independent physical ground truth over complete tasks. We introduce SoftVTBench, a visuo-tactile dataset for physical-interaction-aware deformable-object manipulation. It contains 4,000 expert demonstrations and more than 50 assets, including volumetric deformable objects and visually matched rigid twins. At 20 Hz, each episode synchronizes multi-view RGB, dual-finger tactile RGB and marker motion, proprioception, language, and binary and continuous gripper actions, alongside evaluator-only finite-element (FEM) states. Building upon this dataset, we establish a closed-loop benchmark that uses fixed object-specific calibration to define the Deformation-aware Success Rate (DSR), which counts a rollout as successful only when it completes the task and keeps peak normalized deformation within tolerance. Across Diffusion Policy, $\pi_{0.5}$, and FastWAM, all 12 in-distribution configurations contain successful rollouts that violate the deformation tolerance, accounting for 0.7--24% of each configuration's successes. Under distribution shift, visuo-tactile variants achieve higher task success in all six policy--suite comparisons and higher DSR in five, whereas their in-distribution benefits are mixed. These results show that making touch available does not by itself ensure effective multimodal fusion. SoftVTBench therefore provides a common visuo-tactile resource for studying not only whether a policy succeeds, but how it physically interacts with deformable objects and when touch improves that interaction.
summary_zh: 物理交互质量是可变形物体操作的核心要素，但现有大多数基准仅评估任务是否成功。策略可能在完成任务的同时出现滑动或导致过度压缩。当前的主要瓶颈是缺乏可将策略可见的接触观测与完整任务过程中的独立物理真值配对的视觉触觉数据集。本文提出SoftVTBench，一款面向物理交互感知型可变形物体操作的视觉触觉数据集。该数据集包含4000个专家演示样本，覆盖50余种资产，包括体可变形物体及其视觉匹配的刚性孪生体。每个样本以20Hz频率同步采集多视角RGB图像、双指触觉RGB图像与标记点运动数据、本体感知数据、语言数据、二值与连续夹爪动作数据，以及仅面向评估器的有限元（FEM）状态数据。基于该数据集，本文构建了闭环基准，采用固定的对象专属校准定义形变感知成功率（DSR）：仅当样本完成任务且峰值归一化形变处于容忍区间内时，才判定为成功。在Diffusion Policy、π₀.₅与FastWAM三种策略上的测试结果表明，全部12种分布内配置下均存在满足任务要求但违反形变容忍度的成功样本，占各配置成功样本总数的0.7%至24%。在分布偏移场景下，6组策略-套件对比中，视觉触觉变体在全部6组中取得了更高的任务成功率，在5组中取得了更高的DSR，而其分布内的性能增益则表现不一。上述结果表明，仅引入触觉信息并不能保证实现有效的多模态融合。因此SoftVTBench提供了通用的视觉触觉资源，不仅可用于研究策略是否成功完成任务，还可用于研究其与可变形物体的物理交互方式，以及触觉信息何时能优化该交互过程。

title: Orienteering Problem with Uncertain Time-Varying Rewards: Framework and Benchmark for Everyday Service Robotics
title_zh: 带不确定时变奖励的定向越野问题：面向日常服务机器人的框架与基准
authors: Masafumi Endo, Kohei Honda, Yuu Jinnai, Ryo Yonetani
abstract: We present the orienteering problem with uncertain time-varying rewards (OP-UTVR), a novel variant of the orienteering problem (OP). While most existing OP formulations assume rewards to be known in advance, practical applications involve uncertain and time-varying rewards, as with shifting customer demand for delivery agents. OP-UTVR relaxes this assumption by allowing agents to estimate reward dynamics from observations and forecast future rewards. This enables informed routing decisions despite stochastic reward changes and inevitable prediction errors. We address this problem using three planners that differ in planning horizon and online adaptivity, and derive theoretical bounds on their performance under reward stochasticity. We further introduce a mobile service robot benchmark for OP-UTVR, where a robot navigates among pedestrians in indoor environments. Experiments reveal trade-offs between planning horizon and adaptivity, and demonstrate the effectiveness of long-horizon planning with online adaptation.
summary_zh: 本文提出带不确定时变奖励的定向越野问题（OP-UTVR），这是定向越野问题（OP）的一类全新变体。现有绝大多数定向越野问题的公式化表述均假设奖励预先已知，但实际应用场景中的奖励具有不确定性与时变性，例如配送场景中客户需求的动态变化。OP-UTVR放宽了该假设，允许智能体从观测中估计奖励动态并预测未来奖励，从而在奖励随机变化与预测误差不可避免的条件下做出合理的路径规划决策。本文针对该问题设计了三种规划器，三者在规划时域与在线自适应性上存在差异，并推导了奖励随机性条件下三者性能的理论边界。本文进一步构建了面向OP-UTVR的移动服务机器人基准，场景为机器人在室内环境的行人之间导航。实验揭示了规划时域与自适应性之间的权衡关系，验证了具备在线自适应能力的长时域规划的有效性。

title: Dynamic SpectraFormer for Ultra-High-Definition Underwater Image Enhancement
title_zh: 面向超高清水下图像增强的Dynamic SpectraFormer
authors: Zhiqiang Hu, Tao Yu, Shouren Huang, Masatoshi Ishikawa
abstract: Underwater images suffer from color distortion, haze, and poor visibility due to light refraction and absorption in water. These challenges significantly impact the utilization of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) or marine robots. Typically, color and brightness distortions manifest at lower frequencies, while edge and texture distortions are prevalent at higher frequencies. Traditional methods struggle to concurrently rectify these mixed distortions as they primarily concentrate on the spatial domain. To address these issues, we introduce the Dynamic SpectraFormer, which enhances underwater images through a frequency domain transformer. The Dynamic SpectraFormer introduces an ultra-high-resolution sparse spectrum attention module, which could capture the long-term dependency without losing the universal approximating power. Additionally, we have developed a dynamic spectrum weight generation layer that serves as an adaptive spectrum band selector, accentuating critical frequency bands and suppressing less relevant ones. Consequently, this method significantly improves underwater image quality by addressing both high- and low-frequency distortions. Our extensive ablation studies and comparative evaluations consolidate the Dynamic SpectraFormer's efficacy across multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/arifence2024/DynamicSpectraFormer.git.
summary_zh: 水下图像由于水体对光线的折射与吸收，存在色彩失真、雾霭效应与能见度低等问题，严重影响自主水下航行器（AUV）或海洋机器人的应用效果。通常，色彩与亮度失真主要出现在低频段，而边缘与纹理失真则普遍存在于高频段。传统方法主要聚焦于空间域处理，难以同时校正这类混合失真。针对该问题，本文提出Dynamic SpectraFormer，通过频域Transformer实现水下图像增强。Dynamic SpectraFormer引入超高清稀疏频谱注意力模块，可在不损失通用逼近能力的前提下捕捉长距离依赖关系。此外，本文开发了动态频谱权重生成层，可作为自适应频段选择器，强化关键频段并抑制无关频段。因此，该方法可同时校正高频与低频失真，显著提升水下图像质量。大量消融实验与对比评估验证了Dynamic SpectraFormer在多个水下图像增强基准上的有效性。相关源代码已开源至：https://github.com/arifence2024/DynamicSpectraFormer.git。

title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
title_zh: 面向血管内导航多任务世界模型控制的渐进式经验融合方法
authors: Harry Robertshaw, Maxence Boels, Nikola Fischer, Sebastien Ourselin, Christos Bergeles, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C Booth
abstract: Autonomous endovascular navigation could support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy to underserved areas, but controllers must navigate long, multi-stage paths across varying vascular anatomies. This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller. We additionally evaluate a heuristic that changes the Model Predictive Path Integral planning horizon using residual action-sequence dispersion, and fine-tuning in a patient-specific simulation. Across five subtasks in ten known training anatomies with held-out targets, PEF achieved a mean success rate of 74%, compared with 37% for Soft Actor-Critic (p < 0.001) and 65% for base TD-MPC2 (p = 0.053). A PEF controller with adaptive-horizon planning trained on 30 vasculatures achieved a mean success rate of 90% in ten held-out vasculatures. The PEF agent successfully transferred to an unseen in vitro stroke patient vasculature under fluoroscopy, achieving a mean path ratio improvement from 63% to 80% with fine-tuning (p < 0.001), following 40x103 fine-tuning steps (corresponding to approximately 107 min of clinical inter-hospital transfer time). This work represents a proof of concept for multi-vasculature training and patient-specific adaptation, while further validation is required before clinical deployment.
summary_zh: 自主血管内导航可支持机械取栓技术覆盖医疗资源不足的地区，但控制器需要在不同血管解剖结构下导航长距离多阶段路径。本研究采用渐进式经验融合（PEF）方法训练多任务TD-MPC2控制器，还评估了一种基于残差动作序列离散度调整模型预测路径积分规划时域的启发式策略，以及在患者专属仿真环境中进行微调的方案。在10个已知训练解剖结构、包含预留目标的5个子任务场景中，采用PEF方法的平均成功率达74%，优于Soft Actor-Critic的37%（p<0.001）与基础版TD-MPC2的65%（p=0.053）。在30个血管结构上训练的带自适应时域规划的PEF控制器，在10个未见过的血管结构上的平均成功率达90%。该PEF智能体可在透视成像条件下成功迁移至未见过的体外中风患者血管模型，经过微调后平均路径完成率从63%提升至80%（p<0.001），微调步数为4万步（对应临床院间转运时间约107分钟）。本研究为多血管结构训练与患者专属适配提供了概念验证，后续还需进一步验证方可投入临床应用。

title: Evaluation of Monocular SLAM Systems on High-Altitude Nadir UAV Footage
title_zh: 高空正射无人机影像下的单目同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）系统性能评估
authors: Ga\v{s}per Spagnolo, Matej Dobrevski, Danijel Sko\v{c}aj
abstract: Aerial nadir video combines weak geometric constraints with severe perceptual aliasing, making it a difficult regime for monocular SLAM. We benchmark five monocular SLAM systems on local UAV flights, synthetic city-scale imagery, and long-range aerial sequences. To isolate visual performance, we provide no inertial or GNSS aiding. Performance varies strongly with environment and trajectory scale: MASt3R-SLAM achieves the lowest mean horizontal MAE on the five DJI flights (0.53\% of reference path length), whereas no system consistently preserves global trajectory shape on the long GES and ALTO sequences. Overall, DROID-SLAM performs best, averaging 2.88\% of reference path length across completed runs. Vertical position remains poor, and large-area trajectories remain highly distorted despite loop-closure capability. Current monocular SLAM methods are by themselves therefore insufficient for reliable visual-only aerial navigation.
summary_zh: 航空正射视频存在几何约束弱、感知混叠严重的问题，是单目SLAM技术的典型难点应用场景。本文在本地无人机飞行数据集、合成城市场景影像、长距离航空序列上对5种单目SLAM系统开展基准测试，为排除其他传感器影响视觉性能评估，测试过程不引入惯性或全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）辅助。结果显示系统性能随环境和轨迹尺度变化差异显著：MASt3R-SLAM在5组大疆飞行数据集上取得最低的平均水平平均绝对误差（MAE），误差为参考路径长度的0.53%，但没有任何系统可以在长距离GES和ALTO序列上始终保持全局轨迹形状。整体来看DROID-SLAM表现最优，在所有完成的测试运行中平均误差为参考路径长度的2.88%。即便具备回环检测能力，现有系统的垂直位置估计精度仍然较差，大尺度轨迹畸变问题十分突出。因此仅靠当前的单目SLAM方法无法实现可靠的纯视觉航空导航。

title: Payload Swing Estimation and Damping Without Payload Parameters for Multirotor UAVs
title_zh: 无需载荷参数的多旋翼无人机载荷摆动估计与阻尼控制
authors: K. Taki, K. Umemoto
abstract: Cable-suspended payload transport by multirotor UAVs is flexible but generates periodic swing disturbance that degrades tracking and risks instability. Existing anti-swing methods require additional sensors or precise identification of cable length and payload mass, limiting field deployment. We propose a swing-estimation and damping method using only the onboard IMU and throttle command, requiring no payload parameters. An extended Kalman filter extracts the periodic disturbance with the unknown pendulum frequency as an estimated state, and an active damping controller adds a correction angle to the attitude loop to dissipate pendulum energy. Flight experiments confirm robust damping across a tested range of cable-length and mass variations.
summary_zh: 多旋翼无人机悬吊式载荷运输方式灵活性强，但运行过程中会产生周期性摆动扰动，降低轨迹跟踪精度甚至引发失稳风险。现有抗摆方法需要额外传感器或精确识别缆绳长度、载荷质量等参数，限制了其野外部署能力。本文提出一种仅使用机载惯性测量单元（IMU）和油门指令的摆动估计与阻尼方法，无需任何载荷相关参数。该方法采用扩展卡尔曼滤波器将未知摆频作为估计状态提取周期性扰动，同时设计主动阻尼控制器在姿态环中添加修正角以耗散摆动物体的能量。飞行实验验证了该方法在测试范围内的缆绳长度和载荷质量变化场景下均能实现稳定的阻尼效果。

title: LabDex: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Laboratories
title_zh: LabDex：面向实验室场景灵巧操作的分层基准数据集
authors: Zhipeng Tang, Sihang Chen, Sha Zhang, Peihao Yang, Yan Liu, Wentao Zhao, Xinrui Liu, Rui Huang, Wensheng Du, Yuting Huang, Jiajun Deng, Lidian Wang, Yuan Zhang, Yanyong Zhang
abstract: Autonomous laboratories hold great promise for accelerating scientific discovery. To achieve this vision, robots are supposed to dexterously manipulate diverse labware and instruments and execute long-horizon, state-dependent experimental procedures. Yet existing benchmarks do not jointly capture dexterous hand use, real-world laboratory interactions, and multi-stage experimental procedures, limiting systematic training and evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LabDex, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark for dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories, organized around a hierarchical task taxonomy spanning atomic skills, compositional tasks, and long-horizon experiments. First, LabDex is cross-platform and, for the first time, unifies real-world and simulation platforms under a common framework, providing standardized task definitions, demonstrations, and evaluation protocols. Second, LabDex is large-scale and systematically organizes chemistry laboratory operations into three interconnected levels: Atomic Skills, which characterize fundamental dexterous manipulation capabilities; Compositional Skills; and Long-Horizon Laboratory Workflows. This hierarchical design not only supports the evaluation of end-task performance, but also enables the analysis of how fundamental dexterous skills compose and influence more complex laboratory operations. We conduct cross-level evaluations of representative robot learning methods in both real-world and simulation environments. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of the LabDex task design and demonstration data, and show that the benchmark supports the training and systematic evaluation of existing robotic policies across laboratory dexterous manipulation tasks at different levels, providing a foundation for further research and development of autonomous laboratory robots.
summary_zh: 自主实验室可大幅加速科学发现进程，为实现这一目标，机器人需要能够灵巧操作各类实验器具和仪器，执行长周期、状态依赖的实验流程。但现有基准数据集无法同时覆盖灵巧手使用、真实实验室交互、多阶段实验流程三类场景，限制了相关技术的系统化训练与评估。为填补这一空白，本文提出LabDex——面向化学实验室场景灵巧操作的大规模真实世界数据集与基准平台，其基于覆盖原子级技能、组合任务、长周期实验的分层任务分类体系构建。首先，LabDex是跨平台基准，首次将真实场景与仿真平台在统一框架下打通，提供标准化的任务定义、演示数据和评估协议；其次，LabDex规模庞大，将化学实验室操作系统划分为三个关联层级：表征基础灵巧操作能力的原子技能、组合技能以及长周期实验室工作流。这种分层设计不仅支持端到端任务性能评估，还可分析基础灵巧技能如何组合并影响更复杂的实验室操作。本文在真实场景和仿真环境中对代表性机器人学习方法开展跨层级评估，实验结果验证了LabDex任务设计和演示数据的有效性，证明该基准可支持现有机器人策略在不同层级实验室灵巧操作任务中的训练与系统化评估，为自主实验室机器人的后续研发提供基础支撑。

title: The Role of Grid Cells in Reducing Spatial Aliasing in Hippocampal Place Representations
title_zh: 网格细胞在降低海马体位置表征中空间混叠效应的作用
authors: Alexander Johnson, Obadah Ghizawi, Ali A. Minai
abstract: Spatial aliasing occurs when two or more distinct locations produce highly similar place-cell representations, primarily due to environmental symmetry or repetitive structures. This issue is most pronounced when place representations are constructed solely from boundary vector cell (BVC) inputs, because symmetric or repetitive structures can yield indistinguishable sensory patterns across multiple locations in an environment. This work introduces grid cell signals to mitigate spatial aliasing in such settings. Because grid cells contribute periodic, internally generated spatial signals that vary independently of environmental geometry, they play a key role in disambiguating perceptually identical locations. We integrate multiple modules of analytically constructed grid cells with BVC-driven place cells and show that this leads to a 94--99% reduction in spatial aliasing relative to a BVC-only baseline across three environments: an open environment without obstacles; an environment with a cross-shaped central obstacle creating high visual symmetry; and a maze environment. The greatest improvement occurs in the environment with the highest visual symmetry. These results indicate that grid cells provide information complementary to boundary-based inputs, yielding more reliable place representations in geometrically ambiguous environments.
summary_zh: 空间混叠指两个及以上不同位置产生高度相似的位置细胞表征的现象，主要由环境对称性或重复结构引发。当位置表征仅由边界向量细胞（BVC）输入构建时，该问题尤为突出，因为对称或重复结构会导致环境中多个位置的感知模式无法区分。本文引入网格细胞信号缓解这类场景下的空间混叠问题：由于网格细胞输出的是与环境几何结构无关的周期性内源性空间信号，可有效区分感知上完全相同的不同位置。本文将多个解析构建的网格细胞模块与BVC驱动的位置细胞整合，在三类环境（无障碍物开放环境、存在十字形中心障碍物的高视觉对称环境、迷宫环境）中的测试结果显示，与仅使用BVC的基线方法相比，该方案可将空间混叠程度降低94%~99%，其中视觉对称度最高的环境下性能提升幅度最大。结果表明网格细胞可提供与边界输入互补的信息，在几何结构模糊的环境中生成更可靠的位置表征。

title: Real-Time Control-Constrained DDP for Underactuated Balancing of Legged Robots
title_zh: 面向欠驱动足式机器人平衡控制的实时带约束微分动态规划（DDP）方法
authors: SeongWon Nam, Hyunyong Lee, Hansol Kang, Jiman Park, Yeongwoo Son, Bumsu Yi, Jaeyoung Oh, Hyouk Ryeol Choi
abstract: This paper presents a real-time control-constrained Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) framework for underactuated legged robots. To address the limitation of classical DDP in handling control constraints, we propose an Accelerated Projected Gradient (APG)-based control-constrained DDP (ABC-DDP), which efficiently computes constrained solutions and identifies active sets without repeated Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) inversions. A virtual constraint is introduced to integrate control constraints within a feasibility-driven multiple-shooting framework, enabling stable optimization even from dynamically infeasible initializations. The proposed method supports real-time model predictive control (MPC) with short horizons under strong underactuation. Simulation results demonstrate static two-leg standing under external disturbances, along with diverse dynamic motions including slow catwalk, upright walking, and high-speed running within a unified MPC framework. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of static two-leg standing of a quadruped robot achieved using real-time finite-horizon MPC.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向欠驱动足式机器人的实时带控制约束微分动态规划（DDP）框架。针对经典DDP难以处理控制约束的缺陷，本文提出基于加速投影梯度（APG）的带控制约束DDP方法（ABC-DDP），无需重复求解卡罗需-库恩-塔克（KKT）逆矩阵即可高效计算约束解并识别有效集。该方法引入虚拟约束将控制约束整合到可行性驱动的多重打靶框架中，即使从动力学不可行的初始值开始也能实现稳定优化。所提方法支持强欠驱动场景下的短视界实时模型预测控制（MPC）。仿真结果显示，该统一MPC框架可实现受外部扰动下的静态双腿站立，以及慢走猫步、直立行走、高速奔跑等多种动态运动。据作者所知，这是首次通过实时有限视界MPC实现四足机器人的静态双腿站立。

title: An Experimental Study of Downwash Effects on a Continuum Manipulator Integrated with a Multirotor UAV
title_zh: 集成多旋翼无人机的连续型机械臂下洗效应实验研究
authors: Anuraj Uthayasooriyan, Krishna Manaswi Digumarti, ernando Vanegas, Felipe Gonzalez
abstract: Continuum arm aerial manipulation systems leverage soft-manipulator compliance and dexterity for tasks in confined or hazardous environments, but propeller downwash can degrade performance, particularly near walls and the ground. This effect remains uncharacterized for continuum manipulators. This letter experimentally studies downwash-induced kinematic deviations of a tendon-driven continuum manipulator integrated with a multirotor platform. Under still-air conditions, the CM is compared with a constant-curvature (CC) model. Downwash- induced end-effector pose deviations are then quantified relative to the mean still-air experimental baseline at four propeller throttle levels in free space, and at maximum throttle near a wall, and near the ground. Vertical position and yaw show the largest deviations and are amplified by ground effect. A CC-guided Gaussian process regression (GPR) residual model is learned from experimental data that improves forward pose prediction RMSE (position by 89-95%, orientation by 47-79%), and support compensation-oriented, downwash-aware modeling of continuum arm aerial manipulation systems.
summary_zh: 连续型机械臂空中操作系统可利用柔性机械臂的柔顺性和灵巧性，在受限或危险环境中完成作业，但螺旋桨下洗效应会降低系统性能，在近墙面和近地面场景下尤为明显，目前学界尚未明确连续型机械臂的下洗效应特性。本文通过实验研究集成在多旋翼平台上的绳驱动连续型机械臂由下洗引发的运动学偏差：首先在静风条件下将连续型机械臂的性能与常曲率（CC）模型进行对比，随后在自由空间4种不同螺旋桨油门档位、近墙面最大油门、近地面最大油门的场景下，以静风实验的平均结果为基线量化下洗引发的末端执行器位姿偏差。结果显示垂直位置和偏航角的偏差最大，且地面效应会进一步放大该偏差。本文基于实验数据训练了由常曲率模型引导的高斯过程回归（GPR）残差模型，将位姿预测的均方根误差（RMSE）的位置精度提升了89%~95%，姿态精度提升了47%~79%，可支撑面向补偿需求的下洗感知型连续型机械臂空中操作系统建模。

title: Designing Social Robots for Social-Cognition Training with Autistic Adults
title_zh: 面向自闭症成年人社会认知训练的社交机器人设计研究
authors: Yuval Zohar, Mordi Benhamou, Guy Laban
abstract: Social robots have been widely explored as tools for autism intervention, yet this literature has focused predominantly on children and has rarely involved autistic adults as active contributors to design. This creates a mismatch between existing systems and the social-cognitive challenges autistic adults actually face in everyday life, including navigating ambiguous interpersonal contexts, managing conversational timing, and interpreting implied emotional meaning. To address this gap, we conducted an online focus group and co-design session with five autistic adults to explore what a social robot for social-cognition training should do, how it should interact, and under what conditions it would be genuinely useful. The 90-minute session combined open discussion with structured co-design activities on a shared digital whiteboard, and the resulting verbal and visual data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. The analysis yielded seven themes that define core design requirements: the robot should function as a scaffold rather than a substitute, prioritise authenticity over comfort, provide personalised and user-controlled feedback, accommodate emotional self-awareness gaps, respect privacy and contextual boundaries, support rehearsal for real-world social situations, and remain configurable in identity, form, and expression. Together, the findings suggest that autistic adults envision the robot not as a companion or live social assistant, but as a private, configurable rehearsal partner designed to support independence over time.
summary_zh: 社交机器人已被广泛探索用于自闭症干预，但现有研究主要面向儿童群体，极少将自闭症成年人作为设计的主动参与者，导致现有系统与自闭症成年人在日常生活中面临的社会认知挑战（如处理模糊人际场景、把控对话节奏、解读隐含情绪含义等）不匹配。为解决这一问题，本文组织5名自闭症成年人开展线上焦点小组和协同设计会议，探索面向社会认知训练的社交机器人应具备的功能、交互模式和适用场景。这场90分钟的会议结合开放讨论与共享数字白板上的结构化协同设计活动，通过反射性主题分析法对得到的语音和视觉数据进行分析，提炼出7项核心设计要求：机器人应作为辅助工具而非替代者、优先保证交互真实性而非舒适性、提供用户可控的个性化反馈、适配情绪自我认知缺口、尊重隐私和场景边界、支持真实社交场景预演、身份形态和表达均可配置。研究结果表明，自闭症成年人期望的机器人并非陪伴者或实时社交助手，而是可配置的私密预演伙伴，用于长期提升自身的社交独立性。

title: DevGRU: Depth-guided Visual Navigation using a Collision-aware Recurrent Model
title_zh: DevGRU：基于碰撞感知循环模型的深度引导视觉导航方法
authors: Kyung Min Han, Eunsom Kim, Young J. Kim
abstract: Existing visual navigation models often aim to develop foundation models that can generalize robot navigation across diverse platforms. However, many of these models are prone to collisions when deployed in complex indoor environments, particularly in structured layouts and narrow passages. To address this problem, we propose a depth image- and point-goal-conditioned navigation system, DevGRU. The proposed system employs an action predictor (AP) that generates collision-aware future trajectories, enabling effective avoidance of immediate obstacles. In conjunction with a collision predictor, the AP further compensates for errors accumulated in the goal pose estimation and proactively mitigates future deviations. To evaluate our method, we conducted experiments across nine different scenes and three state-of-the-art approaches - ViNT, NoMaD, and NavDP - as well as four additional variants of ViNT and NoMaD. In terms of navigation performance, DevGRU significantly outperforms ViNT and NoMaD by a large margin. In addition, the proposed model has a relatively small number of trainable parameters, resulting in the fastest inference time among the baselines, particularly outperforming NavDP by 7x in model size and 17x in inference time.
summary_zh: 现有视觉导航模型大多致力于开发可跨多平台泛化的机器人导航基础模型，但这类模型在复杂室内环境（尤其是结构化布局和狭窄通道场景）部署时极易发生碰撞。针对该问题，本文提出一种以深度图像和点目标为输入条件的导航系统DevGRU。该系统采用动作预测器（AP）生成具备碰撞感知能力的未来轨迹，可有效规避近处障碍物；动作预测器与碰撞预测器配合，进一步补偿目标位姿估计的累积误差，主动缓解后续轨迹偏差。本文在9个不同场景下开展实验，对比3种主流前沿方法ViNT、NoMaD、NavDP以及ViNT和NoMaD的4种额外变体，结果显示DevGRU的导航性能大幅优于ViNT和NoMaD，同时该模型的可训练参数量规模较小，在所有基线方法中推理速度最快：模型规模仅为NavDP的1/7，推理速度是NavDP的17倍。

title: Backward Layout Search for Sequence-Constrained Robotic Assembly
title_zh: 面向序列约束机器人装配的反向布局搜索方法
authors: Xi Zhang, Jiancong Dai, Hao Chen, Zhengtao Hu, Changcai Yang, Weiwei Wan
abstract: Robotic assembly layout planning must determine the assembly site and the initial pose of each part while ensuring collision-free execution of a prescribed assembly sequence. This problem is challenging because the obstacle environment changes after each assembly step, and unassembled parts re maining in the workspace may block robot motions. We observe that the feasibility of each assembly step depends only on the initial poses of the current and later-assembled parts. Based on this dependency, we propose Backward Layout Search (BLS), which assigns initial part poses in reverse assembly order. Each expansion performs geometric, kinematic, grasp, and prescribed-motion checks, while collision masks and candidate set filtering remove infeasible initial part pose candidates. Promising partial layouts are retained through beam selection, and complete layouts are validated by full motion planning in forward assembly order. Experiments on five assembly models show that BLS produces collision-free executable layouts and reduces step evaluations and search time compared with a matched forward search.
summary_zh: 机器人装配布局规划需要确定每个零件的装配位置和初始位姿，同时保证指定装配序列的执行过程无碰撞。该问题的难点在于每完成一步装配后障碍物环境都会发生变化，工作空间内剩余未装配的零件可能阻挡机器人运动。本文观察到每一步装配的可行性仅取决于当前零件和后续装配零件的初始位姿，基于该依赖关系提出反向布局搜索（BLS）方法，按照与装配顺序相反的顺序分配零件初始位姿。搜索扩展过程中依次开展几何、运动学、抓取和指定运动校验，同时通过碰撞掩码和候选集过滤剔除不可行的零件初始位姿候选，通过束选择保留优质的部分布局方案，最终按照正向装配顺序开展完整运动规划以验证全布局的可行性。在5个装配模型上的实验结果表明，与同等条件下的正向搜索方法相比，BLS可生成无碰撞的可执行布局，同时减少步骤校验次数和搜索耗时。

title: HarvestPoint-ACT: Explicit Target Selection and Harvest-Point Conditioning for Robotic Fruit Harvesting under Occlusion
title_zh: HarvestPoint-ACT：面向遮挡场景下机器人水果采摘的显式目标选择与采摘点条件控制方法
authors: Hanying Hu, Weipeng Li, Yikun Huang, Hao Chen, Zhengtao Hu, Changcai Yang, Weiwei Wan
abstract: End-to-end imitation learning avoids hand-made robot motion for approaching and grasping, but the policy must still decide which fruit to pick and where to close the gripper. Occlusion can make the policy lose the selected fruit during harvesting, and the correct closing point is difficult to infer from pixels alone. This paper presents HarvestPoint-ACT, which makes both decisions explicit in perception and provides them to the policy. An instance segmentation front end with a keypoint branch predicts a mask and a harvest point for each visible fruit, where the harvest point specifies the location to close the gripper. A scheduler ranks detected candidates by occlusion and travel distance and selects one target. After each attempt, it redetects and reranks the candidates because the canopy may have changed. The selected fruit is encoded for an action chunking transformer as an eight-dimensional state, containing the absolute harvest point, the vector from the gripper to that point, a validity flag, and a confidence score. When the selected fruit is temporarily undetected, the system retains the last harvest point estimate in the robot base frame and marks it as stale, and aborts the attempt if the loss persists. On a canopy mock-up, HarvestPoint-ACT achieves a success rate of 88%, and of 75% under heavy occlusion.
summary_zh: 端到端模仿学习无需人工设计机器人的接近和抓取运动，但策略仍需自主决策采摘目标水果和夹爪闭合位置。遮挡会导致采摘过程中策略丢失选定的目标水果，且仅从图像像素难以推断正确的夹爪闭合位置。本文提出HarvestPoint-ACT方法，在感知环节显式输出两类决策结果并输入给策略：带有关键点分支的实例分割前端可为每个可见水果预测掩码和采摘点，采摘点即夹爪的闭合位置；调度器根据遮挡程度和运动距离对检测到的候选水果排序，选定一个目标，每次采摘尝试后由于冠层形态可能发生变化，系统会重新检测并对候选水果排序。选定的水果被编码为8维状态输入动作分块Transformer，该状态包含绝对采摘点、夹爪到采摘点的向量、有效性标志和置信度得分。当选定的水果暂时未被检测到时，系统会保留机器人基坐标系下最新的采摘点估计并标记为过期，若持续丢失目标则终止本次采摘尝试。在冠层模拟平台上的测试结果显示，HarvestPoint-ACT的采摘成功率可达88%，强遮挡场景下的成功率为75%。

title: The Embodiment Gap in Robot Foundation Models
title_zh: 机器人基础模型中的具身鸿沟
authors: Yukiyasu Domae, Keisuke Shirai, Hanbit Oh, Ryoichi Nakajo, Tomohiro Motoda, Koshi Makihara, Masaki Murooka, Takuma Yagi, Yoshiaki Bando, Ryo Hanai
abstract: Robot foundation models (RFMs), including vision-language-action (VLA) policies, are often discussed through a scaling view: more data, larger models, and broader benchmarks should improve generalization. In robotics, however, a model can generalize while work still remains before it can run on a robot with a particular body. The work required differs across methods and target robots, and those differences affect practical deployment. We call the gap between reusable models, representations, or data and their use in execution on the target robot the embodiment gap. This survey examines what can be reused across robot embodiments and what must still be implemented on a new robot. We place existing methods on a two-axis map that shows the type of shared structure and the stage at which adaptation is needed for execution on the target robot. We then examine recent work through three overlapping research directions: sharing semantics and perception, sharing robot data and interfaces, and learning correspondence across embodiments. We also propose a reporting framework for adaptation work that success rate alone does not reveal. The framework identifies the work that should be checked when comparing cross-embodiment learning and highlights work that remains on a new robot and questions for future study.
summary_zh: 当前针对机器人基础模型（RFMs，包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略）的讨论通常遵循缩放范式：认为更多数据、更大模型、更广泛的基准测试能够提升泛化能力。但在机器人领域中，即使模型具备泛化能力，要使其在搭载特定躯体的机器人上运行，仍需完成大量额外工作。不同方法、不同目标机器人所需的适配工作存在差异，这些差异会直接影响实际部署效果。我们将可复用模型、表征或数据与它们在目标机器人上执行落地之间的差距定义为具身鸿沟。本综述梳理了不同机器人具身形态之间可复用的内容，以及在新机器人上必须重新实现的部分。我们将现有方法归类到一个二维坐标系中，该坐标系可体现共享结构的类型，以及目标机器人执行任务时所需适配的阶段。随后从三个相互关联的研究方向梳理近年相关工作：语义与感知共享、机器人数据与接口共享、跨具身形态的对应关系学习。最后我们提出了一套适配工作的报告框架，仅靠成功率无法完整体现框架的价值，该框架可明确跨具身学习对比过程中应当核验的内容，突出新机器人部署中仍待完成的工作，同时指明未来值得探索的研究方向。

title: Multimodal Rapport Estimation in Real-World HRI
title_zh: 真实世界人机交互（HRI）中的多模态融洽度估计
authors: Akihiro Sakuramoto, Takato Hayashi, Ryo Miyoshi, Yuki Okafuji, Shogo Okada
abstract: Evaluating interaction quality in real-world HRI is an important challenge. If interaction quality can be estimated reliably, the results can be used to improve dialogue strategies and ultimately enable robots to adapt their behavior autonomously. However, existing automatic evaluation methods have been developed primarily in controlled laboratory settings, and it remains unclear whether they can be directly applied to real-world environments, where users are free to disengage and multi-party participation may arise naturally. In this study, we investigate the automatic estimation of third-party-rated rapport scores using 62 sessions of multimodal recordings collected in a Japanese drugstore. We compare zero-shot LLMs, pretrained text, audio, and visual models, and their prediction-level fusion. The results show that, in real-world HRI, zero-shot LLMs achieve strong performance, while audio and visual models tend to provide complementary information. In particular, Gemini 2.5 Flash performs strongly as a single model, and a fusion model combining Gemini (text) with HuBERT and V-JEPA performs best overall. Further analyses showed that estimation performance varied across interaction-duration and group-size conditions. These findings suggest that rapport estimation in real-world HRI requires evaluation and model design that account for contextual variability beyond that assumed in laboratory settings.
summary_zh: 评估真实世界人机交互（HRI）的交互质量是一项重要挑战。如果能够可靠估计交互质量，评估结果可用于优化对话策略，最终实现机器人自主调整自身行为。但现有自动评估方法大多是在受控实验室环境下开发的，尚不清楚其能否直接应用于真实场景：真实场景中用户可随时终止交互，也会自然出现多用户参与的情况。本研究基于日本药妆店采集的62组多模态交互记录，探究第三方标注的交互融洽度得分的自动估计方法，对比了零样本大语言模型（LLM）、预训练文本/音频/视觉模型，以及各模型预测层融合方案的性能。结果表明，在真实世界HRI场景下，零样本大语言模型可实现优异性能，而音频和视觉模型可提供互补信息。其中单模型Gemini 2.5 Flash表现突出，融合Gemini（文本分支）与HuBERT、V-JEPA的融合模型整体性能最优。进一步分析显示，估计性能会随交互时长、参与群体规模的变化产生波动。上述结论表明，真实世界HRI场景下的融洽度估计需要适配上下文多变性的评估方案与模型设计，不能直接套用实验室场景的预设条件。

title: A Task-Agnostic Control Strategy for Dynamic Assistance with Pneumatically Actuated Soft Exosuits
title_zh: 面向气动驱动柔性外服动态辅助的任务无关控制策略
authors: Anoush Sepehri, Zachary Huang, Raymond de Callafon, Michael T. Tolley, Tania K. Morimoto
abstract: Pneumatic artificial muscles have provided new opportunities to develop upper-extremity soft exosuits for reha- bilitation, augmentation, and assisted daily living. However, the complex dynamics and limited bandwidth of these actuators has made providing responsive assistance based on user intention a longstanding challenge. In this work, we present an inverse-plant control strategy for pneumatically actuated soft exosuits that only relies on kinematic sensing for task-agnostic and dynamic assistance during daily living. We model the human-robot system using a Hammerstein dynamic model, consisting of a Preisach hysteresis model and a linear time-invariant filter, to capture the static and dynamic behavior of the system.
