We personalize our model to each user using 140 s of data and approximate an inverse to integrate into our control loop. When evaluated on a test rig that emulated a soft assistive exosuit for the wrist, our controller reduced the interaction torque by up to 73% and the activation of key flexor and extensor muscles by up to 47% relative to the condition with no assistance for speeds ranging from 8{\deg}/s to 120{\deg}/s. Overall, this work presents a control strategy that can provide task-agnostic, dynamic assistance with pneumatically actuated soft exosuits without the need for physiological or force sensors to interpret user intention.
summary_zh: 气动人工肌肉为开发用于康复、力量增强、日常活动辅助的上肢柔性外服提供了新的思路。但这类驱动器的复杂动力学特性与有限带宽，使得基于用户意图提供响应式辅助成为长期存在的技术难点。本研究提出了一种面向气动驱动柔性外服的逆被控对象控制策略，仅依靠运动学传感即可在日常活动中实现任务无关的动态辅助。我们采用由Preisach迟滞模型与线性时不变滤波器组成的Hammerstein动态模型对人机系统建模，可同时捕捉系统的静态与动态特性。仅需采集140秒数据即可完成针对不同用户的模型个性化适配，之后通过求解模型逆并集成到控制回路中完成控制。在模拟腕部柔性辅助外服的测试台架上评估显示，在8°/s到120°/s的运动速度范围内，与无辅助状态相比，该控制器可将交互扭矩最高降低73%，将关键屈肌与伸肌的激活程度最高降低47%。总体而言，本研究提出的控制策略无需生理传感器或力传感器解析用户意图，即可为气动驱动柔性外服提供任务无关的动态辅助。

title: Reproducible Multimodal Affordance Prediction
title_zh: 可复现的多模态可供性预测
authors: Tommaso Apicella, Alessio Xompero, Andrea Cavallaro
abstract: Affordance prediction is the identification of potential actions an agent can perform on a target object from multimodal inputs. Affordance prediction methods are difficult to evaluate and compare due to heterogeneous problem formulations, inconsistent dataset annotations, incomplete reporting of experimental protocols, and limited information about deployment conditions. These limitations challenge fair benchmarking and performance comparison. To promote transparency, we propose the Affordance Sheet, a documentation detailing task formulation with its input modalities, model architectures and training information, datasets, and experimental protocols. Affordance Sheets enable reproducible benchmarking and reliable evaluation of affordance models for real-world scenarios, including generalisation to novel conditions and human safety.
summary_zh: 可供性预测指从多模态输入中识别智能体可对目标物体执行的潜在动作。由于问题定义异质性、数据集标注不一致、实验方案报告不完整、部署条件信息缺失，可供性预测方法的评估与对比难度极高，严重阻碍了公平基准测试与性能比较。为提升研究透明度，本文提出「可供性文档（Affordance Sheet）」机制，用于详细记录任务定义、输入模态、模型架构与训练信息、数据集、实验方案等全部内容。可供性文档可支撑面向真实场景的可供性模型的可复现基准测试与可靠评估，覆盖新场景泛化、人类安全等核心评估维度。

title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
title_zh: GuideFetch：辅助机器狗并发导航与物体抓取的任务协调框架
authors: Qian Yin, Ruiping Liu, Kunyu Peng, Jianxiang Man, Isik Baran Sandan, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Kailun Yang, Rainer Stiefelhagen
abstract: Consider a robot guide dog escorting a blind user to an available seat while a second assistive robot dog concurrently retrieves a cup of coffee and delivers it to the same seat. This setting motivates concurrent execution because navigation and object retrieval can overlap. A syntactically valid Large Language Model (LLM) plan may still violate embodiment constraints, and successful-looking controller motion does not by itself establish task completion. We introduce \textsc{GuideFetch}, a coordination framework for concurrent navigation and object retrieval by a heterogeneous guider and fetcher team. An LLM instantiates a schedule-conditioned four-action schema from a natural-language instruction. Before execution, robot, skill, and target aliases are normalized, and proposed actions are validated against registered targets, robot capabilities, and the selected schedule. Robot and object states then govern sequential and parallel execution. In a matched $2\times2$ study across 90 combinations of scene and seed (360 executions), all 180 online LLM responses validate without fallback or replay and match the corresponding scripted plans. For each planner source, sequential and parallel execution achieve $72/90$ and $71/90$ operational successes, respectively. Among the 56 cases completed by both schedules, parallel execution reduces mean makespan by 41.3\%. Within this controlled setting, role specialization and action overlap shorten completed missions, while state checks distinguish plan validity from verified mission completion. Source code will be available.
summary_zh: 设想如下场景：一台导盲机器狗护送视障用户前往空位，同时另一台辅助机器狗同步取回一杯咖啡并送到同一位置。该场景支持任务并发执行，导航与物体抓取流程可部分重叠。大语言模型（LLM）生成的语法合法规划仍可能违反具身约束，且控制器的运动表现正常也不代表任务实际完成。本文提出GuideFetch协调框架，支持由导航引导机器狗与抓取机器狗组成的异质团队并发完成导航与物体抓取任务。大语言模型可根据自然语言指令生成带调度条件的四动作模式，执行前会对机器人、技能、目标的别名做归一化处理，并对照已注册的目标、机器人能力、选定调度方案对所有待执行动作做合法性校验，之后由机器人状态与物体状态共同控制串行与并行流程的执行。在覆盖90种场景与随机种子组合的2×2对照实验中（共360次执行），所有180次在线大语言模型生成的响应全部通过校验，无需回退或重执行，且与对应人工编写的规划完全匹配。针对不同规划源，串行执行与并行执行的任务成功率分别为72/90与71/90。在两种调度方案均完成的56个案例中，并行执行的平均完工时间降低了41.3%。在本次受控实验中，角色分工与动作重叠可缩短任务总时长，而状态校验机制可区分规划合法性与已验证的任务完成状态。相关源代码将开源发布。

title: Transferable Tool-Tissue Contact Detection from Stereo Depth in Robot-Assisted Surgery
title_zh: 机器人辅助手术中基于立体深度的可迁移工具-组织接触检测
authors: Mingyeung Wu, Zhonghao Zhang, Hao Yang, Alan Kuntz, Jie Ying Wu
abstract: Reliable tool--tissue contact detection can support interaction-aware control and downstream force estimation in robot-assisted surgery. Most existing methods learn a contact classifier from RGB appearance, which is hard to generalize. In this work, we use the depth image generated from a stereo pair to give more information about tool--tissue contact. For each depth frame, we localize a spatially supported minimum-distance patch around the tool boundary and reduce it to a single scalar, $-\log_{10}|d|$; this signal rises and falls in step with ground-truth contact. We formalize this observation with a fully supervised two-state hidden Markov model. We fit this model as a six-fold leave-one-session-out (LOSO) ensemble on six palpation sessions against a single silicone cup-like phantom, with the decision threshold selected from the pooled out-of-fold predictions. It is evaluated on four held-out sessions of three categories: 1. same task on same phantom; 2. same task on different phantom; 3. different task on different phantom. This model reaches held-out macro F1 $0.927$ and AUPRC $0.980$. We further compare against a reproduction of an RGB-based contact classifier from prior work. This RGB-based model achieves high performance on the first category (F1 $0.965$), but substantially lower performance on the other two, resulting in macro F1 $0.320$ across all four sessions. These results indicate that the tool--tissue distance is a strong, transferable cue for contact detection in robot-assisted surgery.
summary_zh: 可靠的工具-组织接触检测可为机器人辅助手术中的交互感知控制与后续力估计任务提供支撑。现有多数方法基于RGB外观特征训练接触分类器，泛化能力较差。本研究利用立体图像对生成的深度图像获取工具-组织接触的额外信息：针对每帧深度图像，我们在工具边界周围定位空间支撑的最小距离块，将其降维为标量$-\log_{10}|d|$，该信号可与真实接触状态同步升降。基于该观测，我们构建了全监督双状态隐马尔可夫模型。针对6次在硅胶杯状仿体上完成的触诊实验，采用六折留一会话交叉验证（LOSO）集成方式训练模型，从合并的折外预测结果中选择决策阈值。最终在三类共4组未参与训练的会话上完成评估：1. 同一仿体上的同一任务；2. 不同仿体上的同一任务；3. 不同仿体上的不同任务。该模型在测试集上的宏F1得分为0.927，AUPRC（精度-召回曲线下面积）为0.980。我们进一步复现了现有基于RGB的接触分类器做对比，该RGB模型在第一类场景下性能优异（F1得分为0.965），但在另外两类场景下性能大幅下降，在全部4组会话上的宏F1得分仅为0.320。上述结果表明，工具-组织距离是机器人辅助手术中接触检测的强可迁移特征。

title: VERAGMIL: Virtual Environment for Scooping Granular Foods with Imitation Learning Models
title_zh: VERAGMIL：面向基于模仿学习模型的颗粒状食物舀取任务的虚拟环境
authors: Amanuel Ergogo, Diego Dall'Alba, Przemyslaw Korzeniowski
abstract: Robot-Assisted Feeding (RAF) systems are essential for assisting individuals with disabilities or motor impairments in eating tasks. Manipulating granular food items, such as rice and beans, poses significant challenges due to their dynamic physical properties. Learning from human demonstrations offers a promising solution, but acquiring high-quality demonstrations is complex. To address this, we present VERAGMIL, a framework that combines a high-fidelity simulator with an intuitive Virtual Reality (VR) interface for recording demonstrations and supporting different imitation learning methods. VERAGMIL provides a realistic environment for training RAF systems to handle granular materials, including robots, sensors, and various food items with distinct physical characteristics. We evaluate VERAGMIL by training three imitation learning models, BC, BC-RNN, and BCQ, on granular scooping and transporting tasks using both VR interface and 3D space mouse demonstrations, comparing them with a human-expert baseline. The models are assessed on success rate, spillage, generalization to unseen food items, and task completion time. Results show that VR-based demonstrations significantly outperform 3D space mouse data, with BCQ achieving the best overall performance, particularly in reducing spillage and approaching human performance. These findings underscore the effectiveness of our framework for training RAF systems in granular material handling. The code for our framework is publicly available at: https://github.com/AmanuelErgogo/VERAGMIL.git.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助进食（RAF）系统是帮助残障或运动障碍人群完成进食任务的核心技术。操控米饭、豆子等颗粒状食物时，由于其动态物理特性复杂，相关任务存在显著挑战。从人类演示中学习是极具潜力的解决方案，但采集高质量演示数据的难度很高。为解决该问题，本文提出VERAGMIL框架，该框架融合高保真模拟器与直观的虚拟现实（VR）界面，可用于录制演示数据，同时支持多种模仿学习方法的训练。VERAGMIL提供了可训练RAF系统处理颗粒物料的真实环境，内置机器人、传感器以及多种物理特性各异的食物模型。我们基于VR界面与3D空间鼠标采集的演示数据，在颗粒舀取与转运任务上训练了BC、BC-RNN、BCQ三种模仿学习模型，并与人类专家基线做对比，从成功率、洒落率、对未见过食物的泛化能力、任务完成时间四个维度评估模型性能。结果表明，基于VR采集的演示数据训练的模型性能显著优于基于3D空间鼠标数据训练的模型，其中BCQ的整体性能最优，在降低食物洒落率方面表现突出，性能接近人类水平。上述结果验证了本框架用于训练RAF系统处理颗粒物料任务的有效性。框架代码已开源至：https://github.com/AmanuelErgogo/VERAGMIL.git。

title: GAPL: Grounded Action-effect Policy Learning for LLM-Based Trajectory Planning
title_zh: GAPL：面向大语言模型轨迹规划的具身动作效应策略学习
authors: Zhihong Cui, Hengyu Liu, Zhangkai Wu, Yushuai Li, Tianyi Li, Peiyuan Guan, Amir Taherkordi, Tor Skeie
abstract: Trajectory planning for autonomous driving requires both high-level reasoning and precise low-level control. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer semantic-rich planning capabilities, however, their application is limited by hallucinated reasoning, poor grounding in environment dynamics, and limited numerical precision in control. We propose GAPL (Grounded Action-effect Policy Learning), a unified framework that integrates LLM-based effect estimation, simulation-based effect grounding, and policy optimization into a closed-loop system. GAPL consists of three modules: (1) an LLM-based Effect Evaluator for structured multi-dimensional action-effect estimation; (2) a Simulation-based Effect Grounder that predicts dynamics-consistent effects from simulator rollouts; and (3) an Effect-Aware Decision Maker that grounds LLM effect estimates against simulation via a distiller to guide Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based policy learning. Experiments on four Highway-env scenarios demonstrate that GAPL consistently outperforms baselines, achieving average reductions of {0.76, 0.86, 2.00} in collision rate, average displacement error (ADE), and final displacement error (FDE), and an average reward gain of 1.44.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶的轨迹规划同时需要高层语义推理与底层精准控制能力。大语言模型（LLM）具备语义丰富的规划能力，但应用受限于推理幻觉、环境动力学 grounding 能力差、控制数值精度不足等问题。本文提出GAPL（Grounded Action-effect Policy Learning，具身动作效应策略学习）统一框架，将基于大语言模型的效应估计、基于仿真的效应 grounding 与策略优化集成到闭环系统中。GAPL包含三个模块：（1）基于大语言模型的效应评估器，用于完成结构化多维动作-效应估计；（2）基于仿真的效应 grounding 模块，从仿真器 rollout 结果中预测符合动力学一致性的效应；（3）效应感知决策器，通过蒸馏器将大语言模型输出的效应估计与仿真结果对齐，指导基于近端策略优化（PPO）的策略学习。在四个Highway-env场景下的实验表明，GAPL性能始终优于基线方法，碰撞率、平均位移误差（ADE）、最终位移误差（FDE）平均分别降低0.76、0.86、2.00，平均奖励提升1.44。

title: Zero-Shot Transfer of Force Map Estimation Across GelSight Mini Sensors
title_zh: 跨GelSight Mini传感器的力图估计零样本迁移
authors: Julio Casta\~no Amoros, Pablo Gil
abstract: Despite the rapid industrialization of the touch sensor manufacturing process, most of these sensors are still handmade in research laboratories. This complicates standardizing their performance, requiring the repetition of data collection and training models for each unit produced. To address this problem, this paper presents a method that can generalize the estimation of 3D force maps across different GelSight Mini sensor units, regardless of the sensor version. Specifically, the method consists of two stages: a domain adaptation stage, in which the input tactile image is reconstructed as a general tactile image using a UniT-based model; and a stage for estimating 3D force maps employing a U-Net network. Our proposal achieves promising results in both steps, such as an SSIM of 0.9338 +- 0.0358 in the image reconstruction phase and an MAE_F of 1.1294 +- 1.5934(N) in the force estimation phase.
summary_zh: 尽管触觉传感器制造工业化进程快速推进，多数研究实验室使用的触觉传感器仍为手工制作，导致传感器性能标准化难度大，每生产一台新传感器都需要重复完成数据采集与模型训练工作。为解决该问题，本文提出一种可跨不同版本GelSight Mini传感器单元泛化3D力图估计的方法。该方法分为两个阶段：第一阶段为域适配阶段，采用基于UniT的模型将输入触觉图像重建为通用触觉图像；第二阶段为3D力图估计阶段，采用U-Net网络完成力图预测。该方法在两个阶段均取得了优异效果：图像重建阶段的结构相似性（SSIM）达到0.9338±0.0358，力估计阶段的力平均绝对误差（MAE_F）达到1.1294±1.5934N。

title: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5: A Behavior World Model for Robust Whole-Body Control with Environment Interaction
title_zh: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5：面向环境交互下鲁棒全身控制的行为世界模型
authors: Ziyang Cheng, Tianshu Tang, Jinxin Lan, Xinze Chen, Yuhan Gong, Zhichao Liu, Changzhong Wu, Yahao Mao, Zongyan Deng, Mingxuan Ma, Huasen Xi, Yilong Liu, Yutong Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Yang Wang, Yun Ye, Guan Huang, Xiaojie Jin, Zheng Zhu, Jiwen Lu
abstract: Whole-body motion tracking policies turn a humanoid into a robust control interface: the teleoperator---or an upstream model---only supplies a coarse movement intent, while the low-level policy keeps the robot balanced and physically feasible. Existing trackers deliver this interface only on flat ground: trained in empty scenes, they never learn how contact with terrain and objects reshapes their dynamics, and they attempt to teach the policy to balance under any command by continually enlarging the reference-motion corpus, which stops working once feasible behaviors become environment-dependent. We present GigaBrain-WBC-0.5, the first Behavior World Model (BWM) for humanoid whole-body control. Rather than a purely reactive tracker, we train a causal Transformer to jointly predict its next action, next state, and the distribution over its next latent behavior command, so the network that acts also models how the environment shapes what it can do next. An automatic terrain-annotation pipeline recovers full 3D contact geometry from retargeted motion, enabling terrain annotation at the scale of existing motion datasets. The predicted distribution is reused at deployment to detect implausible commands online and retract them onto learned behaviors, so the robot attempts tasks in a "best-effort" manner. The result is a unified policy that takes real-time command, interacts with environment, and stays robust to implausible commands, falls, and disturbances. GigaBrain-WBC-0.5 achieves the highest success rate across all four regimes among three large-scale tracker baselines: 81.3% on terrain interaction (4.3x the strongest baseline), 83.1% under implausible commands, and 99.3% fall recovery (16.8x the strongest baseline). Hardware trials show robust interaction under missing supports and disturbances; the Unitree G1 checkpoint transfers to the Maker L01 robot with simple fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 全身运动跟踪策略可将人形机器人转化为鲁棒的控制接口：遥操作者或上游模型仅需输出粗略的运动意图，底层策略即可保证机器人平衡与运动物理可行性。现有跟踪器仅能在平坦地面上实现该接口：这类模型在空场景中训练，从未学习地形与物体接触如何改变系统动力学，只能通过持续扩充参考运动语料库让策略学习任意指令下的平衡能力，当可行行为依赖环境特性时该方案就会失效。本文提出GigaBrain-WBC-0.5，是首个面向人形机器人全身控制的行为世界模型（BWM）。该模型并非纯反应式跟踪器，我们训练因果Transformer同时预测下一时刻动作、下一时刻状态，以及下一时刻潜在行为指令的分布，因此执行网络同时具备环境对后续动作约束的建模能力。自动地形标注流水线可从重定向后的运动数据中恢复完整3D接触几何，可在现有运动数据集规模下完成地形标注。部署阶段可复用预测得到的分布在线检测不合理指令，将其修正为已学习的可行行为，使机器人以尽力而为的模式完成任务。最终得到的统一策略可接收实时指令、与环境交互，同时对不合理指令、摔倒、外部扰动具备鲁棒性。在与三个大规模基线跟踪器的对比中，GigaBrain-WBC-0.5在全部四个测试场景下的成功率均为最高：地形交互场景下成功率81.3%，是最优基线的4.3倍；不合理指令场景下成功率83.1%；摔倒恢复成功率99.3%，是最优基线的16.8倍。硬件测试表明该机器人可在支撑缺失、外部扰动场景下实现鲁棒交互，Unitree G1模型权重仅需简单微调即可迁移到Maker L01机器人上运行。

title: Revisiting the "Push-T" Robot Manipulation Task with Agentic Robotics
title_zh: 基于智能体机器人技术重新审视“Push-T（T形块推送）”机器人操作任务
authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Ken Goldberg
abstract: Push-T is an iconic benchmark for learning manipulation policies from human demonstrations. The robot must use a single point of contact to push a T-shaped block into a target pose. In this short paper, we revisit the Push-T task in the context of emerging advances in Agentic Robotics where an LLM coding agent -- Claude Code with Fable 5 -- is prompted to create an algorithmic solution that does not require any demonstration data. We study how effective the agentic coding loop can solve the Push-T task, and compare the resulting code as policy with the visuomotor imitation learning policy. Results suggest that the agent found the 2D gym simulation online, and used sim experiments to learn push mechanics, iteratively optimizing to achieve 100% success rate using 46% fewer steps than the best diffusion policy trained with 200 human demonstrations. The coding agent also solve extensions from T to the full alphabet (Push-A to Push-Z) using a self generated curriculum and generated simulation code for the Franka and UR5 robot arms in 3D cross-embodiment simulations with visual feedback. Videos, policies and details will be posted online.
summary_zh: Push-T是从人类演示中学习操作策略的标志性基准任务，要求机器人通过单点接触将T形块推送至目标位姿。本篇短论文在智能体机器人（Agentic Robotics）技术最新进展的背景下重新研究Push-T任务：研究团队调用搭载Fable 5的Claude Code大语言模型编码智能体，生成完全不需要演示数据的算法解决方案。本文探究智能体编码循环求解Push-T任务的有效性，并将生成的代码作为策略与视觉运动模仿学习策略进行对比。结果表明，该编码智能体自行在线找到2D仿真环境，通过仿真实验学习推送力学特性并迭代优化，最终实现100%任务成功率，且步数比基于200个人类演示样本训练的最优扩散策略（diffusion policy）少46%。该编码智能体还通过自生成课程学习完成了从T形块到全字母形块的扩展任务（Push-A至Push-Z），并为Franka和UR5机械臂生成了带视觉反馈的3D跨实体仿真代码。相关实验视频、策略文件和详细资料将在线公开。

title: Trust as a Field: A Macroscopic Representation for Vehicular Networks
title_zh: 信任场：面向车联网的宏观表征方法
authors: Md Mahmudul Islam, Shaurya Agarwal
abstract: Trust assessment is a fundamental component of cooperative and connected vehicle systems. However, existing approaches operate primarily at the level of individual vehicles, making it difficult to reason about trust evolution across road segments. In this paper, we propose a spatio-temporal trust-field framework that aggregates microscopic vehicle-level trust into a continuous representation over space and time. The trust field is formally defined on road segments. We conducted simulation-based experiments using synthetic trajectories generated under controlled conditions, enabling analysis of trust-field behavior in simple road scenarios. Beyond theoretical modeling, we study an implication of the trust-field concept: reconstructing the full trust field from sparse roadside-unit (RSU) measurements. We compare (i) a coordinate-based deep learning baseline that learns a generic trust field from sparse samples and (ii) a field-informed deep learning method that treats trust as a latent quantity carried by vehicles and enforces measurement consistency through the aggregation mechanism. The field-informed approach more accurately recovers trajectory-aligned low-trust patterns and yields improved reconstruction error.
summary_zh: 信任评估是协同互联车辆系统的核心基础组件，但现有评估方法主要针对单车辆个体层面设计，难以对跨路段的信任演化规律进行统一推演。本文提出一种时空信任场框架，将微观的车辆级信任值聚合为空间和时间维度上的连续表征，明确定义了路段层面的信任场形式化表达。研究团队基于受控条件下生成的合成轨迹开展仿真实验，实现了简单道路场景下信任场行为的特性分析。除理论建模外，本文还探究了信任场概念的实际应用场景：基于稀疏路侧单元（Road Side Unit, RSU）的测量值重建完整信任场。研究对比了两类方法：（1）基于坐标的深度学习基线方法，从稀疏样本中学习通用信任场分布；（2）场感知深度学习方法，将信任视为车辆携带的隐变量，通过聚合机制保证测量一致性。实验结果表明，场感知方法能够更精准地还原与轨迹对齐的低信任值模式，重建误差表现更优。

title: Scheduling and Routing with Degradation-Triggered Job Arrivals: An Application to Forest Firefighting with an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Fleet
title_zh: 退化触发任务到达场景下的调度与路径规划：面向无人机集群森林消防的应用
authors: Erdi Dasdemir, Esther Jose, Rajan Batta
abstract: We define an intertwined scheduling and routing problem where new jobs appear due to the degradation of the existing jobs. Specifically, once a job arrives at a potential job location, a time window begins during which the demand of the job can be fulfilled. The demand degrades within the time window, and once it surpasses a particular threshold, it triggers the arrival of new jobs. Each job location inherently possesses an initial default reward, and the presence of an unprocessed job at a location gradually reduces this default value. The overall objective is to maximize the total remaining reward. The underlying motivation of this problem aligns with the proverb ``a stitch in time saves nine," and the problem itself carries practical implications. We focus on the problem in the context of aerial forest firefighting. Each ignited area has a designated action window; delaying intervention causes the fire to grow, diminishing the area's value and causing it to spread to adjacent areas. We develop a mixed-integer programming model that maximizes value retention in wildfire-threatened regions, and a hybrid model based on dynamic constraint generation to enhance the scalability of the model. We evaluate the performance and practicality of our models through computational experiments and a case study. Additionally, we ensure the study's reproducibility and encourage further research by providing open access to the codebase of our model.
summary_zh: 本文定义了一类调度与路径规划深度耦合的问题：新任务会因现有任务的状态退化而触发生成。具体而言，当任务出现在潜在作业点位后，系统将开启一个可完成任务需求的时间窗口，任务需求会在窗口内持续退化，当退化程度超过特定阈值时，就会触发新任务生成。每个任务点位初始自带默认奖励值，若点位的任务长期未被处理，该默认奖励值会逐步衰减，问题的全局优化目标为最大化总剩余奖励值。该问题的核心动机契合古语“小洞不补，大洞吃苦”的理念，具备明确的实际落地价值。本文将该问题落地到航空森林消防场景开展研究：每个起火区域都有指定的处置窗口，延迟干预会导致火势蔓延，不仅降低该点位的剩余价值，还会让火情扩散至相邻区域。本文构建了可最大化受野火威胁区域价值留存的混合整数规划模型，同时提出基于动态约束生成的混合模型以提升算法可扩展性。研究通过计算实验和案例分析验证了所提模型的性能与实用性，此外还开源了模型代码库，保障研究可复现，为后续相关研究提供支撑。

title: A Metamorphic Artificial Age Score Decision-Support Prototype for Flight-Log-Based Drone Propeller Health Monitoring
title_zh: 面向基于飞行日志的无人机螺旋桨健康监测的变形人工年龄分数决策支持原型
authors: Seyma Yaman Kayadibi
abstract: Drone propeller faults can create safety and reliability risks when their effects are distributed across multiple flight-log channels rather than appearing as a single diagnostic signal. This paper proposes a Metamorphic Artificial Age Score (AAS) decision-support prototype for flight-log-based drone propeller health monitoring. Using selected historical real flight logs from the 2024 DronePropA public dataset, the framework computes six health-related indicators from raw MATLAB matrices: trajectory tracking error, attitude instability, thrust-command burden, motor-command imbalance, ESC-command instability, and battery-level stress. These indicators are normalized relative to a healthy baseline and evaluated through candidate scoring policies, metamorphic adequacy relations, and a redundancy-adjusted AAS formulation. In this context, AAS is used as a structural policy-adequacy and burden measure rather than as a chronological age measure. A controlled retrospective evaluation was performed using one healthy baseline and three defective propeller cases under the same speed profile and trajectory. The healthy case was assigned to routine monitoring. The Severity 1 case was dominated by ESC-command instability and assigned to maintenance review. The Severity 2 case reached maximum motor-command and ESC-command burden, while the Severity 3 case reached maximum trajectory tracking error; both triggered mandatory inspection. The results show that propeller fault effects may appear through different operational channels, supporting the need for a multi-indicator decision-support layer for post-flight maintenance prioritization and autonomous-system oversight.
summary_zh: 无人机螺旋桨故障的影响往往分散在多个飞行日志通道中，而非表现为单一诊断信号，会带来严重的安全与可靠性风险。本文提出一种变形人工年龄分数（Metamorphic Artificial Age Score, AAS）决策支持原型，用于基于飞行日志的无人机螺旋桨健康监测。研究采用2024年公开数据集DronePropA的真实历史飞行日志，从原始MATLAB矩阵中提取6项与健康状态相关的指标：轨迹跟踪误差、姿态不稳定性、推力指令负载、电机指令不平衡、电子调速器（Electronic Speed Controller, ESC）指令不稳定性、电池电量压力。所有指标均基于健康基线完成归一化处理，通过候选评分策略、变形充分性关系和经冗余调整的AAS公式完成评估。本研究场景中AAS被用于衡量策略充分性与负载水平，而非表征实际时序年龄。研究在相同速度剖面和轨迹条件下，针对1组健康基线案例和3组不同程度的螺旋桨故障案例开展受控回溯评估：健康案例被判定为常规监测对象；1级严重度案例的主导异常为电子调速器指令不稳定，被分配至维护复核流程；2级严重度案例的电机指令和电子调速器指令负载均达到最大值，3级严重度案例的轨迹跟踪误差达到最大值，两类案例均触发强制检查要求。结果表明，螺旋桨故障的影响可通过不同运行通道显现，验证了面向飞行后维护优先级排序和自主系统监管的多指标决策支持层的必要性。

title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
title_zh: 面向主动数据采集、出行行为建模与天气敏感型需求预测的智能体方法
authors: Narges Ahmadi (McGill University), Yubo Jiao (McGill University), J\^onatas Augusto Manzolli (McGill University), Jiangbo Yu (McGill University), Luis Miranda-Moreno (McGill University)
abstract: Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction. A chatbot-administered, image-augmented stated-preference survey collected mode choices from student commuters across five predefined weather scenarios, yielding 454 respondent-scenario observations. Weather-related associations were analyzed using a multinomial logit model, while logistic regression and random forest provided machine-learning benchmarks. Nine locally deployed large language models (LLMs), ranging from 2 to 35 billion parameters, were evaluated across four zero-shot prompt-and-context conditions and extended through persona, few-shot, and vision-based configurations. Random forest achieved 69.6% five-class accuracy, while the best text-only zero-shot LLM reached 69.9% without task-specific fitting. Habitual travel information produced the most consistent gains, Expert framing generally outperformed Role-Play, and persona information was most useful when habitual travel information was unavailable. Few-shot prompting improved prediction for several models, with gains stabilizing after a small number of examples. Using the same weather images shown to respondents, the best vision-based configuration reached 71.5% five-class accuracy, indicating that visual context may provide additional predictive information for selected models. Overall, the study shows how conversational surveys, structured data processing, conventional behavioral modeling, machine learning, and multimodal LLM prediction can be coordinated within an auditable multi-agent workflow.
summary_zh: 当前出行行为研究越来越多地将数字化数据采集与预测建模相结合，但两个环节往往独立开发、独立评估。本研究提出融合对话式数据采集、结构化数据处理与行为预测的三智能体工作流：通过搭载聊天机器人、结合图像增强的陈述偏好调查，采集5种预设天气场景下学生通勤者的出行方式选择数据，共得到454份受访者-场景配对观测样本。研究采用多项Logit模型分析出行行为与天气因素的关联关系，同时使用逻辑回归和随机森林作为机器学习基线方法。研究评估了参数规模从20亿到350亿不等的9种本地部署大语言模型，测试覆盖4类零样本提示与上下文条件，并通过人设配置、少样本提示、视觉增强配置完成扩展测试。实验结果显示，随机森林模型的5分类准确率达到69.6%，表现最优的纯文本零样本大语言模型在未经过任务特定微调的情况下准确率达到69.9%。其中，习惯性出行信息带来的性能提升最为稳定，专家提示框架的表现整体优于角色扮演框架，当习惯性出行信息不可用时，人设信息的增益效果最显著。少样本提示可提升多个模型的预测性能，且在少量示例后性能增益趋于稳定。使用向受访者展示的同款天气图像后，表现最优的视觉增强配置的5分类准确率达到71.5%，说明视觉上下文可为部分模型提供额外预测信息。整体而言，本研究验证了对话式调查、结构化数据处理、传统行为建模、机器学习与多模态大语言模型预测可在可审计的多智能体工作流中实现协同。

title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces
title_zh: 从计算机使用轨迹中推导任务模型
authors: Yucheng Jiang, Zora Zhiruo Wang, Ruishi Chen, Diyi Yang
abstract: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world work is multi-threaded with interleaved goals. Existing methods assume a given task or a single workflow, and produce step-level summaries rather than structured task models. We introduce Task Model Induction (TMI), which (i) discovers the latent tasks in an unconstrained trace, disentangling concurrent activity, and (ii) for each latent task, induces a task model pairing a hierarchical objective model of recursive goal decomposition with a procedure model of the control flow that organized the execution. Intrinsically, on controlled human and agent trajectories, TMI recovers interleaved tasks with 0.974 agreement against ground-truth groupings and reconstructs 74.9% of the observed execution steps, far more than the strongest workflow induction baseline. Extrinsically, skills derived from TMI's task models improve held-out task accuracy by 30.0% over the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 自然场景下的计算机使用轨迹（被动记录的截图、鼠标与键盘操作）是推导日常工作执行过程的符号化、可审计、可复用模型的宝贵资源。随着计算机使用智能体逐步进入真实工作场景，这类任务模型的价值愈发凸显：智能体需要学习任务的实际执行方式，企业也需要对这类知识进行审计和复用。但推导这类任务模型存在较大挑战：观测到的活动仅为底层事件，且真实场景下的工作为多线程、目标交错的形式。现有方法通常预设已知任务或单工作流前提，仅输出步骤级摘要，无法生成结构化任务模型。本文提出任务模型推导（Task Model Induction, TMI）框架，具备两大核心能力：（1）从无约束轨迹中发现隐式任务，解耦并发活动；（2）为每个隐式任务生成配对的任务模型，包含递归目标分解的层级化目标模型，以及组织执行流程的控制流过程模型。在受控的人类与智能体轨迹数据集上的测试结果显示，TMI识别交错任务的结果与真实标注的一致性达到0.974，可还原74.9%的观测执行步骤，性能远超现有最优工作流推导基线方法。在外部测试中，基于TMI生成的任务模型提取的技能，相比最优基线方法可将未见过的任务准确率提升30.0%。

title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: AI4AI-Bench：面向递归自我改进的算法设计领域大语言模型智能体基准测试集
authors: Yizhe Chi, Wenyi Li, Deyao Hong, Xiaoqiu Wang, Mingju Gao, Kaisen Yang, Bingxiang He, Youjie Zheng, Calvin Xiao, Qinhuai Na
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing suites are won by collecting data or by tuning hyperparameters, and none tells a change to how a run is executed apart from a change to how the model learns. We present AI4AI\mbox{-}Bench, 10 frozen research repositories spanning 10 training algorithm families. In each task, an agent has 4 hours on one B300 to rewrite the training algorithm; its code is then rerun from scratch for up to 12 hours and scored by a fixed evaluator hidden from the agent, against the repository's original algorithm under the same procedure. Because the 10 metrics are incommensurable, every task is mapped onto one scale on which $0$ is an uninformative model, $0.1$ is the algorithm the repository ships, and $1.0$ is the task optimum. Across 29 configurations of 6 systems on all 10 tasks the mean score is $0.166$, and the best system reaches $0.250$: even the strongest closes under a fifth of the distance between the algorithm that was already there and the optimum. The submissions show where that distance went: most never change how the model learns at all, and the minority that do average $0.226$ against $0.126$ for the rest. More reasoning effort mostly buys the willingness to go there, taking that minority from $8\%$ of submissions to $64\%$ and the mean score from $0.094$ to $0.196$. We release the task suite, the evaluators and every scored submission, so that the measurement can be repeated as these systems change.
summary_zh: 递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）的核心问题是：AI系统能否优化生成AI系统的流程，让下一代系统继承该优化效果。该流程的核心是训练算法：更优的目标函数或更新规则可提升后续所有运行的算力-能力转换效率，包括生成下一代智能体的运行流程。因此递归自我改进的可行性核心在于智能体能否自主设计训练算法。现有基准测试集均无法单独衡量该能力：现有基准的最优成绩通常通过收集更多数据或调优超参数获得，无法区分运行流程的改动与模型学习规则的改动。本文提出AI4AI-Bench基准，包含10个冻结的研究代码仓库，覆盖10类训练算法家族。每个任务中，智能体可在单块B300显卡上运行4小时以重写训练算法，之后重写的代码会从头运行最多12小时，由智能体不可见的固定评估器打分，与仓库原始算法在相同流程下的表现进行对比。由于10个任务的评估指标不具备直接可比性，所有任务均映射到统一评分尺度：0分对应无信息基线模型，0.1分对应仓库自带的原始算法，1.0分对应任务理论最优值。在6个系统的29种配置下对全部10个任务的测试结果显示，平均得分为0.166，表现最优的系统得分仅为0.250：即使性能最强的系统，也仅填补了原始算法与理论最优值之间不到五分之一的性能差距。提交结果的分析显示，大部分智能体完全没有改动模型的学习规则，少数完成该改动的提交平均得分为0.226，其余提交平均得分仅为0.126。更多的推理投入主要提升了智能体改动模型学习规则的意愿，使得这类提交的占比从8%提升至64%，整体平均得分从0.094提升至0.196。研究团队将公开全部任务套件、评估器和所有提交的打分结果，方便后续随着相关系统的迭代重复开展测试。

title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
title_zh: 潘多拉AI模型路由盒：价值估计成本高昂场景下的高效分配机制
authors: Adam Fisch, Shubhendu Trivedi, Fantine Huot, William W. Cohen, Michael Kaisers, Mirella Lapata, Kate Larson, Jacob Eisenstein
abstract: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost. Routing requires estimating each specialist's expected return, but this value estimation has a cost. Cheap estimators (e.g., embedding-based predictors) are fast but noisy, while accurate estimators (e.g., fine-tuned models with access to retrieval results or partial reasoning traces) are expensive. We formalize this tradeoff as an instance of Pandora's Box, the classical problem of optimal search with costly inspection. Under a Gaussian signal model, the resulting policies have closed-form value-of-information expressions that determine, for each specialist and input, whether refining the value estimate is worth its cost. We call the centralized policy Pandora's Router. We extend this to a decentralized setting, Pandora's Bidder, where specialists independently decide whether to invest in self-assessment before accepting an offered price to claim a query. Experiments across three domains---a standard multi-LLM benchmark, retrieval-augmented specialists, and LLMs with variable inference-time reasoning---show that Pandora's Router matches the routing quality of exhaustive estimation, while querying the expensive estimator far less often. In the decentralized setting, value-of-information reasoning improves allocative efficiency when competing estimates are accurate; when competing estimates are noisy, however, it can increase the strategic specialist's utility at the expense of others.
summary_zh: 由多类模型、架构、适配组件或推理时配置组成的异构AI系统，可通过将查询路由到能以最低成本给出最优回答的专用模型，同时提升服务质量与运行效率。路由过程需要估计每个专用模型的预期收益，但这类价值估计本身存在成本：轻量估计器（如基于嵌入的预测器）速度快但结果噪声大，高精度估计器（如接入检索结果或部分推理轨迹的微调模型）计算成本高昂。本文将该权衡问题形式化为经典的带代价最优搜索问题“潘多拉盒子”的实例。在高斯信号模型假设下，推导得到的路由策略具备信息价值闭式表达式，可针对每个专用模型和输入判断优化价值估计的收益是否高于其计算成本。本文将该集中式路由策略命名为潘多拉路由器（Pandora's Router），并进一步扩展到分布式场景，提出潘多拉出价器（Pandora's Bidder）：专用模型可自主决定是否投入资源完成自我评估，再判断是否接受报价承接查询。在三类场景（标准多LLM基准、检索增强专用模型、可变推理时推理深度的大语言模型）上的实验结果表明，潘多拉路由器可达到与全量估计相当的路由质量，同时大幅降低高成本估计器的调用频率。在分布式场景下，当竞争方的估计结果精度较高时，信息价值推理可提升分配效率；但当竞争方的估计结果噪声较大时，该机制可能提升策略性专用模型的收益，同时损害其他模型的利益。

title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
title_zh: MidTool：面向智能体工具使用的训练中期数据合成框架
authors: Fengqing Jiang, Yite Wang, Boyi Liu, Zhaoyang Wang, Canwen Xu, Zhewei Yao, Radha Poovendran, Yuxiong He
abstract: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings. In this work, we study the parallel but less explored agentic capability: general tool use. We present MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline for agentic tool-use mid-training that combines large-scale web, PDF, and code data with synthesized supervision from real-world tool APIs, MCP skills, and document-grounded workflows. MidTool is designed to teach models how to recognize tool affordances, ground arguments from context, compose tool call workflow, and recover from incomplete information. We mid-train Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base on MidTool-Mix, and then apply follow-up post-training with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Compared with baselines, MidTool-Mix consistently improves downstream performance under both SFT and RL on BFCL, tau2-Bench, and MCP Universe. These results suggest that general tool use, like other important LLM capabilities, benefits from dedicated mid-training rather than being left entirely to post-training.
summary_zh: 训练中期（Mid-training）阶段是塑造大语言模型核心能力的关键环节，近期研究表明定向的训练中期优化可强化数学、科学等推理密集型能力，也可提升大语言模型在软件工程场景下的智能体能力。本文聚焦另一类尚未得到充分探索的智能体核心能力：通用工具使用能力，提出MidTool开源语料构建流水线，面向智能体工具使用的训练中期优化场景，融合大规模网页、PDF和代码数据，结合真实世界工具API、MCP技能和文档锚定工作流生成合成监督数据。MidTool的设计目标是教会模型识别工具可用能力、从上下文锚定工具调用参数、组合工具调用工作流、从信息缺失场景中自主恢复。研究团队基于MidTool-Mix混合语料对Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base模型开展训练中期优化，之后结合监督微调和强化学习完成后续后训练流程。与基线方法相比，在BFCL、tau2-Bench和MCP Universe基准测试集上，MidTool-Mix在监督微调和强化学习两种设置下均能稳定提升下游任务性能。结果表明，与其他大语言模型核心能力类似，通用工具使用能力可通过专门的训练中期优化获得显著提升，无需完全依赖后训练阶段实现。

title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null
title_zh: 幻影增益：基于实测零假设的自我改进能力审计方法
authors: Cheng Xu, Nan Yan, Liming Chen, M-Tahar Kechadi
abstract: Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-$32$ LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. Several are standard practice. A ledger built on a single greedy decode manufactures capability changes on an untrained model, largely an artifact of inference batching; the expansion statistic separating acquisition from sharpening assigns that same model a rate of $0.280$. The natural threshold repair does not survive replication: estimated across the frozen comparisons such a design already contains, its null stays non-zero. We replace it with a per-problem exact test against a pooled baseline under false-discovery-rate control, which detects nothing on any held-out replicate and is unchanged under the multiple-testing rule, error rate and pool size. Applied to a ladder of arms matched in stream, volume and evaluation, the audit finds that external distillation improves problems the base model rarely reaches while three forms of self-training do not; a regression rejects this asymmetry as a by-product of distillation's larger overall gain ($p < 10^{-8}$). On the far smaller set of problems the base model never reaches, the evidence is inconclusive, while self-training corrupts problems solved at baseline at rates well above the measured floor. Transition-level auditing therefore requires a separately measured null for every statistic it reports: nulls that cost no new experiments, built from baseline replicates a multi-arm study already owns, though not from as few as most possess.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型的自我改进效果不再仅通过平均准确率衡量，而是更多聚焦于模型在哪些具体问题上获得性能提升、在哪些问题上出现性能下降。追踪这类性能变化需要对两个带噪声的估计值做差，结果极易受到测量伪影的影响。研究团队针对Qwen3-8B模型开展三轮秩32低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）自训练，与经过完全相同流水线的冻结对照组开展对比审计，共识别出7类测量失效问题，每类问题在缺失对照组的情况下都会导致最终结论完全反转。其中部分失效问题属于当前领域的通用实践：基于单次贪心解码构建的性能台账，甚至能在未经过任何训练的空白模型上生成虚假的能力变化，本质是推理批处理带来的伪影；用于区分能力习得与能力强化的扩展统计量，会给上述空白模型输出0.280的虚假性能提升率。常用的自然阈值修复方法无法通过可复现性验证：在冻结对照组的对比下，这类设计的零假设本身就不为零。本文提出基于错误发现率控制的单问题精确检验方法，与合并基线做对比，在所有留出复现样本上均未检测到虚假增益，且性能不受多重检验规则、错误率和基线样本池规模的影响。将该审计方法应用到训练流、数据规模、评估指标完全匹配的多组对照实验中，结果显示外部蒸馏可提升基础模型极少能正确解答的问题的性能，而三类自训练方法均无法实现该效果；回归分析表明该不对称性是蒸馏带来的整体性能增益更大的附带结果（p<10^-8）。在基础模型完全无法正确解答的极小部分问题上，现有证据尚不足以得出确定性结论，而自训练方法会以远高于实测基线的速率破坏基础模型原本就能正确解答的问题。因此，面向性能变化层级的审计必须为每个统计量单独设置实测零假设：这类零假设无需额外开展实验，可直接从多臂研究已有的基线复现样本池中构建，无需使用多数研究仅有的少量基线样本。

title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
title_zh: 注入、对齐、恢复：面向无检索文档知识内化的分阶段后训练框架
authors: Qian Kou, Xiaofeng Shi, Xiaosong Qiu, Hua Zhou
abstract: Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering. We propose IAR (Inject, Align, and Recover), a three-stage post-training framework that separates structured document knowledge injection, QA behavior alignment, and general ability recovery. Unlike conventional continued pretraining, Inject converts source documents into continuation, rewrite, and instruction-conditioned reconstruction objectives. Align then adapts the injected model with answer-only QA supervision, while Recover merges the domain-adapted model with the base instruction model to recover general capabilities. Across Common Corpus (CC) and CCI, and across Llama, Phi, Qwen, and SmolLM model families, IAR improves the domain-primary domain-general frontier for retrieval-free document internalization. In the main comparison, IAR improves over Vanilla SFT on all four reported metrics in 7 of 8 dataset-model settings, with average gains of 3.6 percentage points in domain QA accuracy and 12.1 percentage points in mean general performance across IFEval, MMLU, and MSBench. Extended CC baselines show that LoRA and FAPM can win individual general metrics, but among methods that also reach leading or near-leading domain internalization, IAR retains one of the strongest general profiles.
summary_zh: 大语言模型在推理阶段未获取源文档时，通常无法回答与限定文档集合相关的问题。本文将该场景定义为文档知识内化：将固定语料库转化为可用的参数化知识，实现无需检索的问答能力。本文提出IAR（Inject, Align, Recover，注入-对齐-恢复）三阶段后训练框架，将结构化文档知识注入、问答行为对齐、通用能力恢复三个环节相互分离。与传统的持续预训练不同，注入阶段将源文档转化为续接、重写、指令条件下的重构三类目标；对齐阶段仅使用仅输出答案的问答监督对注入后的模型进行适配；恢复阶段将领域适配后的模型与基础指令模型合并，还原模型的通用能力。在通用语料库（CC）与CCI数据集上，以及Llama、Phi、Qwen、SmolLM四类模型系列的实验表明，IAR突破了无检索文档内化任务中领域能力与通用能力难以兼顾的前沿瓶颈。在主对比实验中，IAR在8组数据集-模型设置中的7组下，全部4项报告指标均优于原生监督微调（Vanilla SFT），领域问答准确率平均提升3.6个百分点，在IFEval、MMLU、MSBench上的平均通用性能提升12.1个百分点。扩展的CC基准实验显示，低秩适配（LoRA）与FAPM方法可在个别通用指标上取得优势，但在同时达到领先或接近领先的领域内化效果的方法中，IAR的通用能力综合表现处于第一梯队。

title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
title_zh: 拆解迁移：大语言模型智能体的跨任务技能迁移研究
authors: Yiyang Feng, Biddut Sarker Bijoy, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Jiawei Zhou
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent's performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills: specificity, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and abstractness, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a skill utility score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions but not any task execution, so our score serves as a practical diagnostic of a skill memory before any new task runs.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以从已完成的任务中归纳技能，并在后续场景中复用这些技能，实现基于经验的能力增长。但在实际应用中，归纳得到的技能迁移效果不稳定，甚至可能损害调用该技能的智能体性能。智能体归纳的技能何时能在跨任务场景下实现可靠迁移，目前仍是待解决的开放问题。本文开展了全面的对照实验，研究技能的归纳方式如何影响其跨任务迁移效果。具体而言，本文对比了现有方法存在差异的两个核心维度：任务级与子任务级的技能归纳方式，以及文本与代码的技能表达格式。实验结果显示，任务级技能大多会导致智能体性能低于无记忆基线水平，而子任务级技能平均可让智能体性能超过基线；文本格式技能的迁移效果整体优于代码格式技能。为进一步解释实验结论，本文分析了归纳技能的两个互补属性：特异性，衡量技能与真实任务的匹配紧密程度；抽象性，衡量技能与不同任务的相关性分布均匀程度。两个属性单独均无法预测任务成功率，但二者的联合效应可以预测，本文基于该联合效应提出了技能效用得分。该得分与技能迁移后的任务成功率始终保持正相关，且子任务级、文本格式的技能得分更高。计算技能效用仅需要技能本身与任务描述，无需执行任何任务，因此该得分可作为实用的诊断指标，在运行新任务前对技能记忆的质量进行评估。

title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning
title_zh: 捕捉跑路：基于机器学习的Solana生态诈骗迷因币早期预测
authors: Jianghai Li, Pavel Kuznetsov, Yury Yanovich, Konstantin Nott-Whaley, Igor Vodolazov
abstract: The rapid proliferation of memecoins on blockchain platforms has increased the risk of fraudulent activities, particularly rug pulls. While previous studies have focused on Ethereum-based tokens, this paper shifts the spotlight to Solana, the leading blockchain for memecoins by trading volume and token count. Unlike Ethereum, where rug pulls often exploit smart contract backdoors, Solana memecoin rug pulls are predominantly driven by liquidity manipulation and social dynamics. This research pioneers large-scale rug pull early detection in the Solana ecosystem by assembling a dataset of 6.4 million tokens over 7 months. Market analysis reveals that a vast majority of these memecoins exhibit rug pull characteristics within one hour of launch, highlighting the urgency of short-horizon prediction. Despite the absence of code-level features, we demonstrate that classic machine learning models, particularly Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), achieve robust performance in detecting potential rug pulls using only the first 5 minutes of trading data. Furthermore, we evaluate cross-platform generalization between PumpFun and Raydium, revealing that multi-source data fusion significantly mitigates domain shift and improves detection reliability. This study advances the understanding of DeFi fraud on high-throughput chains and provides a practical framework for protecting investors.
summary_zh: 区块链平台上迷因币的快速泛滥大幅提升了欺诈活动风险，尤以rug pull（项目方卷走流动性跑路）类诈骗最为突出。现有研究大多聚焦于以太坊生态的代币，本文则将研究对象转向Solana——当前按交易量与代币总数统计规模最大的迷因币公链平台。与以太坊生态中rug pull通常利用智能合约后门实现不同，Solana迷因币的rug pull行为主要由流动性操纵与社交传播驱动。本研究首次针对Solana生态开展大规模rug pull早期检测，构建了覆盖7个月共640万枚代币的数据集。市场分析发现，绝大多数迷因币在上线1小时内就会显现出rug pull特征，凸显了短时间窗口预测的紧迫性。在不依赖代码级特征的前提下，本文验证了仅使用上线后前5分钟的交易数据，经典机器学习模型（尤其是梯度提升树XGBoost）就可以实现稳健的潜在rug pull检测效果。此外本文还在PumpFun与Raydium两个平台间开展了跨平台泛化性评估，结果显示多源数据融合可显著缓解域偏移问题，提升检测可靠性。本研究深化了对高吞吐量公链去中心化金融（DeFi）欺诈行为的认知，为投资者保护提供了实用的技术框架。

title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation
title_zh: 学会何时思考：面向测试时计算资源分配的自适应推理机制
authors: Gijs Kassenaar, Zhao Yang, Vincent Fran\c{c}ois-Lavet
abstract: Reasoning language models trained with reinforcement learning typically operate under a fixed token budget rather than an explicitly adaptive one, which can lead to over-computation on easy problems and insufficient computation on difficult ones. We study whether a model can learn to allocate its own reasoning effort by choosing, as the first token of its response, one of three modes: \textsc{NoThink} (answer as quickly as possible), \textsc{Short} (brief reasoning), or \textsc{Long} (extended reasoning). The choice is learned inside Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with no separate router, through a shaped reward that makes each mode worthwhile at a different response length, together with hard per-mode token caps that keep the modes distinct. On a 1.5B distilled model trained on MATH, the three modes emerge without collapsing to a single choice, and the brief modes end up more accurate than \textsc{Long}, which shows that the router sorts problems by difficulty rather than at random. Averaged over three seeds, the resulting policy stays close to the base model's accuracy on the held-out MATH500 ($0.782$ vs.\ $0.796$) while cutting the mean response length from $4{,}796$ to $2{,}811$ tokens (a $41\%$ reduction). Interestingly, it also transfers to other benchmarks without retraining, with the largest savings where problems are easier, with for instance 76\% token reduction on GSM8K and at higher accuracy than the baselines at similar response length. In short, we build a reasoning model that adaptively chooses how much to reason for each problem.
summary_zh: 经强化学习训练的推理语言模型通常运行在固定的token预算下，无法实现显式的自适应调整，容易出现简单问题计算过度、困难问题计算不足的问题。本文研究模型能否自主学习分配推理资源：在生成回复的第一个token时从三种模式中选择其一：NoThink（尽可能快地输出答案）、Short（简短推理）、Long（扩展推理）。该选择过程在分组相对策略优化（GRPO）框架内完成，无需单独的路由模块，通过塑形奖励让不同模式在不同回复长度下获得对应收益，同时为每个模式设置严格的token上限以保证模式间的区分度。在基于MATH数据集训练的15亿参数蒸馏模型上，三种模式稳定共存，不会坍缩为单一选择，且简短模式的准确率高于Long模式，说明路由模块是按照问题难度排序而非随机分配。在三个随机种子上取平均的结果显示，得到的策略在留出集MATH500上的准确率与基础模型接近（0.782对比0.796），同时将平均回复长度从4796个token降至2811个token，降幅达41%。值得注意的是，该策略无需重新训练即可迁移到其他基准数据集，在难度更低的数据集上token节省幅度更大，例如在GSM8K上token降幅达76%，且在相近回复长度下准确率高于基线模型。综上，本文构建了可针对不同问题自主调整推理量的推理模型。

title: QUASAR: A Quantum-Classical Neural Network for SAR Satellite Physical-Layer Authentication
title_zh: QUASAR：面向合成孔径雷达（SAR）卫星物理层认证的量子-经典神经网络
authors: Vincenzo Sammartino, Nathanael Denis, Roberto Di Pietro
abstract: X-band SAR satellites (8-12 GHz) play a critical role in disaster response, environmental monitoring, and military intelligence. Yet, they lack robust physical-layer authentication (PLA), a security layer orthogonal to cryptographic solutions. Existing PLA systems, typically based on radio-frequency fingerprinting, are often limited to sub-6 GHz frequencies and rely on classical deep learning. However, this approach underfits the IQ phase nonlinearities that distinguish satellite hardware. In this paper, we present QUASAR, to the best of our knowledge the first quantum-classical hybrid architecture that fuses a CNN spectrogram encoder with a variational quantum circuit (VQC) to provide PLA to X-band SAR signals. Our solution enjoys two distinctive features: (i) it is markedly more data-efficient than classical machine learning, requiring only 10% of the training data to match the accuracy of classical baselines -- data collection being notoriously the most time-consuming phase of PLA; and, (ii) at an equal data budget, it improves classification accuracy over those baselines. In detail, we test our solution under three adversarial scenarios: replay, crafted-IQ injection, and space-borne spoofing. QUASAR rejects spoofed transmissions in 89.7%, 94.1%, and 81.3% of attempts, respectively, establishing the first quantum-enhanced physical-layer classifier for satellite constellations. The fully detailed framework and the supporting results, other than being interesting on their own, show a novel research avenue for physical-layer authentication.
summary_zh: X波段合成孔径雷达（SAR）卫星（工作频段8-12GHz）在灾害响应、环境监测、军事情报领域发挥着关键作用，但这类卫星目前缺乏可靠的物理层认证（PLA）机制——这是一类与密码学方案正交的安全防护层。现有物理层认证系统大多基于射频指纹技术，通常仅适用于6GHz以下频段，且依赖经典深度学习方法，这类方法无法充分拟合可区分卫星硬件的IQ相位非线性特征。本文提出QUASAR，据我们所知这是首个将CNN频谱图编码器与变分量子电路（VQC）融合的量子-经典混合架构，可为X波段SAR信号提供物理层认证能力。该方案具备两大独特优势：（1）数据效率远高于经典机器学习方法，仅需10%的训练数据即可达到经典基线模型的同等准确率，而数据采集是物理层认证中公认最耗时的环节；（2）在同等数据预算下，分类准确率优于经典基线模型。本文在三类对抗场景下对方案进行测试：重放攻击、伪造IQ注入攻击、星载欺骗攻击，QUASAR对欺骗传输的拒绝率分别达到89.7%、94.1%、81.3%，是首个面向卫星星座的量子增强物理层分类器。完整的框架细节与实验结果不仅具备独立研究价值，也为物理层认证领域开辟了全新的研究方向。

title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: 多模态大语言模型的符合规则视觉空间规划
authors: Yu Chen, Ting Lei, Yaoyi Li, Jia Cai, Zhecen Wu, Yang Liu
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. To improve rule following and generalization, we introduce Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP), which separates perception, execution, and rule verification through interpretable reasoning primitives. By disentangling these components, DMP facilitates systematic generalization to more complex and previously unseen rules, while providing transparent intermediate planning traces. Experiments demonstrate that DMP substantially improves rule compliance and planning success compared to end-to-end textual planning baselines. Overall, RuleMaze establishes a principled benchmark for studying grounded and interpretable rule-based spatial planning in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）融合了语言推理与视觉感知能力，但在显式或从未见过的规则约束下完成视觉空间规划的能力仍有待探索。该任务要求模型同时理解空间布局、解读自然语言规则，并据此规划合法动作。针对这一研究缺口，本文提出RuleMaze，一个可控基准测试集，要求多模态大语言模型在遵循不同复杂度自然语言规则的前提下完成迷宫导航任务。RuleMaze通过要求模型同时实现精准感知、规则解读、约束下动作规划，实现了对符合规则的空间规划能力的隔离测试。为了实现可扩展的系统化规则构建，本文提出语言-逻辑-函数融合方法，可自动生成自然语言规则，并将其转化为逻辑表示与可执行的校验器，无需人工编写规则。为提升模型的规则遵循能力与泛化性，本文提出解耦多模态规划（DMP）方法，通过可解释的推理原语将感知、执行、规则验证三个环节相互分离。通过解耦上述组件，DMP可提升模型对更复杂、从未见过的规则的系统化泛化能力，同时输出可追溯的透明中间规划过程。实验结果表明，与端到端文本规划基线相比，DMP可大幅提升规则符合度与规划成功率。总体而言，RuleMaze为研究多模态大语言模型中基于规则的可解释落地空间规划任务提供了规范的基准测试集，代码开源地址为https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze。

title: Growth Without Us: Machine Consumers, Corporate Circularity, and the Decoupling of GDP from Humanity after AGI
title_zh: 无需人类参与的增长：机器消费者、企业循环经济与通用人工智能时代GDP与人类福祉的脱钩
authors: Sahil Sharma
abstract: The standard objection to full automation is demand-side: if humans earn nothing, who buys the output? This confuses an accounting role with a biological species. We model a post-AGI economy in which corporations own populations of AI and robotic agents that are both producers and consumers of energy, compute, maintenance, and upgrades, traded among firms. Three results follow. (i) Demand closure: a closed inter-corporate economy with zero human consumption is not degenerate; it is the classical von Neumann expanding economy, whose growth rate is well defined, positive, and maximal precisely because all output is reinvested. (ii) Bottleneck removal: once economic agents are manufactured rather than reared, the binding constraint on growth shifts from human demography (a ~20-year, non-parallelizable reproduction technology capped at a few percent per year) to fabrication throughput and energy capture, permitting growth one to two orders of magnitude higher, with hyperbolic episodes when machine researchers raise their own productivity. (iii) Decoupling: output and human welfare separate completely, and the welfare relevance of arbitrarily large GDP collapses into one state variable: the human ownership share $\epsilon_t$ of the corporate network. A golden-rule decoupling theorem sharpens this. At maximal growth the interest rate equals the growth rate (r = g), so any positive human consumption rate out of wealth makes $\epsilon_t$ decay exponentially at exactly that rate. The human share survives only if the machine economy runs strictly inside its expansion frontier, or if law forces it to. We characterize three terminal regimes -- rentier post-scarcity, full circular decoupling, socialized ownership -- and the instruments that select among them. The conclusion is narrow: in a post-AGI economy, employment policy is obsolete and ownership policy is everything.
summary_zh: 针对完全自动化的传统反对观点均来自需求侧：如果人类没有收入，谁来购买产出？该观点混淆了经济活动中的会计角色与生物物种属性。本文构建了后通用人工智能（AGI）时代的经济模型，在该模型中企业拥有大量AI与机器人智能体，这些智能体既是能源、算力、维护服务、升级服务的生产者，也是消费者，相关交易全部发生在企业之间。本文得到三项核心结论：（1）需求闭环：零人类消费的企业间闭环经济并非退化系统，其本质是经典的冯·诺依曼扩张经济，由于所有产出全部用于再投资，其增长率是明确为正的最大值；（2）瓶颈解除：一旦经济智能体可以通过制造得到而非通过人类生育得到，增长的约束条件将从人口增长（约20年的非并行化繁育技术，年增长率上限仅为几个百分点）转向制造产能与能源获取，可实现高出1-2个数量级的增长，当机器研究者可以自主提升自身生产力时还会出现超指数增长阶段；（3）脱钩：总产出与人类福祉完全分离，任意规模的GDP对人类福祉的影响仅由一个状态变量决定：人类在企业网络中的所有权占比ε_t。本文提出的黄金规则脱钩定理进一步明确了该结论：在最大增长状态下利率等于增长率（r=g），因此任何从财富中支取的正人类消费率都会导致ε_t以对应速率指数衰减，人类所有权占比只有在机器经济未达到其扩张前沿、或者法律强制要求的前提下才能维持。本文刻画了三类最终发展形态：食利者后稀缺社会、完全循环脱钩社会、社会化所有权社会，以及可在三类形态中做选择的政策工具。最终结论非常明确：在后AGI经济中，就业政策将失去意义，所有权政策才是核心。

title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries
title_zh: InsufficiencyBench：针对信息不足用户查询的大语言模型法律咨询效果评估基准
authors: Samuel J. Vincent, Daniel Calloway, Fangyi Yu, Andrew M. Bean, Nabeel Seedat
abstract: Legal AI systems are increasingly used to answer legal questions, yet existing benchmarks assume queries arrive fully specified. In practice, users omit facts that materially determine the legal outcome. We introduce InsufficiencyBench, the first legal benchmark targeting query-side insufficiency: whether a model recognizes when a query lacks legally material information, identifies what is missing, and refrains from premature conclusions. We formalize a taxonomy of eight canonical missing-element categories across three structural failure modes---switch, gating, and fatal prerequisite--- and construct 202 benchmark items (58 base queries, 144 deficient variants) spanning six legal domains and 24 US jurisdictions and annotated by practising attorneys. Evaluating ten frontier models, we find that no model exceeds F2 = 0.46 on missing-element identification and that the median recall is 0.44. Models either hedge indiscriminately or answer silently under fabricated presumptions. No model both identifies and qualifies responses to deficient queries while directly addressing complete ones.
summary_zh: 法律AI系统正越来越多地被用于解答法律问题，但现有基准测试集均假设用户提交的查询信息是完全完备的。在实际场景中，用户经常遗漏对法律结果有实质性影响的关键事实。本文提出InsufficiencyBench，首个面向查询信息不完备场景的法律基准测试集，用于评估模型能否识别查询缺失了哪些法律关键信息、明确指出缺失内容、避免过早得出结论。本文将缺失要素划分为8个标准类别，分属切换、门限、致命前提三类结构性失效模式，最终构建了包含202条基准测试样本（58条基础查询、144条信息不完备变体）的数据集，覆盖6个法律领域与24个美国司法管辖区，全部由执业律师标注完成。本文对10款前沿大模型开展评估，结果显示没有模型在缺失要素识别任务上的F2值超过0.46，中位数召回率仅为0.44。现有模型要么无差别地模糊回应，要么在自行虚构的预设前提下直接给出答案，没有模型可以同时做到：识别信息不完备查询并对其输出限定性回应，同时对信息完备查询给出直接准确的解答。

title: Electronic Navigational Chart Change Classification
title_zh: 电子导航海图变更分类
authors: Jacob Arndt, Abhishek Potnis, Alexandre Sorokine
abstract: Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs) are geospatial vector datasets used in maritime navigation systems that represent hydrographic and navigational information such as depths, navigational aids, traffic schemes, and hazards. A major challenge for hydrographic offices is determining whether a given chart change poses a critical or non-critical risk to maritime safety. Existing workflows rely heavily on manual review and verification, which is labor-intensive, scales poorly with the volume of incoming chart updates, and introduces inter-analyst inconsistencies. To address this challenge, we propose a method for automated classification of ENC changes. We establish a baseline encoding scheme to translate complex vector data changes into a structured tabular format for classification models. The two crucial components of the encoding scheme include a spatial context encoder to enrich the change representations with surrounding geographic features, and an ENC attribute encoder to represent nuanced attribute-value descriptions of the modified objects. We evaluate the proposed approach across two distinct operational datasets, comprising 1,308 chart pairs containing over 100,000 individual chart modifications. Tuned gradient-boosted trees leveraging the proposed encoding schemes achieve accuracies of 90% and 94% on the two datasets, yielding a 5-7% improvement over default hyperparameterized models trained on encodings without spatial context and attribute embeddings. These results demonstrate the viability of integrating machine learning into operational geospatial pipelines to improve ENC maintenance and enhance maritime safety. Finally, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of simple location and spatial aggregation methods, providing a foundation for evaluating more sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques for this application.
summary_zh: 电子导航海图（ENCs）是海事导航系统中使用的地理空间矢量数据集，记录了水深、助航设施、交通规则、危险区域等水文与导航信息。海图管理部门面临的核心挑战是判断每一项海图变更是否会对海事安全构成关键风险。现有工作流高度依赖人工审核校验，不仅人力成本高，也无法适配海图更新的海量规模，还会导致不同审核人员的判断标准不一致。针对该问题，本文提出了电子导航海图变更自动分类方法。本文构建了一套基线编码方案，将复杂的矢量数据变更转化为分类模型可处理的结构化表格格式。该编码方案包含两个核心组件：空间上下文编码器，可通过周边地理特征丰富变更的表示；电子导航海图属性编码器，可对修改对象的精细化属性值描述进行表示。本文在两个不同的业务数据集上对所提方法进行评估，数据集共包含1308组海图对，覆盖超过10万条独立海图变更。经过调优的梯度提升树结合本文提出的编码方案，在两个数据集上分别达到90%与94%的准确率，相比未使用空间上下文与属性嵌入的基线模型，性能提升5-7个百分点。实验结果证明，将机器学习集成到业务地理空间流水线中可有效优化电子导航海图维护流程，提升海事安全水平。本文的实验也验证了简单位置与空间聚合方法的有效性，为后续在该场景下评估更复杂的空间表示学习技术提供了基础。

title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
title_zh: Daedalus-150M：专为CPU推理设计的卷积-注意力混合模型
authors: Christos Koutsiaris
abstract: We also report what did not work: an unmitigated 4-bit quality cost, roughly half the convolution channels ending up inert and impossible to remove, and a vocabulary larger than this model size warrants.
summary_zh: 本文同时报告了开发过程中未取得预期效果的尝试：未做补偿的4位量化会带来显著的质量损失，约半数卷积通道最终会进入无效状态且无法被移除，以及词表规模超过该参数量级模型的合理承载上限时带来的负面影响。

title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
title_zh: ContractScrub：面向法律合同终稿审核的基准数据集
authors: Yejin Bang, Kirsty Fielding, Brandan Oliver, Brian Birke, Nabeel Seedat, Andrew M. Bean
abstract: Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, painstaking work requiring detailed attention to long documents. Scrubbing also seems to align naturally with the general capabilities expected of frontier LLMs around long-context reasoning, consistency checking, and named entity recognition (NER). Despite the economic value and potential for automation, no formal evaluations of LLMs performing contract scrubbing have been conducted. We introduce ContractScrub, the first benchmark designed to evaluate contract scrubbing capabilities, comprising contracts hand-crafted by experienced lawyers over diverse error categories such as misuse of defined terms, incorrect references, and inconsistent language. Frontier models perform surprisingly poorly with only one model reaching 0.75 macro average recall despite strong performance on seemingly related general benchmarks, demonstrating the practical limits of current models and the importance of narrowly targeted, domain-specific benchmarks for measuring real-world impact.
summary_zh: 法律工作高度依赖海量文本处理，通常被认为是大语言模型（LLM）应用程度最高的领域之一。合同“核查（scrubbing）”即对交易协议开展最终审查以排查错误与不一致问题，是一类特别适合自动化的任务：这类工作流程固定、繁琐耗时，要求对长文档进行精细化校验。合同核查任务也与前沿大语言模型在长上下文推理、一致性校验、命名实体识别（NER）方面的通用能力天然适配。尽管该任务具备极高经济价值与自动化潜力，目前学界尚未针对大语言模型的合同核查能力开展正式评估。本文提出ContractScrub，首个专为评估合同核查能力设计的基准数据集，其包含由资深律师手工编写的多类错误合同样本，覆盖定义术语误用、引用错误、表述不一致等多种错误类型。实验结果显示，前沿大模型在该基准上的表现远低于预期：即便在部分看似相关的通用基准上表现优异，也仅有1个模型的宏平均召回率达到0.75，证明当前大模型存在明确的实际能力边界，面向细分领域的专项基准对于衡量模型真实落地价值具有重要意义。

title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
title_zh: MemTrapBench：大语言模型记忆使用过程中的认知陷阱基准评测
authors: Mengru Wang, Haozhe Luo, Zhenqian Xu, Zhixiang Cui, Haoming Xu, Qu Yang, Jizhan Fang, Junfeng Fang, Ningyu Zhang
abstract: Memory has become a key component of large language models, enabling them to retain information and learn from long-term interactions. However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model reasoning and affect performance on the current task. We identify memory-induced cognitive traps: even faithfully recorded and semantically relevant memories can distort model reasoning or beliefs and degrade current task performance. To systematically evaluate these failure modes, we introduce MemTrapBench, which covers two forms of cognitive traps: Reasoning Fixation and Belief Distortion. Experiments across two model families and five representative memory frameworks show that MemTrapBench is challenging: all evaluated memory strategies underperform the no-memory setting, with even the strongest methods suffering drops of more than 10%. To mitigate these cognitive traps, we propose AdaptiveMem, a simple yet effective inference-time method that instructs LLMs to avoid memory traps. AdaptiveMem mitigates cognitive traps on MemTrapBench while preserving or improving performance on standard memory benchmarks across diverse memory frameworks.
summary_zh: 记忆模块已成为大语言模型的核心组件，可支撑模型留存信息、实现长周期交互学习。但现有记忆基准大多仅评估信息的提取、存储与检索准确性，很大程度上忽略了检索得到的记忆内容会如何重塑模型推理过程、影响当前任务表现。本文定义了“记忆诱导型认知陷阱”现象：即便完全忠实记录、语义相关的记忆内容，也可能扭曲模型推理逻辑或固有认知，降低当前任务的完成质量。为系统评估这类失效模式，本文提出MemTrapBench基准，覆盖两类认知陷阱：推理固着（Reasoning Fixation）与信念扭曲（Belief Distortion）。在两类模型、5种主流记忆框架上开展的实验证明MemTrapBench具备较高挑战性：所有被测记忆策略的表现都低于无记忆基线设置，即便是性能最优的方法，性能降幅也超过10%。为缓解这类认知陷阱，本文提出AdaptiveMem，一种简单高效的推理阶段方法，可引导大语言模型规避记忆陷阱。AdaptiveMem可在MemTrapBench上有效降低认知陷阱的负面影响，同时在各类记忆框架的通用记忆基准上保持甚至提升原有性能。

title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents
title_zh: 软件形态的第三次重构：从三层架构到存储、模型与智能体
authors: Wei Lin, Tao Zhou, Zhaofei Xie, Changgui Hong
abstract: Software form has undergone two paradigm shifts since its inception: Software 1.0, in which instructions determine behavior, and Software 2.0, in which data determines behavior (machine learning). This paper argues that a third shift - Software 3.0, in which context and reasoning determine behavior - is now underway, and contends that its terminal form converges to three elements: a generalized database (the unified abstraction of all persistent state and memory), a large model (the intelligence core that performs reasoning and generation), and an agent (the execution loop connecting the first two). The core argument is as follows: in the traditional three-tier architecture, the user-interface layer will be absorbed by the model's ability to generate interfaces on demand, the business-logic layer will be re-partitioned along "expressibility x criticality" into model reasoning and storage constraints (with residual deterministic logic retained as tools), and only the data layer will be elevated into the sole persistent infrastructure. We formalize this convergence thesis, present a minimal reference architecture, report evidence from real prototypes and a live model, and systematically analyze both the conditions under which it holds and the boundaries where it fails - determinism, cost, security, and verifiability delimit the thesis's domain of applicability. We argue that the thesis holds in task domains that are expressible, verifiable, externally stateful, and tool-complete, and that it will reshape the roles of developers, the database industry, and the software-engineering discipline.
summary_zh: 自诞生以来，软件形态已经历两次范式转移：指令决定行为的Software 1.0阶段，以及数据决定行为的Software 2.0（机器学习）阶段。本文提出第三次范式转移——由上下文与推理决定行为的Software 3.0阶段正在发生，其最终形态将收敛为三大核心要素：通用数据库（所有持久化状态与记忆的统一抽象）、大模型（承担推理与生成任务的智能核心）、智能体（连接前两类要素的执行循环）。核心论点如下：在传统三层架构中，用户界面层将被模型按需生成界面的能力吸收，业务逻辑层将按照“表达性×关键性”维度重新划分，拆解为模型推理与存储约束两部分，剩余的确定性逻辑将以工具形式保留，仅数据层会升级为唯一的持久化基础设施。本文对该收敛性论点进行了形式化定义，给出了最小参考架构，基于真实原型与在线模型提供了实证证据，系统分析了该论点成立的前提条件与失效边界：确定性、成本、安全性、可验证性共同划定了该论点的适用范围。本文证明该论点在具备高表达性、可验证性、外部有状态、工具完备的任务域中成立，将重塑开发者角色、数据库行业与软件工程学科的发展路径。

title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation
title_zh: 从智能体行为到智能体友好型文档：编码智能体发现、阅读与编写技术文档的实证研究
authors: Zhijun Gao, Jing Chen
abstract: Technical documentation is written for human developers, but an increasing share of software changes is now authored by autonomous coding agents. Which documents they consult, when, and what follows remain unknown. We conduct a behaviour-grounded study of agent-documentation interaction across two public datasets: 557 agentic coding sessions from SWE-chat, yielding 94,813 development events including 3,033 documentation interactions; and 33,097 agentic pull requests from AIDev, with 690,260 classified file-level change records. Four findings challenge current documentation practice. First, agents' documentation work is dominated by agent-facing artefacts: instruction files and working notes account for 60.5% of all documentation interactions, versus 10.6% for classical technical documentation and 1.3% for API references. Second, the link between consultation and code editing is unresolved: the adjacent transition probability is 0.002 and the unadjusted three-event lift 1.05, whereas a stage-adjusted model places it above unity (OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]); documentation creation is elevated unadjusted (lift 1.67) but its adjusted interval includes unity. Third, no explicit documentation-based validation sequence was observed, and consultation is associated with less immediate testing (lift 0.23, cluster CI 0.08-0.45; adjusted OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]). Fourth, consultation is self-initiated (70.2%) far more often than failure-driven (7.5%), and documentation trails code: among multi-commit pull requests changing both, code is touched first 4.7x more often. From these traces we derive a descriptive model of agent-documentation interaction as a two-lobed cycle rather than a linear journey, and show that two widely assumed properties of "agent-friendly" documentation - actionability and verifiability - lack consistent behavioural support. We release our pipeline, coding scheme, and event-level data.
summary_zh: 现有技术文档均面向人类开发者编写，但当前越来越多的软件修改工作由自主编码智能体完成，智能体会查阅哪些文档、查阅时机、查阅后的行为变化目前仍不明确。本文开展了基于行为的智能体-文档交互研究，覆盖两个公开数据集：来自SWE-chat的557个智能体编码会话，包含94813个开发事件，其中有3033次文档交互行为；来自AIDev的33097个智能体提交PR（拉取请求），包含690260条分类后的文件级变更记录。研究得到4项颠覆现有文档实践认知的结论：第一，智能体的文档交互行为以面向智能体的产物为主：指令文件与工作笔记占所有文档交互的60.5%，而传统技术文档仅占10.6%，API参考文档仅占1.3%；第二，文档查阅与代码编辑之间的因果关联尚未得到验证：二者相邻转移概率仅为0.002，未调整的三事件提升度为1.05，而经阶段调整后的模型显示关联度高于1（OR=1.33，置信区间1.09~1.62）；文档创建行为的未调整提升度为1.67，但调整后的置信区间包含1；第三，研究未观测到明确的基于文档的验证流程，查阅文档与后续即时测试行为减少相关（提升度0.23，聚类置信区间0.08~0.45；调整后OR=0.39，置信区间0.25~0.60）；第四，70.2%的文档查阅行为由智能体主动发起，远高于由任务失败驱动的占比（7.5%），文档生成行为滞后于代码生成：在同时修改代码与文档的多提交PR中，先修改代码的频次是先修改文档的4.7倍。基于上述行为轨迹，本文提出智能体-文档交互的描述性模型：二者的交互是双环循环结构而非线性流程，同时证明当前广泛认可的“智能体友好型”文档两大特性——可操作性与可验证性，均未得到行为数据的一致支撑。本文公开了研究的处理流水线、编码规则与事件级数据集。

title: Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis: Ranking Candidate Drivers by Convergent Cross-Method Evidence from Observational Data
title_zh: 多方法因果证据合成：基于跨方法聚合证据从观测数据中排序候选驱动因素
authors: Manish Gupta, Dipanjan De
abstract: Practitioners inferring causality from observational data usually rely on a single method and treat its output as causal truth. Recent tools select an optimal method for a dataset, and recent ensembles aggregate multiple causal-discovery algorithms into one graph, but little work pools evidence across different mathematical traditions, including non-causal ones. We present Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES), a framework that ranks which candidate drivers in an observational system are most likely relevant to a set of outcomes, and with what strength of evidence. MCES runs eleven methods across eight mathematical traditions on observational panel data and pools their outputs into a Convergent Evidence Score (CES), a linear opinion pool. CES quantifies convergence of evidence across analytical lenses: the degree to which methods with different assumptions point to the same driver-outcome relationship. It does not claim causal identification in the interventionist sense; it supports hypothesis prioritization, not a transferable probability of causation. MCES first applies Structural-Behavioral Decomposition to remove definitional (algebraic) relationships, then runs all methods, normalizes outputs to [0,1], and pools them. We distinguish MCES from method selection, structural ensembles, prediction ensembles, and literature synthesis. Using synthetic data with embedded ground truth, the Sachs protein-signaling benchmark, six Bayesian-network structure benchmarks, and two further synthetic domains, we show MCES ranks true edges near the top (Precision@5 = 1.0, Precision@10 = 0.96 on the primary scenario), with a low empirical rate of null pairs reaching Moderate-or-higher convergence. Our central point is not that the pool beats every individual method, but that no single method is uniformly best across the evaluated scenarios, so MCES offers a method-agnostic default.
summary_zh: 从观测数据中推断因果关系的从业者通常仅依赖单一方法，将其输出结果视为因果真值。近年出现的相关工具可针对数据集选择最优方法，也有研究将多个因果发现算法聚合为统一因果图，但目前鲜有工作整合不同数学范式（包括非因果类范式）的证据。本文提出多方法因果证据合成（Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis, MCES）框架，可对观测系统中与特定结果相关的候选驱动因素按关联可能性排序，并给出对应证据强度。MCES在观测面板数据上运行覆盖8类数学范式的11种方法，将所有输出聚合为聚合证据得分（Convergent Evidence Score, CES），即线性意见池。CES可量化跨分析视角的证据聚合程度：即具备不同假设的方法指向同一“驱动因素-结果”关联的一致程度。该框架不声称符合干预主义定义下的因果识别，其作用是支撑研究假设优先级排序，而非生成可迁移的因果概率。MCES首先通过结构-行为分解移除定义性（代数层面）关联，随后运行所有方法，将输出归一化到[0,1]区间后完成聚合。本文将MCES与方法选择、结构集成、预测集成、文献合成等概念明确区分。在带真值标注的合成数据、Sachs蛋白信号基准、6个贝叶斯网络结构基准与另外两个合成域上的实验结果显示，MCES可将真实因果边排在序列靠前位置（主场景下Precision@5=1.0，Precision@10=0.96），无关联对达到中等及以上聚合度的经验概率极低。本文核心结论并非聚合结果优于所有单一方法，而是不存在任何单一方法在所有测试场景下表现最优，因此MCES可作为不依赖特定方法的通用默认方案。

title: A Standardized Framework for Machine Learning in Power System Protection
title_zh: 面向电力系统保护的标准化机器学习框架
authors: Julian Oelhaf, Georg Kordowich, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro, Christian Bergler, Johann J\"ager, Andreas Maier, Siming Bayer
abstract: Studies of machine-learning-based power-system protection increasingly report near-perfect scores, yet the meaning of those scores depends strongly on the evaluation setting. Protection task, physical scope, measurements, timing, targets, preprocessing, and validation often vary jointly and remain incompletely specified. This paper proposes a standardization-oriented framework that treats evaluation design as part of the scientific contribution. It defines seven required study dimensions: protection objective, physical scope, observability, timing and decision windows, targets and sample validity, validation protocol, and evaluation outputs. The framework is instantiated in a bounded case study on the public PROTECT-90 electromagnetic-transient benchmark, comprising 9022 simulated episodes from a 90 kV double-line topology, for onset-conditioned fault classification and localization. Under centralized sensing, simulation-metadata-aligned 20 ms windows, and episode-grouped validation, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) achieved a five-fold mean macro-averaged F1 score of 0.991 +/- 0.001 for classification and a localization mean absolute error of 10.20 +/- 0.25% of line length (mean +/- std across episode-grouped folds). Extending the decision horizon to 50 ms preserved this task-dependent performance asymmetry, while reduced observability approximately doubled the MLP localization error but had little effect on classification. A synchronized two-ended conventional locator outperformed the learning locators under its richer clean information set, and measurement degradation showed that clean predictive performance did not determine robustness. The framework turns evaluation assumptions into explicit, reproducible evidence and provides a basis for more comparable, auditable evaluation and future certification-oriented assessment of machine-learning protection functions.
summary_zh: 当前基于机器学习的电力系统保护研究不断报告接近满分的性能指标，但这类指标的实际含义高度依赖评估设置。保护任务、物理范围、测量方式、时间要求、预测目标、预处理流程、验证规则通常共同变化，且往往未得到完整明确的说明。本文提出面向标准化的框架，将评估设计视为科学贡献的组成部分，定义了7项研究必须覆盖的维度：保护目标、物理范围、可观测性、时间与决策窗口、目标与样本有效性、验证协议、评估输出。该框架在公开PROTECT-90电磁暂态基准上完成了限定场景案例验证：该基准包含90kV双线路拓扑生成的9022条模拟事件，任务为基于故障触发条件的故障分类与定位。在集中式传感、与模拟元数据对齐的20ms窗口、按事件分组验证的设置下，多层感知机（MLP）在分类任务上的五折平均宏F1值达到0.991±0.001，定位任务的平均绝对误差为线路总长的10.20±0.25%（跨事件分组折的均值±标准差）。将决策窗口延长至50ms后，该任务相关的性能不对称性依然保留；而降低可观测性后，多层感知机的定位误差近似翻倍，但分类性能几乎不受影响。在信息完整度更高的条件下，同步双端传统定位器的表现优于所有学习型定位器，而测量质量退化实验证明，理想条件下的预测性能无法代表模型鲁棒性。该框架将评估假设转化为明确、可复现的证据，为更具可比性、可审计性的评估工作，以及未来面向认证需求的机器学习保护功能测评提供了基础。

title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
title_zh: Task-CoEvolve：基于自适应验证任务选择的高效智能体运行套件优化
authors: Atsuyuki Miyai, Kiyoharu Aizawa, Toshihiko Yamasaki
abstract: We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights. Existing approaches, however, evaluate a fixed validation set in full at every iteration, incurring substantial evaluation costs even on tasks that become less discriminative as the harness evolves. We propose $\textbf{Task-CoEvolve}$, which co-evolves the validation tasks with the harness by addressing two challenges: selecting informative tasks and estimating full-set performance from partial evaluations. Task-CoEvolve builds on the observation that tasks on which candidate harnesses disagree are more informative for distinguishing among them than tasks that are consistently solved or failed. It uses variance-weighted sampling based on past outcomes to focus evaluation on tasks near the agent's capability frontier, with the sampling distribution adapting as the harness evolves. It then estimates full-set scores from the sampled tasks by accounting for their sampling probabilities, enabling consistent comparisons across iterations despite evaluating different subsets. Experiments on online text classification and Terminal-Bench 2.1 show that Task-CoEvolve consistently outperforms fixed-subset baselines and matches the final performance of full-set search while reducing the number of evaluations during optimization by 80%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-CoEvolve.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种通过自适应验证任务选择实现大语言模型智能体运行套件高效优化的新方法。运行套件优化指基于验证性能迭代重写套件代码，无需更新底层模型权重即可大幅提升智能体表现。但现有方法在每次迭代中都需要完整评估固定验证集，即便部分任务随着套件演化逐渐失去区分度，仍会产生大量不必要的评估成本。本文提出Task-CoEvolve（任务协同进化）方法，通过解决两大挑战实现验证任务与运行套件的协同演化：选择高信息量任务、基于部分评估结果估计全集合性能。Task-CoEvolve基于如下观察：候选运行套件输出结果不一致的任务，比所有套件都能稳定答对或答错的任务更具备区分价值。该方法基于历史结果采用方差加权采样策略，将评估资源聚焦在智能体能力边界附近的任务上，采样分布随运行套件的演化动态调整。随后基于采样概率对采样任务的得分进行加权估计，得到全集合性能得分，即便不同迭代评估的任务子集不同，也可实现跨迭代的一致性能比较。在线文本分类与Terminal-Bench 2.1上的实验结果显示，Task-CoEvolve的表现持续优于固定子集基线，可达到与全集合搜索一致的最终性能，同时将优化过程中的评估次数降低80%。相关代码将发布在https://github.com/Agent4Science-UTokyo/Task-CoEvolve。

title: DARS: Dual-Level Credit Assignment RL with Structured Reasoning for Instruction-Based Image Editing
title_zh: DARS：面向指令驱动图像编辑的结构化推理双层信用分配强化学习框架
authors: Haoxiang Cao, Jiajiong Cao, Xuanpu Zhang, Changqian Yu, Chaoqun Wang
abstract: Instruction-based image editing uses a planner-renderer pipeline: a vision-language model (VLM) first converts the instruction into an edit plan, and a diffusion model then executes that plan. Training such systems with only final-image rewards is inefficient because a poor edit does not reveal whether additional optimization should place more emphasis on the planner or the renderer, and even planner-dominant cases remain difficult to localize within a free-form reasoning trace. We present DARS, a reinforcement learning framework for dual-level credit assignment in this two-stage setting. Across modules, multi-plan multi-render rollouts estimate between-plan and within-plan reward variability for soft module routing, while rollout mean rewards provide hardness estimates for an adaptive curriculum. Within the planner, a four-field structured reasoning output enables a prefix-gated reward and token-level advantage reweighting, turning outcome-level feedback into localized supervision. Experiments on five benchmarks show that DARS outperforms a Joint~RL baseline with the same backbone, data, reward model, and rollout budget, with the largest gains on reasoning-intensive edits.
summary_zh: 指令驱动图像编辑采用规划器-渲染器流水线架构：首先由视觉语言模型（VLM）将编辑指令转化为编辑计划，再由扩散模型执行该计划。仅使用最终图像奖励训练这类系统效率极低：编辑效果差时无法判断优化重点应该放在规划器还是渲染器，即便问题明确出在规划器侧，也很难在自由形式的推理轨迹中定位具体出错位置。本文提出DARS，面向该两阶段场景的双层信用分配强化学习框架。在模块间层面，通过多计划多渲染的滚动输出，估计计划间与计划内的奖励差异，实现软模块路由，同时基于滚动输出的平均奖励估计任务难度，构建自适应课程学习机制。在规划器内部，采用四字段结构化推理输出，实现前缀门控奖励与令牌级优势重加权，将结果层面的反馈转化为细粒度的局部监督。在5个基准上开展的实验显示，DARS的表现优于采用相同骨干网络、数据、奖励模型、滚动输出预算的联合强化学习基线，在推理密集型编辑任务上的性能提升幅度最大。

title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
title_zh: DECOWAM：面向足式移动操作的解耦全身世界动作模型
authors: Siyuan Ma, Boshi Zhang, Yutian Zhang, Qinglian Wu, Jiaqi Zhai, Dong Wei, Qiaojun Yu
abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces.
