title: Evaluating Neural Cartographic Relief Shading for Urban Environments: A Downtown Calgary Study Using High-Resolution DEM and DSM Data
title_zh: 城市环境神经制图晕渲效果评估：基于高分辨率数字高程模型与数字表面模型数据的卡尔加里市中心研究
authors: Emmanuel Stefanakis
abstract: This article explores the performance of analytical and neural-based hillshading methods in a dense urban environment using high-resolution digital elevation model (DEM) and digital surface model (DSM) data for downtown Calgary. The study compares single-direction and multi-direction analytical hillshading with relief shading generated in Eduard, a machine-learning system originally developed to emulate Swiss-style shaded relief trained primarily on mountainous landscapes. Because Eduard was not designed for buildings, bridges, streets, trees, and other urban infrastructures, the central question is not whether it perfectly reproduces urban morphology, but whether parameter tuning can nevertheless produce visually strong, cartographically useful, and in some cases superior results when compared with conventional analytical methods. The analysis focuses especially on terrain type, micro and macro generalization, and flat-area detail parameters, while keeping the large-scale shading style constant throughout the neural experiments. The article is structured as an exploratory comparison rather than a benchmark of universal best practice. It aims to identify where analytical hillshading remains more reliable, where Eduard offers unexpected strengths, and where neural shading fails because of its training bias toward alpine terrain. The study contributes to current work on terrain representation by testing whether a neural approach designed for natural landforms can be adapted to a highly built urban setting, and it concludes by arguing for future model training and evaluation specifically targeted at urban relief shading.
summary_zh: 本文利用卡尔加里市中心的高分辨率数字高程模型（Digital Elevation Model, DEM）和数字表面模型（Digital Surface Model, DSM）数据，探究分析型晕渲方法与基于神经网络的晕渲方法在高密度城市环境下的表现。本研究对比了单方向、多方向分析型晕渲结果，与Eduard生成的地形晕渲效果——Eduard是一款最初为模拟瑞士风格晕渲开发、主要基于山地景观训练的机器学习系统。由于Eduard并非针对建筑、桥梁、街道、树木等城市基础设施设计，本研究的核心问题并非其能否完美复现城市形态，而是经过参数调优后，它是否能够生成视觉效果优异、符合制图规范、部分场景下甚至优于传统分析型方法的结果。分析过程重点关注地形类型、微观与宏观概括、平坦区域细节参数，所有神经实验过程中均保持大规模晕渲风格恒定。本文采用探索性对比结构，而非面向通用最优实践的基准测试，旨在明确分析型晕渲在哪些场景下表现更可靠、Eduard在哪些场景下具备意料之外的优势、以及神经晕渲因训练数据偏向山地地形的偏差会在哪些场景下失效。本研究通过测试专为自然地貌设计的神经方法能否适配高度建成的城市环境，为当前地形表征相关工作提供补充，最终结论提出未来需开发专门面向城市地形晕渲的模型训练与评估方案。

title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo
title_zh: 基于嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛的离散扩散模型推理时控制
authors: Lohithsai Yadala Chanchu, Hany Abdulsamad, Christian A. Naesseth
abstract: We study inference-time control for text generation in discrete diffusion language models, where the goal is to steer sampling toward sequence-level rewards without retraining. Prior work in this domain has focused on particle-based methods such as best-of-$n$ sampling and bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo, which may suffer from overoptimism and weight degeneracy, respectively. We address these limitations using \emph{nested} sequential Monte Carlo methods. We formulate nested SMC (NSMC) and fully-adapted nested SMC (FA-NSMC) for Feynman--Kac steering, identifying and correcting errors in prior formulations that lead to biased final estimates. We evaluate these methods on toxicity and fluency steering tasks, showing that NSMC and FA-NSMC consistently outperform best-of-$n$ and bootstrap SMC.
summary_zh: 本文研究离散扩散语言模型中文本生成的推理时控制技术，目标是在不重新训练模型的前提下，引导采样过程生成符合序列级奖励的结果。该领域此前的相关工作主要聚焦于基于粒子的方法，例如n选最优采样与引导序贯蒙特卡洛方法，二者分别存在过度乐观与权重退化的问题。本文采用嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛方法解决上述局限，针对费曼-卡茨引导场景构建了嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛（Nested SMC, NSMC）与全适配嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛（FA-NSMC）框架，修正了此前相关公式中会导致最终估计有偏的错误。我们在毒性控制与流畅度控制任务上对上述方法进行评估，结果显示NSMC与FA-NSMC的表现始终优于n选最优采样与引导序贯蒙特卡洛方法。

title: SAE-Xplainers: Rule-Based Feature Interpretation for Extreme Earth Events
title_zh: SAE-Xplainers：面向极端地球事件的基于规则的特征解释方法
authors: Hugo Porta, Emanuele Dalsasso, Chang Xu, Theo Gnassounou, Devis Tuia
abstract: The emergence of large-scale Weather and Climate (W&C) datasets offers new opportunities for modeling extreme Earth events (ExEE) and their impacts using deep learning. However, their adoption in operational settings remains limited by the lack of models' interpretability. While for conventional text and image modalities, tools such as Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have proven effective for extracting human-understandable concepts, their use for the analysis of ExEE remains challenging due to the nature of W&C data. To address this, we introduce (i) a geographic location-based modulation of the inputs of SAE to capture the local semantic meaning of environmental patterns, and (ii) an ensemble of rule-based SAE-Xplainers to interpret the resulting high-dimensional features derived from complex, multi-modal environmental predictors. We evaluate our method on three ExEE types: the prediction of fires, and the detection of tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers. We show that SAE input modulation improves both reconstruction performance and feature utilization, and that our SAE-Xplainers enable faithful interpretation of complex climatic patterns by unfolding them into human-understandable rules that are consistent with the scientific literature, while also supporting the identification of feature absorption.
summary_zh: 大规模天气与气候（W&C）数据集的出现为利用深度学习建模极端地球事件（ExEE）及其影响提供了新机遇，但由于模型可解释性不足，相关技术在业务场景中的落地仍受到较大限制。针对传统文本、图像模态，稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）等工具已被证实可有效提取人类可理解的概念，但受天气与气候数据的特性限制，将其用于极端地球事件分析仍存在诸多挑战。为解决该问题，本文提出两项创新：第一，基于地理位置对SAE的输入进行调制，以捕获环境模式的局部语义含义；第二，集成基于规则的SAE-Xplainers方法，用于解释从复杂多模态环境预测因子中提取的高维特征。我们在三类极端地球事件任务上对所提方法进行评估：火灾预测、热带气旋检测与大气河流检测。结果显示，SAE输入调制可同时提升模型的重构性能与特征利用率，本文提出的SAE-Xplainers可将复杂气候模式拆解为符合科学文献、人类可理解的规则，实现对复杂气候模式的忠实解释，同时支持特征吸收现象的识别。

title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
title_zh: 面向高效多智能体通信拓扑设计的奖励引导自回归图生成方法
authors: Poomphob Suwannapichat, Boonyarit Changaival, Caesar Wu, Pascal Bouvry
abstract: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）通过协调多个智能体在复杂推理任务上取得了优异表现，但代价是极高的token消耗。近期面向自动拓扑设计的相关工作ARG-Designer将该问题重构为自回归图生成任务，但其训练目标未向模型提供生成稀疏高效拓扑的显式激励。本文受人类反馈强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, RLHF）启发，提出奖励引导自回归图生成框架（Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation, RGA-Designer）以解决上述局限。我们训练了一个可同时捕获任务正确性与结构紧凑度的奖励模型，随后以该奖励模型作为反馈对预训练图生成器进行微调。所提方法可在保持与ARG-Designer相当的任务准确率的前提下，平均降低20.5%的token消耗。

title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
title_zh: 正交JEPA：面向潜态世界模型的分解预测状态
authors: Taoyong Cui, Pheng Ann Heng, Wanli Ouyang
abstract: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. Predictive regression preserves the factor magnitudes required for state synthesis, an orthogonality objective discourages repeated directions, factor-activity regularization maintains variation in projected targets, and online variance regularization discourages coordinate-wise encoder collapse. Predicted components are synthesized into a complete latent state that can be used by a readout, decoder, planner, or autoregressive rollout. The same predictive-state mechanism applies when the target is temporally future, spatially hidden, or another partial observation of the same system. Experiments on controlled vision, single-cell transcriptomics, longitudinal health records, continuous control, and molecular dynamics evaluate representation quality, forecasting, planning, and long-horizon stability.
summary_zh: 世界模型可构建支持预测、规划与推理底层系统特性的潜态表示。联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-embedding predictive architectures, JEPAs）无需重构观测的全部细节，直接在表示空间预测目标，为学习这类潜态表示提供了可行路径。但标准JEPA通过单一目标嵌入与单一预测通路组织所有可预测内容，在复杂系统中，这类整体状态会为优势信号分配冗余容量，同时为次要预测结构提供弱甚至冲突的梯度。本文提出Orthogonal JEPA这一潜态世界建模框架，基于正交预测分解范式构建：学习得到的基矩阵可将每个目标状态拆解为多个分量，专用预测分支从共享上下文表示中估计每个分量；预测回归保留状态合成所需的分量幅值，正交性目标避免分量方向重复，因子活性正则化维持投影目标的变异度，在线方差正则化避免坐标级编码器崩溃。预测得到的分量最终可合成为完整的潜态状态，供读出模块、解码器、规划器或自回归推演模块使用。该预测状态机制同样适用于目标为未来时序数据、空间隐藏数据或同一系统其他部分观测的场景。我们在受控视觉任务、单细胞转录组学、纵向健康记录、连续控制与分子动力学任务上开展实验，对所提方法的表示质量、预测能力、规划性能与长时程稳定性进行了评估。

title: DecoVAE: a Lightweight Interpretable Trend-Seasonal VAE Framework for Efficient Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: DecoVAE：面向高效概率时间序列预测的轻量可解释趋势-季节变分自编码器框架
authors: Alexander Marusov, Dmitry Anikin, Alexey Zaytsev
abstract: Probabilistic time series forecasting remains challenging, largely because modeling distinct trend and seasonal dynamics requires specialized approaches. Existing methods often fail to capture the unique inner properties of these components, lack interpretability, or suffer from heavy memory and runtime overhead. To address these limitations, we propose DecoVAE, a lightweight interpretable trend-seasonal VAE framework that explicitly decomposes time series into trend and seasonal components by applying domain-specific inductive biases. The trend stream enforces structural smoothness using a differential regularizer on the latent trajectory, analogous to the Hodrick-Prescott filter. Concurrently, the seasonal stream operates in the frequency domain via a complex Gaussian VAE, natively capturing the amplitude and phase of periodic patterns. Extensive evaluations across seven real-world benchmarks show that DecoVAE consistently outperforms strong baselines. It achieves reductions of up to 14.96\% in CRPS and 23.30\% in NMAE for short-term forecasting, and up to 52.68\% and 26.51\% for long-term horizons. Crucially, DecoVAE yields these accuracy gains while remaining highly efficient, reducing model weight by up to 93\% and accelerating speed by up to 74\% compared to the second-best method.
summary_zh: 概率时间序列预测仍存在较大挑战，核心原因在于对趋势与季节动态的差异化建模需要专用的技术方案。现有方法大多难以捕获两类分量的独特内在属性，可解释性不足，或存在内存占用高、运行时开销大的问题。为解决上述局限，本文提出DecoVAE，一款轻量可解释的趋势-季节变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder, VAE）框架，通过引入领域特定的归纳偏置，显式地将时间序列分解为趋势分量与季节分量。趋势流通过对潜态轨迹施加微分正则化实现结构平滑，其作用类似霍德里克-普雷斯科特滤波器；同时季节流通过复高斯VAE在频域运行，可原生捕获周期模式的振幅与相位。在7个真实世界基准数据集上的大量评估结果显示，DecoVAE的表现始终优于现有强基线方法：在短期预测场景下，连续排序概率得分（CRPS）最大降低14.96%，归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）最大降低23.30%；在长时程预测场景下，两项指标最大降幅分别可达52.68%与26.51%。尤为关键的是，DecoVAE在实现精度提升的同时保持了极高的运行效率，与次优方法相比，其模型参数量最大降低93%，运算速度最大提升74%。

title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
title_zh: 语言模型水印的跨语言公平性审计
authors: Alexander Nemecek, Osama Zafar, Debargha Ganguly, Vikash Singh, Vipin Chaudhary, Erman Ayday
abstract: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Across detection and quality, observed disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that cross-lingual fairness gaps in watermarking are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages.
summary_zh: 现有大语言模型输出水印方案的评估几乎全部基于英文文本开展，仅使用各方案自带的检测阈值与少量质量度量指标。多语言部署场景下，大量在英文场景下无影响的评估设计选择会直接决定跨语言场景下的结论可靠性。本文提出包含四大组件的评估框架：面向每个部署场景经验校准的检测阈值、可区分校准失败与检测失败的阈值无关辅助度量、三类互不重叠的质量度量范式（分布度量、配对语义度量、参考困惑度度量）、以及基于语言类型学家族划分的跨语言差异广义熵分解方法。将该框架应用于6种水印方案、3种开源生成模型、覆盖4种书写系统8个类型学家族的11种语言，以及基础模型与指令微调模型两类场景后，发现了单语言单范式评估无法暴露的失效模式。在检测性能与质量表现两个维度上，观测到的跨语言差异主要存在于类型学家族之间，说明水印的跨语言公平性差距是由语言属性的结构性差异导致，而非特定语言的个体特性引发。

title: End-to-end Early Classification of Time Series in Non-Stationary Environments
title_zh: 非平稳环境下时间序列的端到端早期分类
authors: Aur\'elien Renault, Alexis Bondu, Antoine Cornu\'ejols, Vincent Lemaire
abstract: Early Classification of Time Series (ECTS) requires making accurate decisions as early as possible in inherently online and evolving environments. Yet, most existing methods assume stationarity and rely on separable designs, where classification and triggering are optimized independently, an assumption that fundamentally limits their adaptability under drift. In this work, we challenge this paradigm and study ECTS under non-stationary conditions. We provide the first systematic comparison between separable and end-to-end approaches across controlled drifting scenarios. Building on Reinforcement Learning, we introduce DQeND, a unified architecture that jointly learns representation, classification, and triggering decisions, while remaining directly comparable to state-of-the-art separable baselines. Across a wide range of drifts, DQeND demonstrates strong robustness across various non-stationary scenarios, consistently outperforming separable baselines. An ablation study further highlights that jointly updating representation and decision modules is critical to these gains. Overall, our results indicate that end-to-end learning can offer improved adaptation capabilities for ECTS in dynamic environments, and motivate further investigation of alternatives to separable designs.
summary_zh: 时间序列早期分类（Early Classification of Time Series, ECTS）要求在原生在线且不断演化的环境下尽可能早地输出准确决策。但现有大多数方法假设环境是平稳的，采用分类与触发规则独立优化的分离式设计，该假设从根本上限制了模型在数据漂移场景下的自适应能力。本文突破该范式，研究非平稳条件下的时间序列早期分类问题，在受控漂移场景下对分离式方法与端到端方法开展了首次系统性对比。基于强化学习思路，本文提出DQeND这一统一架构，可联合学习表示、分类与触发决策，且性能可直接与现有最优分离式基线进行对比。在大量不同漂移场景下，DQeND在各类非平稳场景下均表现出强鲁棒性，性能始终优于分离式基线。消融实验进一步证实，联合更新表示模块与决策模块是性能提升的核心原因。总体而言，本文结果表明端到端学习可提升动态环境下时间序列早期分类的自适应能力，为后续探索分离式设计的替代方案提供了研究支撑。

title: CLaST: Context-aware Contrastive VAE for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: CLaST：面向概率时间序列预测的上下文感知对比变分自编码器（VAE）框架
authors: Alexander Marusov, Dmitry Anikin, Petr Sokerin, Vitaliy Pozdnyakov, Ilya Kuleshov, Alexey Zaytsev
abstract: Probabilistic forecasting models are widely used for time series forecasting in domains such as energy systems, finance, medicine, and transportation. In recent years, deep generative models have shown strong results on probabilistic forecasting, yet many conventional approaches struggle to capture internal temporal dependencies, leading to latent representations with limited expressive power. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{CLaST}, a VAE framework for probabilistic multivariate time series forecasting. Unlike existing generative models, CLaST learns embeddings that preserve contextual similarity between observations through our contrastive loss function. Experiments across nine widely adopted benchmarks demonstrate that CLaST consistently surpasses strong baseline methods. In short-term forecasting tasks, our approach achieves improvements of up to $16.4\%$ in CRPS and $14.4\%$ in NMAE over the second-best method. Furthermore, in long-term prediction CLaST attains superior overall performance, exceeding the second-best method by up to $48.6\%$ and $25.1\%$ in CRPS and NMAE, respectively.
summary_zh: 概率预测模型被广泛应用于能源系统、金融、医疗、交通等领域的时间序列预测任务。近年来深度生成模型在概率预测任务中表现出优异性能，但多数传统方法难以捕捉内部时间依赖关系，导致学习到的潜在表征表达能力有限。为解决这一局限，本文提出CLaST，一种面向概率多变量时间序列预测的VAE框架。与现有生成模型不同，CLaST通过本文设计的对比损失函数学习可保留观测值间上下文相似性的嵌入表示。在9个主流基准数据集上开展的实验表明，CLaST的性能始终优于现有强基线方法：在短期预测任务中，相比次优方法，其连续排序概率得分（CRPS）最高提升16.4%，归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE）最高提升14.4%；在长期预测任务中，CLaST的综合表现同样更优，相比次优方法CRPS最高提升48.6%，NMAE最高提升25.1%。

title: Systematic Evaluation of TabPFN-TS for Zero-Shot Probabilistic Heat Load Forecasting in District Heating Networks
title_zh: 面向区域供热网络零样本概率热负荷预测的TabPFN-TS系统性评估
authors: Ben Spoek, Karim K. Ben Hicham, Kai Derzsi, Philipp Althaus, Alexander Mitsos, Dirk M\"uller
abstract: District heating energy hubs require reliable heat load forecasts for efficient operational scheduling. Conventional forecasting workflows train system-specific models on historical data, which can become burdensome when networks change through new consumers, retrofits, or changing operating regimes. Zero-shot time-series foundation models and in-context forecasting offer a promising alternative: they can adapt at inference time from recent observations rather than by repeated retraining. This study systematically evaluates TabPFN-TS against time-series foundation models and trained machine-learning baselines for probabilistic heat load forecasting in district heating networks. Unlike foundation models pretrained on large collections of real time series, TabPFN-TS relies on synthetic pretraining data, which avoids direct pretraining-test overlap but raises the question of whether the learned prior captures district heating dynamics. We analyze covariate choice, context length, temporal resolution, and prediction horizon on representative operating weeks, validate the selected configuration over a full year, and test transferability on a second network. The results identify hourly 24-hour forecasting with a 12-week rolling context and ambient temperature as a parsimonious high-performing configuration; longer context windows do not improve accuracy. TabPFN-TS remains close to Chronos-2 in deterministic accuracy, reaching CVRMSE values of 13.06% versus 12.48% on the main dataset, and lies within the critical-difference threshold in the daily-rank comparison. Although Chronos-2 achieves the lowest aggregate full-year error, TabPFN-TS shows better empirical calibration. Finally, the diagnostic findings motivate a Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster that combines a low-frequency Base Forecaster with a short-horizon Residual Forecaster to improve longer-horizon planning accuracy.
summary_zh: 区域供热能源枢纽需要可靠的热负荷预测结果来实现高效运维调度。传统预测工作流基于历史数据训练系统专属模型，当供热网络因新增用户、管网改造、运行模式变更发生变化时，这类方法的运维负担会显著提升。零样本时间序列基础模型与上下文内预测技术提供了极具前景的替代方案：这类方法无需反复重训练，可在推理阶段基于近期观测数据完成自适应调整。本研究针对区域供热网络概率热负荷预测任务，将TabPFN-TS与时间序列基础模型、经过训练的机器学习基线方法开展系统性对比评估。与基于大量真实时间序列预训练的基础模型不同，TabPFN-TS依托合成预训练数据，可避免预训练集与测试集的直接重叠，但也引发了其学习到的先验知识是否能捕捉区域供热动态特性的疑问。本文在代表性运行周场景下分析了协变量选择、上下文长度、时间分辨率、预测时域的影响，在全年数据上验证了筛选出的最优配置，并在第二个供热网络上测试了模型的迁移性。结果表明：采用12周滚动上下文、以环境温度为协变量的小时级24小时预测是精简且高性能的配置，更长的上下文窗口无法进一步提升预测精度。TabPFN-TS的确定性精度与Chronos-2接近，在主数据集上的变异系数均方根误差（CVRMSE）为13.06%，而Chronos-2为12.48%，在日度排名对比中处于临界差阈值范围内。尽管Chronos-2的全年综合误差最低，但TabPFN-TS表现出更优的经验校准性能。最终基于诊断结果提出了多分辨率残差校正预测器，该框架融合了低频基础预测器与短时域残差预测器，可提升长时程规划的精度。

title: Scale-Aware Pretraining of Time Series Foundation Models via Multi-Patch Token Alignment and Hybrid Masking
title_zh: 基于多补丁token对齐与混合掩码的时间序列基础模型尺度感知预训练
authors: Taihua Chen, Xiang Ma, Yixin Zhang, Tailin Zhan, Manyu Sun, Lizhen Cui
abstract: Pretraining time series foundation models across heterogeneous datasets necessitates effective handling of varying sampling frequencies. Current methods either employ dataset-specific patch sizes and separate FFNs, leading to fragmented representations, or enforce a fixed patch size that neglects inherent temporal variations. To address this, we propose SATS, featuring a scale-aware token alignment mechanism that treats patch size as an explicit notion of scale. By incorporating a contrastive-inspired alignment regularizer, SATS aligns representation spaces across scales while preserving distinct modeling capacities. Furthermore, a hybrid masking strategy combining random and contiguous masking is introduced to capture multi-scale temporal structures. Experimental results on LSTF benchmarks demonstrate that SATS achieves a 9.2% improvement in MSE and an 8.3% gain in GIFT-Eval MASE compared to competitive baselines. Notably, SATS consistently delivers SOTA performance while achieving a 65.6% increase in model efficiency over advanced baselines, highlighting its effectiveness and scalability in time series pretraining.
summary_zh: 在异构数据集上预训练时间序列基础模型需要有效处理不同采样频率的问题。现有方法要么采用数据集专属的补丁尺寸与独立前馈网络（FFN），导致表征碎片化；要么强制使用固定补丁尺寸，忽略了固有的时间变化特性。为解决该问题，本文提出SATS方法，核心是尺度感知token对齐机制，该机制将补丁尺寸作为显式的尺度概念。通过引入对比学习启发的对齐正则项，SATS在保留不同尺度独有建模能力的同时，实现了跨尺度表征空间的对齐。此外本文还提出了融合随机掩码与连续掩码的混合掩码策略，用于捕捉多尺度时间结构。长序列时间序列预测（LSTF）基准上的实验结果表明，与现有最优基线方法相比，SATS的均方误差（MSE）提升9.2%，GIFT-Eval平均绝对尺度误差（MASE）提升8.3%。值得注意的是，SATS不仅持续取得当前最优（SOTA）性能，相比先进基线的模型效率还提升了65.6%，充分证明其在时间序列预训练任务中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Green BOA: Determining the environmental break-even point for ML-based data compression
title_zh: Green BOA：面向机器学习数据压缩的环境盈亏平衡点确定方法
authors: Caterina Doglioni, Akshat Gupta, Thomas Elliott, Hanzila Hussain, Sanjiban Sengupta
abstract: We summarise the outcome of two summer internship projects based at the University of Manchester, focused on the break-even point in terms of environmental sustainability for ML-based data compression algorithms. Using the example of a ML-based lossless compression algorithm, we compare estimates for the carbon-equivalent of the infrastructure needed for ML training and inference with the carbon-equivalent savings from reduced disk storage requirements, and discuss their break-even point.
summary_zh: 本文总结了曼彻斯特大学开展的两项暑期实习项目的研究成果，研究聚焦于基于机器学习的数据压缩算法在环境可持续性维度的盈亏平衡点。本文以一种基于机器学习的无损压缩算法为实例，对比了机器学习训练与推理所需基础设施的碳排放当量，以及磁盘存储需求降低带来的碳排放节省当量，并对二者的盈亏平衡点展开讨论。

title: G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs
title_zh: 从噪声到信号：基于大语言模型与终端专属日志的安全日志异常检测性能提升方法
authors: Bhavya Gupta, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing
abstract: Autonomous driving systems must operate under partial observability, where safety-critical objects may be occluded or visible only to neighboring connected vehicles. Vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation can reduce this uncertainty, but existing cooperative driving methods often compress multi-agent evidence into latent features or hidden multimodal states. As a result, they obscure which agent observed each object, whether the object is visible to the ego vehicle, and how conflicting evidence affects downstream decisions. We propose G-MARK, a grounded multi-agent reasoning framework that converts cooperative object-centric observations into explicit provenance-aware knowledge graphs (KGs). The resulting KGs preserve object hypotheses together with their source attribution, ego-versus-partner visibility, uncertainty, conflicts, spatial relations, and planning-relevant context. G-MARK then derives a shared feature representation from these KGs, enabling lightweight task heads to support object reasoning, motion prediction, control selection, and trajectory forecasting. Compared with the state-of-the-art baseline, GMARK improves occlusion reasoning accuracy by 42.2%, reduces control-selection error by 13.1%, and achieves comparable trajectory-planning accuracy with a 25.6x smaller structured communication payload. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhavyagupta98/g-mark.
summary_zh: 现有异常行为日志检测方法中，Wazuh等方案主要依赖预定义检测规则，OpenSearch等统计异常检测方案则通过识别与历史观测行为模式的偏差实现检测。近期研究探索了大语言模型（LLM）在日志异常检测中的应用，这类模型具备解读语义与上下文信息的能力。但基于LLM的检测方法容易受到提示词构建、日志数据噪声、依赖缺乏终端专属认证行为信息的通用数据集等问题的影响。为解决上述局限，本研究开发了标准化的基于指令的LLM分类框架，用于检测包括边界案例在内的异常认证行为。研究搭建了受控网络安全测试床生成终端专属认证数据，构建了包含正常、边界与异常行为场景的精选数据集。在统一的真实严重度评估框架下，对三个经过指令微调的LLM（Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct、GPT-OSS 20B）与基于规则的Wazuh检测、OpenSearch异常检测开展对比评估。结果显示Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的端到端综合检测性能最优，准确率达89.3%，召回率达88.2%，F1值达91.8%，漏检率为11.8%。作为对比，Wazuh的准确率为52.0%，漏检率为68.6%；OpenSearch的准确率为49.3%，漏检率为74.5%。Meta Llama还检测出了80%的边界异常场景，而Wazuh仅检测出20%，OpenSearch仅检测出15%。Qwen的综合检测性能低于Meta Llama，但平均推理延迟最低，结构化响应有效率达100%。GPT-OSS在生成有效响应时表现出优异的分类性能。

title: From Noise to Signal: Improving Security Log Anomaly Detection Using LLMs with Endpoint-Specific Logs
title_zh: 从噪声到有效信号：利用大语言模型结合端点专属日志提升安全日志异常检测性能
authors: Christopher Henshaw, Gour Karmakar
abstract: Existing approaches to anomalous behaviour log detection, such as Wazuh rely primarily on predefined detection rules, while statistical anomaly detection approaches such as OpenSearch identify deviations from previously observed behavioural patterns. Recent research has investigated LLMs for log anomaly detection because of their ability to interpret semantic and contextual information. However, LLM-based approaches can be affected by prompt construction, noisy log data, and reliance on generic datasets that may lack endpoint-specific authentication behaviours. To address these limitations, this study develops a standardised instruction-based LLM classification framework for detecting anomalous authentication behaviours, including borderline cases. A controlled cybersecurity testbed was developed to generate endpoint-specific authentication data, producing a curated dataset comprising normal, borderline, and anomalous behavioural scenarios. Three instruction-tuned LLMs, Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, and GPT-OSS 20B, were evaluated against Wazuh rule-based detection and OpenSearch Anomaly Detection using a common ground-truth severity framework. Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct achieved the strongest overall end-to-end detection performance, with an accuracy of 89.3%, recall of 88.2%, F1-score of 91.8%, and false negative rate of 11.8%. In comparison, Wazuh achieved an accuracy of 52.0% and false negative rate of 68.6%, while OpenSearch achieved an accuracy of 49.3% and false negative rate of 74.5%. Meta Llama also detected 80% of the borderline anomalous scenarios, compared with 20% for Wazuh and 15% for OpenSearch. Qwen achieved lower overall detection performance than Meta Llama but recorded the lowest average inference latency and 100% structured-response validity. GPT-OSS demonstrated strong classification performance when valid responses were produced.
summary_zh: 现有异常行为日志检测方案如Wazuh主要依赖预定义检测规则，而OpenSearch等统计异常检测方案则通过识别与历史观测行为模式的偏差实现检测。近期研究利用大语言模型的语义与上下文信息理解能力开展日志异常检测，但基于大语言模型的方案仍面临提示词构建难度大、日志数据存在噪声、依赖缺乏端点专属认证行为特征的通用数据集等局限。针对上述问题，本研究构建了标准化的基于指令的大语言模型分类框架，可实现含边界案例在内的异常认证行为检测。研究搭建了受控网络安全测试平台生成端点专属认证数据，构建了包含正常、边界、异常三类行为场景的精选数据集。在统一的真实严重程度评估框架下，对三个经过指令微调的大语言模型（Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct、GPT-OSS 20B）与基于规则的Wazuh检测方案、OpenSearch异常检测方案开展对比评估。实验结果表明，Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的端到端检测整体性能最优，准确率达89.3%、召回率达88.2%、F1值达91.8%、漏检率为11.8%；作为对照的Wazuh准确率为52.0%、漏检率为68.6%，OpenSearch准确率为49.3%、漏检率为74.5%。Meta Llama可检测出80%的边界异常场景，而Wazuh与OpenSearch仅能检测出20%与15%的边界异常场景。Qwen的整体检测性能低于Meta Llama，但平均推理延迟最低，结构化响应有效率达100%。GPT-OSS在生成有效响应的前提下表现出优异的分类性能。

title: Auditing Recorded Predictive Lead Service-Line Classifications Against Physical Verification: A Statewide Study of New York
title_zh: 针对物理核验的预测性服务铅管分类记录审计：纽约州全域研究
authors: Muhammad Sarmad Sohail
abstract: Under the US Lead and Copper Rule Revisions, a utility may determine a service line's material with a predictive model instead of inspecting it. New York State publishes, per address, which method was used. Almost no address carries both a model classification and a physical verification, so the check is between populations within a utility rather than paired addresses. We screen all 153 New York localities that classified at least 100 addresses this way. Seventy-five (49%), covering 125,990 addresses or 57% of those screened, record one value. Zero variance alone is not misconduct: 68 of the 75 match their own verification or have too little to test. Seven are contradicted by their own crews, six beyond any sampling explanation. Five are boroughs of New York City, which file as one system; one is East Rochester, 550 km away. New York City is the largest case: a predictive model is the recorded basis for 43,215 addresses, and on all of them the recorded material is "Known Other". The city records "Unknown" on 121,779 addresses, 1,880 already excavated, and lead on 120,692. In the model bucket both counts are zero, and the 95% upper bound on the rate is 0.0085%. Across the rest of New York the same method records lead or the hedge "Unknown but could be lead" on 12.21% of 176,888 addresses, a comparison whose weaknesses we report. The model-cleared population is newer, median year built 1984 against 1930, and construction era accounts for about a third of the gap and not the rest: holding era fixed, records-based classification finds lead at 4.3-31.9%, physical verification at 1.5-14.5%, the model in no era. Six era-aware estimators place the expected lead lines among them at 1,150-1,450. Two findings need no comparison: 7,782 of these addresses are in pre-1940 buildings, and the archived 2025 snapshot shows the public-side determination was copied from a customer-side model output.
summary_zh: 根据美国《铅铜规则修订版》要求，公用事业单位可通过预测模型而非现场核验确定服务管线的材质。纽约州公开了每个地址对应的管线材质判定方法。几乎没有地址同时拥有模型分类结果与物理核验结果，因此审计工作是在同一公用事业单位内的不同群体间开展，而非基于配对地址。本研究筛查了纽约州所有采用预测模型分类、且分类地址数不少于100个的153个行政区。其中75个行政区（占比49%，覆盖125990个地址，占筛查总地址数的57%）的记录仅标注了单一材质。零方差本身并不代表违规：75个行政区中有65个的记录与自有核验结果匹配，或样本量过小无法开展检验。剩余7个行政区的记录与自有运维团队的核验结果矛盾，其中6个的偏差程度超出了抽样误差可解释的范围。这7个行政区中5个属于纽约市行政区，统一作为一个系统提交数据，1个位于550公里外的东罗切斯特。纽约市是规模最大的案例：43215个地址的管线材质判定记录基于预测模型，所有这些地址的记录材质均为“已知其他材质”。该市另有121779个地址的管线材质记录为“未知”，其中1880个已经完成开挖核验，120692个地址的管线材质记录为铅制。在模型判定分组中，铅制管线与“未知”管线的数量均为0，铅制管线占比的95%置信区间上限仅为0.0085%。在纽约州其余地区，采用同类预测方法判定的176888个地址中，铅制管线或“未知但可能为铅制”的管线占比达12.21%，本文也报告了该对比方法的局限性。经模型判定为非铅制的管线所属建筑年代更晚，中位建成年份为1984年，而其余管线的中位建成年份为1930年，建筑年代差异可解释约三分之一的占比差距，但无法解释剩余差异：固定建筑年代变量后，基于记录的分类方法得到的铅制管线占比为4.3%-31.9%，物理核验得到的铅制管线占比为1.5%-14.5%，而预测模型在所有年代分组中均未检出铅制管线。6种考虑年代因素的估计方法测算得到，该群体中预期存在的铅制管线数量为1150-1450根。两项无需对比即可确认的发现显示：这些地址中有7782个位于1940年前建成的建筑内，2025年归档快照显示，公共侧管线的判定结果直接复制自用户侧模型的输出结果。

title: Multi-Source Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Graph Learning
title_zh: 多源Wasserstein分布鲁棒图学习
authors: Chuansen Peng, Yifan Xia, Jinshan Zhong, Xiaojing Shen
abstract: Network topology inference from graph signals is central to graph signal processing with applications in neuroscience, sensor, and social networks. In practice, target-domain samples are scarce while heterogeneous source-domain data are abundant. Fusing these sources is challenging: Euclidean averaging works for homogeneous sources but degrades sharply as inter-source divergence grows, collapsing distinct geometries into an inflated, biased consensus. We exploit the Wasserstein metric's distribution-preserving properties to counter heterogeneity while preserving each source's intrinsic geometry. We propose MS-WDRO, a multi-source Wasserstein distributionally robust graph learning framework that fuses heterogeneous sources via their weighted Wasserstein barycenter, a geometrically principled nominal distribution, then builds an ambiguity ball around it to hedge residual uncertainty. Minimizing worst-case risk yields a tractable regularized Laplacian estimator solved efficiently via a provably convergent ADMM scheme. We establish non-asymptotic guarantees: a finite-sample concentration bound for the empirical barycenter, a pooling bias lower bound proving naive aggregation is suboptimal, and an out-of-sample excess risk bound decaying at a parametric rate with only logarithmic dependence on source count. To calibrate hyperparameters governing robustness, sparsity, and source fusion, we unroll the solver into a differentiable architecture trained end-to-end, achieving data-adaptive calibration beyond cross-validation while retaining interpretability. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and the multi-site ABIDE~I neuroimaging dataset show MS-WDRO consistently outperforms seven baselines in graph recovery, sample efficiency, and downstream diagnostic utility, with the largest gains in the sample-scarce regime.
summary_zh: 基于图信号的网络拓扑推断是图信号处理的核心研究方向，可应用于神经科学、传感器网络、社交网络等领域。在实际场景中，目标域样本稀缺，但异构源域数据十分充足。融合这些异构源数据存在显著挑战：欧氏平均方法仅适用于同源数据，随着源间差异增大，性能会急剧下降，将不同的几何结构坍缩为有偏的膨胀共识结构。本文利用Wasserstein度量的分布保持特性抵消异构性，同时保留每个源的固有几何结构。本文提出MS-WDRO，一种多源Wasserstein分布鲁棒图学习框架，该框架通过加权Wasserstein重心（一种具备几何合理性的名义分布）融合异构源数据，随后在其周围构建歧义球对冲残余不确定性。通过最小化最坏情况风险，可得到易于求解的正则化拉普拉斯估计器，采用可证明收敛的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）可高效求解。本文推导得到非渐近理论保证：经验重心的有限样本集中界、证明朴素聚合方法非最优的融合偏差下界，以及仅与源数量存在对数依赖、以参数速率衰减的样本外超额风险界。为校准控制鲁棒性、稀疏性、源融合的超参数，本文将求解器展开为可微架构并进行端到端训练，实现了超越交叉验证的数据自适应校准，同时保留了模型可解释性。在合成基准数据集与多站点自闭症脑成像数据交换I期（ABIDE I）神经影像数据集上开展的实验表明，MS-WDRO在图恢复精度、样本效率与下游诊断效用方面始终优于7种基线方法，在样本稀缺场景下性能提升幅度最大。

title: A Layered Simplex Architecture for Large Alphabets
title_zh: 面向大字符集的分层单纯形架构
authors: Meir Feder, Yaniv Fogel, Ruediger Urbanke
abstract: Probability estimation over large alphabets under log loss is a well-studied problem, with celebrated methods such as the Good-Turing estimator. We introduce and study a new Bayesian estimator with four notable properties. First, its construction is exceptionally simple: multiply independent uniform draws from the probability simplex coordinate-wise and renormalize. Depth is the only structural parameter, and averaging over depths eliminates the need to tune it. Second, the regret of the resulting mixture, the excess code length it pays relative to a code that knows the source, admits an explicit and efficiently computable expression. Third, despite its simplicity and lack of tuned constants, the estimator is competitive across a diverse set of synthetic and real-text benchmarks with substantially more specialized methods, including Good-Turing. Fourth, the tractability of its regret allows us to identify scaling laws in data, alphabet size, and depth. For Zipf targets with exponent above one, the regret has a simple reading as long as the sample reveals only a small fraction of the alphabet. It closely matches the description length of the set of discovered symbols, at one bit of code per bit of description, plus a further cost per symbol. The data exponent is therefore the rate at which new symbols are discovered.
summary_zh: 对数损失下针对大字符集的概率估计是一个被广泛研究的问题，已有Good-Turing（古德-图灵）估计器等经典方法。本文提出并研究了一种全新的贝叶斯估计器，具备四项突出特性：第一，构造极其简单：对概率单纯形上的独立均匀采样结果逐坐标相乘后重新归一化即可，深度是唯一的结构参数，对不同深度的结果取平均可免去参数调优步骤。第二，该混合估计器的遗憾（即相比已知源分布的编码方法额外付出的码长）存在显式且可高效计算的表达式。第三，尽管结构简单且无需调参，该估计器在大量合成与真实文本基准上的性能可与包括Good-Turing在内的大量专用方法相媲美。第四，该估计器的遗憾易于计算，可帮助识别数据、字符集大小与深度之间的标度律。对于指数大于1的Zipf分布目标，只要样本仅能覆盖字符集的一小部分，遗憾就存在简洁的表达形式：其与已发现符号集合的描述长度高度匹配，每比特描述对应1比特码长，再加上每个符号的额外开销。因此数据指数就是新符号被发现的速率。

title: PETA:Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Screening
title_zh: PETA：面向虚拟筛选的参数高效测试时自适应方法
authors: Jia-Qi Lin, Yinghua Yao, Chang-Dong Wang, Yew-Soon Ong, Yuangang Pan
abstract: Accurately ranking active ligands for a target protein pocket from massive chemical libraries remains a central challenge in virtual screening. DrugCLIP and its recent extensions substantially accelerate this process by encoding protein pockets and molecules into a shared embedding space. Despite this progress, further performance improvements typically require retraining the entire model, incurring substantial computational overhead and making target-specific customization inefficient. In this work, we formulate the specialization of pretrained virtual screening models to individual pockets as a test-time adaptation problem and propose PETA, a parameter-efficient framework that directly adapts pretrained model at test time. Given a target pocket, PETA constructs pocket-specific negatives through molecular diffusion and chemical validity filtering, and further moves them toward the reference ligand retrieved from structural databases via embedding-space mixup to create more challenging ranking tasks. A ranking objective then places greater emphasis on suppressing high-scoring invalid candidates that could contaminate the top-ranked screening results, providing structured supervision for lightweight adaptation. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that this lightweight, pocket-specific adaptation outperforms both pretrained and fully retrained baselines while updating only the LayerNorm parameters, which account for approximately $0.03\%$ of the full model.
summary_zh: 从海量化学库中为目标蛋白口袋精准排序活性配体是虚拟筛选领域的核心挑战。DrugCLIP及其后续扩展方法通过将蛋白口袋与分子编码到共享嵌入空间中，大幅加快了虚拟筛选的速度。尽管取得了上述进展，进一步提升性能通常需要重新训练整个模型，带来极高的计算开销，导致目标专属定制的效率极低。本研究将预训练虚拟筛选模型针对单个蛋白口袋的适配问题定义为测试时自适应任务，提出PETA，一种参数高效的框架，可直接在测试阶段对预训练模型进行自适应调整。针对目标蛋白口袋，PETA通过分子扩散与化学有效性过滤构建口袋专属负样本，进一步通过嵌入空间混合操作将这些负样本向从结构数据库中检索得到的参考配体偏移，构建更具挑战性的排序任务。随后采用排序目标，重点抑制可能污染高排名筛选结果的高分无效候选，为轻量自适应过程提供结构化监督。在多个不同基准上开展的实验表明，该轻量、口袋专属的自适应方法仅需更新占全模型参数约0.03%的层归一化（LayerNorm）参数，性能即可超越预训练基线与全量重训练基线。

title: Where Does the Union Bound Go? Best-Arm Identification and Strong FWER Control
title_zh: 联合界的去向：最优臂识别与强族系错误率（FWER）控制
authors: Rianne de Heide
abstract: In fixed-confidence best-arm identification, proofs often use a union bound across the competing arms. From a multiple-testing point of view this can look puzzling: if the best arm is unique, only one hypothesis of the form ``arm $i$ is best'' can be true. Why then should there be a Bonferroni-type factor of $K-1$? The answer is that there are two natural ways to orient the hypotheses. In one orientation, best-arm identification is literally a strong familywise-error-rate (FWER) problem with $K-1$ true nulls. In the opposite orientation, exactly one null is true, but a pairwise implementation can falsely reject that one null through any of $K-1$ comparisons. Thus the multiplicity has not disappeared; it just pops up in different places. This note makes the equivalence explicit in the terminology of both communities.
summary_zh: 在固定置信度最优臂识别场景中，相关证明通常会对所有竞争臂使用联合界方法。从多重检验的视角来看这一做法似乎令人困惑：如果最优臂是唯一的，那么形如“臂i为最优臂”的假设中仅有一个为真，为何还要引入K-1量级的邦费罗尼（Bonferroni）因子？答案在于对假设的定向存在两种自然方式：第一种定向下，最优臂识别本质上是包含K-1个真零假设的强族系错误率（FWER）问题；在相反的定向中，恰好仅有一个零假设为真，但成对实现过程中会通过K-1次比较中的任意一次错误拒绝该零假设。因此多重性并未消失，只是出现在了不同位置。本文明确厘清了两个研究领域术语体系下的等价关系。

title: The impact of feature engineering and an optimisation framework for ocean colour machine learning
title_zh: 面向海洋色彩机器学习的特征工程影响评估与优化框架
authors: Edson Silva, Julien Brajard, Simon Cappe, Lasse H. Pettersson, Fran\c{c}ois Counillon
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is widely used for the development of ocean colour algorithms, but most studies focus on model parameter training and hyperparameter tuning. The optimisation of the data that feeds the models - i.e., Feature Engineering (FE) - is not fully explored. We assess the impact of FE in ocean colour machine learning models and we propose an optimisation framework that includes seven sequenced levels of data transformation: i. band choice, ii. log scaling, iii. spectral shape normalisation, iv. index extraction, v. principal component analysis, vi. feature scaling, and vii. zero-to-one scaling. We demonstrate the application for Multi-layer perceptron, Support Vector Machines, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting Trees on Sentinel-3 OLCI observations in the Norwegian coastal waters. The models are trained to estimate Chlorophyll-a concentration [Chl-a] and Secchi disk depth (Zsd). Results show that accuracy is highly variable among FE found in six studies using Sentinel-3 OLCI and the ones that we optimise. The R range from 0.01 to 0.55 for [Chl-a] and from 0.15 to 0.68 for Zsd, where the optimised FE shows the top results. The ML models with optimised FE could also improve by two times the R and reduce up to 63% of the mean absolute error when compared to CHL_OC4ME and CHL_NN standard algorithms. Nevertheless, no common optimised FE is found for all target variables and ML models, suggesting that FE optimisation is necessary for each application. Therefore, our proposed framework can be key for improving the accuracy of water quality monitoring in coastal waters.
summary_zh: 机器学习（ML）已被广泛应用于海洋色彩算法开发，但现有研究大多聚焦于模型参数训练与超参数调优，对输入模型的数据优化即特征工程（FE）的探索仍不充分。本文评估了特征工程对海洋色彩机器学习模型的影响，提出了包含7个顺序数据转换层级的优化框架：i.波段选择、ii.对数缩放、iii.光谱形状归一化、iv.指数提取、v.主成分分析、vi.特征缩放、vii.0-1归一化。本文基于挪威近岸海域的哨兵3号海洋与陆地色彩成像仪（Sentinel-3 OLCI）观测数据，在多层感知机、支持向量机和极端梯度提升树三类模型上开展应用验证，训练模型用于估算叶绿素a浓度[Chl-a]和塞克盘深度（Zsd）。结果显示，6项使用Sentinel-3 OLCI数据的现有研究采用的特征工程方案与本文优化得到的方案精度差异极大：[Chl-a]的决定系数R取值范围为0.01~0.55，Zsd的R取值范围为0.15~0.68，其中本文优化得到的特征工程方案取得了最优结果。与CHL_OC4ME、CHL_NN等标准算法相比，采用优化特征工程的机器学习模型可将R值提升1倍，平均绝对误差最高降低63%。但不存在适用于所有目标变量和机器学习模型的通用优化特征工程方案，说明特征工程优化需要针对每类应用单独开展。本文提出的框架可为提升近岸海域水质监测精度提供关键支撑。

title: Reliable Neural Collapse Approximation for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: 面向开放世界测试时自适应的可靠神经塌陷近似方法
authors: Jia-Qi Lin, Yuangang Pan, Chang-Dong Wang, Haizhang Zhang, Ivor W. Tsang, Joey Tianyi Zhou
abstract: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods aim to bridge the domain gap between the source and target domains. However, traditional TTA methods become ineffective when the label distribution shift occurs, a challenge commonly referred to as an open-world scenario. In this paper, we introduce a new method named Reliable Neural Collapse approximation (ReNC) for Open-World Test-Time Adaptation (OWTTA). Specifically, we leverage neural collapse as a structural prior for reliable target-domain adaptation. Guided by this prior, we justify that the pre-trained classifier weights can serve as the prototypes of the source domain. By measuring the similarity between samples and prototypes, we filter out the Out-Of-Distribution~(OOD) samples for reliable updates. Furthermore, we propose a neural collapse approximation mechanism to refine these prototypes, ensuring they can gradually adapt to the target domain while maintaining the neural collapse structure. Extensive experiments on several open-world benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. Our empirical analysis suggests that ReNC better preserves NC-related properties in the target domain, providing useful evidence for explaining reliable OWTTA and offering new insights for model design. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiLin-AI/ReNC.
summary_zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）方法旨在弥合源域与目标域之间的域差距，但传统TTA方法在发生标签分布偏移（即开放世界场景）时会失效。本文提出一种面向开放世界测试时自适应（OWTTA）的全新方法：可靠神经塌陷近似（ReNC）。具体而言，本文将神经塌陷作为结构先验实现可靠的目标域自适应，基于该先验可证明预训练分类器权重可作为源域的原型。通过度量样本与原型之间的相似度，本文过滤掉分布外（OOD）样本以实现可靠的模型更新。此外本文提出神经塌陷近似机制对原型进行优化，确保原型在保持神经塌陷结构的前提下逐步适配目标域。在多个开放世界基准数据集上开展的大量实验证明了所提方法的优越性。实证分析表明，ReNC可在目标域中更好地保留与神经塌陷相关的属性，为解释可靠开放世界测试时自适应提供了有效依据，也为模型设计提供了新的思路。代码开源地址为：https://github.com/JiaqiLin-AI/ReNC。

title: Interpretable Feature Learning for RF Fingerprinting via Polar MKANs
title_zh: 基于极坐标MKAN的可解释射频指纹特征学习
authors: Mikhail Krasnov, Ljupcho Milosheski, Carolina Fortuna
abstract: Radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting authenticates wireless devices from hardware-induced I/Q impairments, typically with deep learning feature extractors that are accurate but opaque, limiting their use in security critical settings. We propose Polar Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (Polar MKAN), a block partitioned monotonic encoder on polar inputs in which each latent dimension depends exclusively on magnitude or phase, yielding channel separation and monotone responses by construction. On a synthetic gain and carrier frequency offset (CFO) benchmark, Polar MKAN reaches 57.2 percent DCI Disentanglement versus at most 12.9 percent for unpartitioned baselines. We further evaluate the detection accuracy trade off on real data and the sensitivity to blind CFO compensation.
summary_zh: 射频（RF）指纹技术可根据硬件引入的同相/正交（I/Q） impairments实现无线设备认证，现有方案通常采用深度学习特征提取器，虽然精度较高但可解释性差，限制了其在安全关键场景中的应用。本文提出极坐标单调柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（Polar MKAN），这是一种针对极坐标输入的分块单调编码器，每个潜在维度仅依赖于幅度或相位，通过构造即可实现信道分离与单调响应。在合成增益与载波频偏（CFO）基准数据集上，Polar MKAN的DCI解耦度达到57.2%，而未分区的基线模型最高仅为12.9%。本文进一步在真实数据上评估了检测精度的权衡关系，以及模型对盲载波频偏补偿的敏感度。

title: A Repeated Measurements Approach to $SoH$ Battery Modelling of Cyclic Aged Data in a Laboratory Environment
title_zh: 实验室环境下循环老化数据的电池健康状态（SoH）建模重复测量方法
authors: Mark Cary, Charles Bokor
abstract: This document describes the application of a first order linearised nonlinear repeated measurements approach to the analysis of battery cell ageing profiles generated under controlled conditions in a laboratory. The primary advantage of the model is it reflects the obvious structure in the data. Consequently, it is a two-component of variance model: variation within ageing profiles (measurement noise) and variation among ageing profiles (test-to-test or cell-to-cell) variation. Novel regularised iterative generalised least squares parameter identification schemes, with optimal hyper-parameter re-estimation, are used to identify the hierarchical nonlinear model. The training data comprised $SoH$ profiles for 10 cells aged at various constant discharge and charge current cycles at a fixed chamber environmental temperature of 25 [$^\circ$C]. Each cell $SoH$ profile is modelled using a simple power law expression, whereas the variation in ageing parameters is modelled using a single knot cubic B-spline. $SoH$ is accurately predicted to $\pm 0.191\%$ for $SOH \in [0,20]$.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一阶线性化非线性重复测量方法在实验室受控条件下生成的电池单体老化曲线分析中的应用。该模型的核心优势是可充分反映数据中隐含的结构特征，属于双分量方差模型：包含老化曲线内部的变异（测量噪声）和老化曲线之间的变异（测试间或单体间差异）。本文采用带最优超参数重估计的新型正则化迭代广义最小二乘参数识别方案，对分层非线性模型进行参数辨识。训练数据包含10个电池单体的健康状态（SoH）曲线，所有单体均在25℃的固定恒温箱环境中，在不同的恒定充放电电流循环下完成老化。每个单体的SoH曲线采用简单幂律表达式建模，老化参数的变异采用单节点三次B样条建模。当SoH取值在[0,20]区间时，SoH预测精度可达±0.191%。

title: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Generalizable Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 面向可泛化动态图异常检测的在线测试时自适应
authors: Jialun Zheng, Hanchen Yang, Jiannong Cao, Yankai Chen, Yuanjing Feng, Philip S. Yu
abstract: Generalizable dynamic graph anomaly detection (DGAD) enables pretrained detectors to identify anomalies in unseen target domains without costly retraining. However, existing methods often fail for two reasons. First, they mainly rely on domain-agnostic patterns and miss domain-specific patterns that keep evolving. Second, they assume access to the full target domain data, whereas in more practical online test-time adaptation settings, target data arrive sequentially in unlabeled chunks. To address these limitations, we formulate online test-time adaptation for generalizable DGAD and propose OTTA-DGAD. OTTA-DGAD first extracts dynamic prototypes, i.e., evolving representations of normal and anomalous patterns, from temporal ego-graphs and stores them in a memory buffer. The buffer selectively retains general patterns shared across the source domains used for pretraining while incorporating new patterns from the target domain. An anomaly scorer then compares incoming edge representations against these prototypes to identify both general and domain-specific anomalies. During adaptation, OTTA-DGAD updates the memory buffer using reliable pseudo-labels identified through confidence-based detection. It further enriches each target chunk with relevant representations retained from previous chunks, compensating for information loss resulting from the sequential arrival of data. Extensive experiments under strict test-then-adapt OTTA settings demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on ten real-world datasets from diverse domains.
summary_zh: 可泛化动态图异常检测（DGAD）可让预训练检测器无需高成本重训练即可在未见过的目标域中识别异常，但现有方法通常存在两点缺陷导致性能不佳：第一，现有方法主要依赖域无关模式，忽略了持续演化的域特定模式；第二，现有方法假设可获取全部目标域数据，但在更具实用性的在线测试时自适应场景中，目标数据以无标注分块的形式依次到达。为解决上述局限，本文定义了面向可泛化DGAD的在线测试时自适应任务，提出OTTA-DGAD方法。该方法首先从时序自图中提取动态原型（即正常模式与异常模式的演化表示），并存储在内存缓冲区中。缓冲区会选择性保留预训练所用源域之间共享的通用模式，同时纳入来自目标域的新模式。随后异常评分器将新到达的边表示与这些原型进行比对，同时识别通用异常和域特定异常。自适应过程中，OTTA-DGAD通过基于置信度检测得到的可靠伪标签更新内存缓冲区，同时利用从之前分块中保留的相关表示丰富每个目标分块，补偿数据顺序到达带来的信息损失。在严格的先测试后自适应OTTA设置下开展的大量实验表明，该方法在来自不同领域的10个真实世界数据集上取得了当前最优性能。

title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
title_zh: 语言模型中的非故意上下文泄露现象研究
authors: Jaiden Fairoze, Neal Mangaokar, Kamalika Chaudhuri, Sanjam Garg, Saeed Mahloujifar
abstract: In controlled experiments across eight proprietary models, we find that 2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82\% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests. We observe that more capable models leak more: stronger instruction-following amplifies sensitivity to in-context secrets, suggesting leakage is a byproduct of capability as opposed to a patchable bug. We show this leakage enables two practical attacks: (1) a trained classifier that infers semantic predicates about user memories (e.g., health conditions, financial events) from routine natural-language outputs, and (2) an RL-trained adversary that extracts full Social Security Numbers from a production-style agent.
summary_zh: 在针对8个商用模型的受控实验中，本文发现模型在响应普通非对抗请求生成的输出中，可近乎完美地重建上下文中的2位数字秘密，对4位数字秘密的精确匹配重建准确率也可达82%。观测结果表明能力越强的模型泄露风险越高：更强的指令遵循能力会放大模型对上下文秘密的敏感度，说明泄露是模型能力提升的伴随产物，并非可通过补丁修复的孤立漏洞。本文验证了该泄露现象可支撑两类实用攻击：（1）经过训练的分类器可从常规自然语言输出中推断出用户记忆的语义谓词（例如健康状况、金融事件）；（2）基于强化学习（RL）训练的对抗者可从生产级智能体中提取完整的社保号码。

title: FAR-DPO: Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization for Cyclic Peptide Design
title_zh: 环肽设计的可行性感知鲁棒直接偏好优化方法FAR-DPO
authors: Guofeng Zhang, Rong Han, Xiaoyu Wang, Zhiyun Li, Zongbo Han, Xiaohong Liu, Guangyu Wang
abstract: Cyclic peptides are emerging as promising molecular scaffolds in drug discovery due to their high binding affinity and structural stability. However, extending generative models from linear to cyclic peptide design remains challenging, as cyclization sharply restricts the feasible design space through coupled geometric and biophysical constraints. Moreover, limited training data has led existing approaches to rely largely on zero-shot generation or post hoc filtering, resulting in low yields of feasible designs and limited control over multi-objective trade-offs. To address these limitations, we propose FAR-DPO (Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization), an architecture-agnostic framework that steers generative models toward structurally and biophysically feasible cyclic peptide designs, particularly for challenging targets. FAR-DPO integrates feasibility-aware preference construction with difficulty-aware group-robust optimization. Specifically, it constructs within-target preference pairs through feasibility-gated multi-objective dominance and adaptively reweights predefined difficulty groups according to their current preference losses. On the CPSea LNR benchmark, under a fixed generation budget, FAR-DPO increases overall success rate from 46.89% to 57.79% on PepGLAD and from 47.96% to 49.57% on PepFlow. These gains also extend to the hardest target quartile and are accompanied by more favorable best-per-target binding scores. Together, these results demonstrate FAR-DPO's effectiveness in improving feasibility and target-wise robustness.
summary_zh: 环肽因具备高结合亲和力与结构稳定性，已成为药物研发领域极具潜力的分子骨架。但将生成模型从线性肽设计拓展到环肽设计仍面临诸多挑战：环化过程通过耦合几何约束与生物物理约束大幅压缩了可行设计空间，同时训练数据不足导致现有方法大多依赖零样本生成或事后过滤，可行设计的产出率低，且难以对多目标权衡进行控制。为解决上述局限，本文提出FAR-DPO（Feasibility-Aware and Robust Direct Preference Optimization，可行性感知鲁棒直接偏好优化），这是一种架构无关的框架，可引导生成模型输出结构与生物物理层面均可行的环肽设计，尤其适用于高难度靶点。FAR-DPO将可行性感知偏好构建与难度感知组鲁棒优化相结合，具体通过可行性门控的多目标支配关系构建靶点内偏好对，并根据当前偏好损失对预定义的难度组进行自适应重加权。在CPSea LNR基准数据集上，固定生成预算的条件下，FAR-DPO将PepGLAD的整体成功率从46.89%提升至57.79%，将PepFlow的整体成功率从47.96%提升至49.57%。该性能提升同样适用于难度最高的四分之一靶点，同时单靶点最优结合得分也得到进一步优化。上述结果充分证明FAR-DPO可有效提升环肽设计的可行性与靶点层面鲁棒性。

title: Answer-Level Trust Selection for Physical Vision-Language Reasoning
title_zh: 面向物理视觉语言推理的答案级可信选择
authors: Rongyu Yu, Ke Niu, Fengxiang He
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can estimate physical quantities such as duration, speed, and acceleration from visual observations, but existing benchmarks primarily assess overall model performance against annotated ground truth. In deployment, a key question is whether an individual prediction can be trusted when its ground truth is unavailable. Self-consistency alone may fail to capture important failure modes: a VLM may produce stable-but-wrong estimates or rely on textual priors rather than visual evidence. We formulate answer-level selective prediction for quantitative physical reasoning and propose Answer-Level Trust Selection (ATS), a post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for accepting or rejecting individual VLM predictions. ATS requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary verifier, or access to the model's internal logits. Instead, it aggregates eight interpretable behavioral diagnostic scores derived from repeated queries and controlled interventions into a unified trust score. We evaluate ATS in depth on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and across 20 VLM backbones, examining selective performance, diagnostic behavior, and targeted failure modes. Our results show that intervention-based diagnostics help identify stable-but-wrong and prior-tracking predictions that repeated agreement alone may miss. However, improved failure-case rejection can come at the cost of lower retention of correct predictions. ATS therefore complements model-level capability evaluation with answer-level reliability assessment for quantitative VLM predictions. Code will be released upon publication.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可从视觉观测中估算时长、速度、加速度等物理量，但现有基准数据集主要基于标注真值评估模型的整体性能。在实际部署场景中，核心问题在于当无法获取真值时，如何判断单个预测结果是否可信。仅依靠自一致性无法覆盖所有重要的失效模式：视觉语言模型可能输出稳定但错误的估算结果，或依赖文本先验而非视觉证据得到结果。本文针对定量物理推理任务定义了答案级选择性预测问题，提出答案级可信选择（ATS）框架，这是一种事后的、模型无关的框架，可对视觉语言模型的单个预测结果进行接受或拒绝判断。ATS无需微调、无需额外验证器，也无需访问模型内部对数几率，仅通过聚合从重复查询和受控干预中得到的8个可解释行为诊断得分，输出统一的可信得分。本文在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型以及20种不同的视觉语言模型骨干上对ATS进行了全面评估，分析了其选择性性能、诊断行为和针对性失效模式。结果表明，基于干预的诊断方法可识别出仅靠重复一致性无法发现的“稳定但错误”和“先验跟踪”类预测结果，但提升失效案例的拒绝率可能会降低正确预测的留存率。ATS可对模型层面的能力评估形成补充，实现针对视觉语言模型定量预测结果的答案级可靠性评估。代码将在论文发表后开源。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Using Flow Matching on Tabular Data
title_zh: 基于流匹配的表格数据无监督异常检测
authors: Philip Konz, Tejaswini Medi, Margret Keuper
abstract: Financial anomaly detection often relies on large unlabeled transaction logs, where anomalous samples may already be present during training. Such training-set contamination violates the clean-normal data assumption underlying many anomaly detection methods. Although flow matching has demonstrated strong performance in generative modeling, its robustness in unsupervised tabular anomaly detection remains underexplored. In this work, we study flow-matching-based anomaly detection under contaminated training data by comparing Time-Conditioned Contraction Matching (TCCM) with Forest-Flow and evaluating multiple anomaly scoring functions. Our results show that the choice of anomaly score is critical. The original single-step Decision score used by TCCM is sensitive to contamination, whereas trajectory-based Deviation and Reconstruction scores provide more stable anomaly signals. With these scores, Forest-Flow becomes competitive with, and in some cases outperforms, TCCM. These findings highlight the importance of anomaly scoring for flow-matching methods in financial anomaly detection under severe class imbalance.
summary_zh: 金融异常检测通常依赖大量无标注交易日志，训练过程中可能已经存在异常样本，这种训练集污染问题违背了许多异常检测方法所基于的干净正态数据假设。尽管流匹配在生成建模领域已表现出优异性能，但其在无监督表格异常检测中的鲁棒性仍有待深入探索。本文针对存在污染的训练数据场景开展基于流匹配的异常检测研究，对比了时间条件收缩匹配（TCCM）与Forest-Flow两种方法，评估了多种异常评分函数的效果。结果表明，异常评分函数的选择至关重要：TCCM原本采用的单步决策得分对污染十分敏感，而基于轨迹的偏差得分和重构得分可输出更稳定的异常信号。采用上述两类得分后，Forest-Flow的性能可与TCCM持平，在部分场景下甚至优于TCCM。该研究结果凸显了在严重类别不平衡的金融异常检测场景中，异常评分策略对流匹配类方法的重要性。

title: Learning piecewise-smooth dynamical systems
title_zh: 分段光滑动力系统学习
authors: Davide Murari, Erik Jansson, Chris Budd OBE, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb
abstract: Discovering dynamical systems from trajectory data is a central problem in applied mathematics and engineering. Whilst recent advances in machine learning have led to strong progress in data-driven system identification, much less attention has been given to systems with discontinuous dynamics. These systems are nevertheless highly relevant in applications, including climate dynamics and mechanical systems with friction. In this work, we consider the problem of identifying piecewise-smooth dynamical systems directly from trajectory data. Compared with the smooth setting, this requires recovering the governing equations and detecting the switching hyperplanes that separate different dynamical regimes and characterising their behaviour, such as sliding motion. We present a modular framework for discovering such systems by first estimating switching hyperplanes from data and then learning smooth dynamics within each region using geometry-constrained neural networks. The geometry-learning phase is studied from a statistical perspective, analysing the identifiability of the discontinuities and the robustness of the procedure. We also introduce a novel neural network architecture with a prescribed discontinuity set, and provide a theoretical analysis of its approximation properties. The approach is tested on low-dimensional benchmark problems, including dry-friction oscillators and the PP04 climate model for the ice ages.
summary_zh: 从轨迹数据中发现动力系统是应用数学与工程领域的核心问题。近年来机器学习的进展推动了数据驱动系统辨识领域的长足发展，但针对不连续动力学系统的研究仍相对匮乏。这类系统在气候动力学、含摩擦机械系统等诸多应用场景中具有极高的实用价值。本研究聚焦于直接从轨迹数据中辨识分段光滑动力系统的问题：与光滑动力系统场景相比，该任务需要恢复系统的控制方程，检测分隔不同动力学状态的切换超平面，并刻画滑模运动等特殊行为的特性。本文提出了一种模块化的分段光滑动力系统发现框架：首先从数据中估计切换超平面，随后使用几何约束神经网络学习各区域内的光滑动力学特性。本研究从统计视角分析了几何学习阶段，对不连续点的可辨识性以及算法流程的鲁棒性进行了论证；同时提出了一种预设不连续集的新型神经网络架构，并对其逼近特性开展了理论分析。所提方法在干摩擦振荡器、用于冰期研究的PP04气候模型等低维基准问题上完成了测试验证。

title: skchange: Fast and Flexible Algorithms for Changepoint Detection
title_zh: skchange：面向变点检测的快速灵活算法库
authors: Martin Tveten, Johannes Voll Kolst{\o}, Per August Jarval Moen
abstract: Skchange is an open-source Python library for detecting structural changes in time series. It implements modern change detection algorithms within a unified and extensible framework. The algorithms are modular and composable, and they include changepoint search methods based on both cost minimisation and statistical tests. Key features include the detection of anomalous segments in addition to changepoints; theoretically well-founded fast and approximate search methods; theoretically well-founded algorithms for high-dimensional data, covering settings where either few or many features change simultaneously; utilities for automatic and data-driven penalty calibration, which balances false alarms against missed detections; and a large collection of built-in costs and statistical tests. The design follows established scikit-learn conventions to streamline both user and contributor experience, and Numba is used extensively to achieve high computational performance. Source code and documentation are available at https://github.com/NorskRegnesentral/skchange.
summary_zh: Skchange是一款用于检测时间序列结构变化的开源Python库，在统一且可扩展的框架下实现了多种现代变点检测算法。库内算法具备模块化、可组合的特性，涵盖基于代价最小化和统计检验的两类变点搜索方法。其核心特性包括：除变点外还可检测异常片段；具备理论支撑的快速近似搜索方法；面向高维数据的理论完备算法，可覆盖少量特征同时变化或大量特征同时变化的场景；支持基于数据驱动的自动惩罚校准工具，可平衡误报与漏检问题；内置大量代价函数与统计检验方法。该库的设计遵循成熟的scikit-learn开发规范，优化了用户使用体验与开发者贡献体验，同时大量使用Numba工具实现了极高的计算性能。其源代码与文档可访问地址：https://github.com/NorskRegnesentral/skchange。

title: RecPFN: Prior-Fitted Networks for In-Context-Based Recommendations
title_zh: RecPFN：面向基于上下文推荐的先验拟合网络
authors: En Zhi Tan, Jia Xiang Lim, Bryan Lijie Chew, Tze Minh Ng, Benjamin Yan Han Yap
abstract: We introduce RecPFN, a prior-fitted network that brings in-context learning to sequential recommendation. RecPFN is pretrained entirely on synthetic clickstream environments sampled from a broad structural causal prior, enabling it to amortize Bayesian-style inference from a small support set. At inference, a lightweight decoder-only transformer conditions on a handful of domain sequences and produces next-item predictions for queries in a single forward pass, without any weight updates. Across eight public benchmarks, RecPFN achives state-of-the-art zero-shot performance while remaining strongly competitive with supervised methods in low-compute and low-data regimes. It is deployment-efficient and robust to domain shift, outperforming strong zero-shot baselines that rely on large real-interaction corpora. RecPFN provides a practical path toward generalizable, data-efficient recommenders and opens avenues for richer priors, longer-context ICL, and multimodal extensions. Code for training and evaluation is publicly available at https://github.com/SAP-samples/tabular-ai-recpfn/.
summary_zh: 本文提出RecPFN（Prior-Fitted Network，先验拟合网络），首次将上下文学习引入序列推荐场景。RecPFN完全基于从广泛结构因果先验中采样得到的合成点击流环境进行预训练，可实现基于小支持集的贝叶斯风格摊销推理。在推理阶段，仅使用轻量型仅解码器Transformer，以少量领域序列为条件，通过单次前向传播即可生成查询的下一个物品预测结果，无需任何权重更新。在8个公开基准测试中，RecPFN取得了当前最优的零样本性能，同时在低算力、低数据场景下的表现与监督学习方法相比也极具竞争力。该模型部署效率高、对域偏移鲁棒性强，性能优于依赖大规模真实交互语料的主流零样本基线模型。RecPFN为实现泛化性强、数据效率高的推荐系统提供了可行路径，也为探索更丰富的先验机制、长上下文上下文学习、多模态扩展等方向开辟了新的研究思路。其训练与评估代码开源地址为：https://github.com/SAP-samples/tabular-ai-recpfn/。

title: Learning Deterministic and Stochastic Forced Hamiltonian Systems
title_zh: 确定性与随机受迫哈密顿系统学习
authors: Benedikt Brantner, Tomasz Tyranowski
abstract: We develop a geometric framework for learning deterministic and stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems with neural networks. Motivated by the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle and the theory of variational integrators, we introduce the notion of a Lagrange-d'Alembert map and establish a $C^r$ convergence theorem for first-order one-step methods. Building on these results, we propose Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (GFHNNs), a class of structure-preserving neural networks obtained by concatenating Lagrange-d'Alembert-Euler maps, and prove a universal approximation theorem for this architecture. We further extend the framework to parameter-dependent systems, leading to Parametric Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (PGFHNNs). By interpreting the multiple Stratonovich integrals appearing in the Stratonovich-Taylor expansion as parameters, the same framework can be applied to stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems whenever information about the underlying Wiener process is available. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed geometric architectures provide significantly improved long-time stability and accuracy compared to non-geometric residual neural networks, while requiring substantially less training data to achieve a comparable level of performance.
summary_zh: 本文开发了一套基于神经网络学习确定性与随机受迫哈密顿系统的几何框架。受拉格朗日-达朗贝尔原理与变分积分器理论的启发，本文引入了拉格朗日-达朗贝尔映射的概念，并针对一阶单步方法建立了$C^r$收敛定理。基于上述研究结果，本文提出广义受迫哈密顿神经网络（Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks, GFHNNs）：一类通过级联拉格朗日-达朗贝尔-欧拉映射得到的保结构神经网络，并证明了该架构的通用逼近定理。本文进一步将该框架扩展到参数依赖系统，提出参数化广义受迫哈密顿神经网络（Parametric Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks, PGFHNNs）。通过将斯特拉托诺维奇-泰勒展开中出现的多重斯特拉托诺维奇积分解释为参数，只要可获得底层维纳过程的相关信息，该框架即可直接应用于随机受迫哈密顿系统。数值实验表明，与非几何残差神经网络相比，本文提出的几何架构大幅提升了长时间稳定性与精度，同时仅需远少于后者的训练数据即可达到相当的性能水平。

title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
title_zh: CacheRoute：面向大语言模型大规模部署的规划型前缀亲和路由
authors: Huang Cheng
abstract: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3-70B in fp8 across 60 H100 GPUs, CacheRoute sustains 176+/-11 QPS at a 3.5-s p99 SLO, 2.3x the strongest of five baselines. Served KV-cache hit rate rises from 64.1+/-1.3% under cache-blind balancing to 93.2+/-0.5%. A second semi-synthetic aggregate and controlled 8B and burst experiments separate the effects of affinity and placement. Two 32B workloads provide the counterexamples: when affinity recovers too little KV work, its residual load skew reduces or erases the improvement. We therefore recommend gating any deployment with a shadow replay rather than enabling affinity from workload statistics alone.
summary_zh: 前缀缓存技术只有当重复请求返回仍保存有前缀KV值的服务器时，才能避免重新执行预填充步骤。无缓存感知的负载均衡策略会破坏这种复用性，而固定亲和策略虽然可以保留复用性，却可能导致单台服务器过载。CacheRoute通过周期性路由方案解决了上述权衡问题：它将高流量密钥纳入稳定的热集，并根据预期负载分配其路由目标。热密钥可使用多个目标节点，但在本文使用的主半合成聚合数据集中，所有密钥均仅分配一个目标节点。在60张H100 GPU上部署fp8精度的Llama-3.3-70B模型时，CacheRoute可在3.5秒p99服务水平协议约束下实现176±11的查询每秒处理量，性能是5个基线方案中最优值的2.3倍。KV缓存命中率从无缓存感知均衡策略下的64.1±1.3%提升至93.2±0.5%。本文通过第二组半合成聚合实验、8B模型对照实验与突发流量实验，分离了亲和策略与放置策略的各自作用。两组32B模型工作负载的对照实验表明：当亲和策略可恢复的KV计算量过少时，剩余负载偏斜会削弱甚至抵消性能提升效果。因此本文建议，任何部署上线前都应通过影子重放流程验证策略效果，而非仅基于工作负载统计直接启用亲和策略。

title: SAGE-XGBoost: Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings--Machine Learning Framework for Natural Hazards Susceptibility Mapping under Data Scarcity
title_zh: SAGE-XGBoost：数据稀缺场景下自然灾害易发性制图的空间增强图嵌入机器学习框架
authors: Mohammad H. Vahidnia, Ali Pourkarimi
abstract: Natural hazard susceptibility mapping is often constrained by limited labeled data, reducing the generalizability of conventional machine learning and limiting the applicability of complex deep learning models. This study proposes SAGE (Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings), a structurally informed feature-engineering framework that combines controlled noise-based data augmentation with neighborhood-based graph embeddings to improve prediction under data-scarce conditions. A K-nearest neighbor graph is constructed to derive local spatial statistics, which are reduced using principal component analysis and integrated with environmental covariates and spatial coordinates. The resulting features are used with XGBoost to develop the SAGE-XGBoost model. The framework was evaluated for landslide and wildfire susceptibility mapping. SAGE-XGBoost consistently outperformed conventional and spatially explicit machine learning models. Compared with Spatial XGBoost, it achieved an absolute improvement of above 33 percentage points across the two case studies. The model reached AUC values of approximately 0.97 for landslide susceptibility and 0.95 for wildfire susceptibility. Feature importance analysis confirmed the contribution of graph embeddings to prediction, while their integration improved spatial coherence and reduced local noise amplification. Overall, SAGE-XGBoost provides an efficient and transferable alternative to deep representation learning for environmental hazard assessment and other geospatial prediction tasks under limited supervision.
summary_zh: 自然灾害易发性制图往往受限于标注数据不足的问题，既会降低传统机器学习方法的泛化能力，也会限制复杂深度学习模型的应用效果。本研究提出SAGE（Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings，空间增强图嵌入）：一种结构感知特征工程框架，结合基于受控噪声的数据增强与基于邻域的图嵌入方法，可在数据稀缺条件下提升预测性能。该框架首先构建K近邻图以提取局部空间统计特征，通过主成分分析对特征进行降维后，与环境协变量、空间坐标进行融合，将得到的融合特征输入XGBoost模型即可得到SAGE-XGBoost模型。本研究在滑坡易发性制图与山火易发性制图任务上对该框架进行了验证，结果表明SAGE-XGBoost的性能始终优于传统模型与显式空间机器学习模型：与Spatial XGBoost相比，两个案例研究中其性能绝对提升幅度均超过33个百分点，滑坡易发性预测的AUC值约为0.97，山火易发性预测的AUC值约为0.95。特征重要性分析证实了图嵌入对预测任务的贡献，特征融合后模型的空间一致性得到提升，局部噪声放大效应被抑制。总体而言，SAGE-XGBoost为有限监督场景下的环境灾害评估与其他地理空间预测任务提供了一种高效、可迁移的深度表征学习替代方案。

title: FleetSieve: Decision-Critical Profiling for SLO-Aware LLM Fleet Configuration
title_zh: FleetSieve：面向感知服务水平协议的大语言模型集群配置的决策关键分析工具
authors: Huang Cheng, Scott Zhang, Aubert Li
abstract: Choosing tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and replica counts for an LLM serving fleet is difficult because performance is not monotonic in TP and the feasible choice can change with load. Exhaustive profiling resolves this uncertainty, but measures many configurations that do not affect the final resource allocation. We present FleetSieve, which selects measurements according to their expected effect on a resource-coupled, SLO-aware fleet decision. FleetSieve models capacity and tail latency jointly, compares conservative and optimistic allocations, and stops when their remaining decision gap is below a specified tolerance. On a fixed H100 measurement grid for a 31B-parameter open-weight model, FleetSieve reaches the oracle aggregate decision using 22,200 GPU-seconds, 6.9% less than uniform random profiling in the fixed comparison. Across 200 random reveal orders, its mean saving over random profiling is 5.4% (95% bootstrap CI: 3.5-7.2%). The fixed-comparison saving is 21.5% for Chat, while FleetSieve does not use the fewest GPU-seconds for Code. Joint capacity and tail modeling also avoids selecting a configuration whose 46.4-second completion p99 violates a 30-second SLO. In a 16-GPU allocation, an incorrect sparse-profile decision loses up to 1.93 requests/s and 12.4 percentage points of max-min fulfillment. Boundary repeats and BurstGPT measurements support the observed load-dependent tail-latency mechanism.
summary_zh: 为大语言模型服务集群选择张量并行度与副本数量是一项极具挑战性的任务：系统性能并非张量并行度的单调函数，可行配置会随负载变化而改变。全量遍历分析虽然可以消除这种不确定性，但会测量大量对最终资源分配无影响的配置。本文提出FleetSieve框架，根据测量结果对资源耦合、感知服务水平协议的集群决策的预期影响来选择待测量配置。FleetSieve联合建模系统容量与尾延迟，对比保守分配与乐观分配方案，当二者剩余决策差距低于指定阈值时即可停止测量流程。在基于H100 GPU、针对31B参数开源模型构建的固定测量网格上，FleetSieve仅使用22200 GPU秒即可达到全知最优的集群决策结果，比对照实验中的均匀随机分析方法节省6.9%的算力。在200组随机揭示顺序实验中，其相比随机分析的平均算力节省为5.4%（95%自举置信区间：3.5%-7.2%）。针对对话场景的对照实验算力节省可达21.5%，仅在代码场景下FleetSieve的GPU秒消耗未达到最低值。容量与尾延迟联合建模还可避免选择p99完成时间为46.4秒、违反30秒服务水平协议要求的无效配置。在16张GPU的分配场景中，基于稀疏分析的错误决策最多会导致每秒请求处理量损失1.93，最大最小满足率下降12.4个百分点。边界重复实验与BurstGPT测量结果验证了观测到的负载依赖尾延迟机制的有效性。

title: Rationally Enriched Chebyshev Trunk Bases for DeepONet Surrogates of High P\'eclet Entrance Transport
title_zh: 面向高佩克莱数入口输运问题DeepONet代理模型的有理增强切比雪夫主干基
authors: Mingeun Choi, Satish Kumar
abstract: This study demonstrates a rationally enriched Chebyshev (REC) trunk for deep operator network (DeepONet) surrogate models of singularly perturbed and high-P\'eclet transport problems whose solution profiles are characterized by thin localized boundary or wall layers. The REC trunk combines Chebyshev polynomial dictionary elements with rational dictionary elements constructed using the adaptive Antoulas-Anderson (AAA) algorithm. Over five independent training runs, the resulting REC-trunk DeepONet is evaluated against a vanilla DeepONet and a Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet whose prescribed dictionary consists only of Chebyshev polynomials across three problems whose singular perturbation parameters are diffusion-to-advection ratios: a singularly perturbed scalar boundary-value problem (BVP), the thermal entrance problem with a prescribed wall temperature, and the concentration entrance problem with an absorbing wall. Across the held-out test profiles, the REC-trunk DeepONet improves over the vanilla DeepONet and remains comparable to the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet in predicting the scalar profile, with its clearest advantage over the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet appearing when the perturbation parameter lies between $1.00\times10^{-4}$ and $1.78\times10^{-4}$, where it reduces the profile-error metrics by up to $19.5\,\%$ relative to the Chebyshev-trunk DeepONet. In predicting the wall-normal temperature and concentration profiles, the REC-trunk DeepONet reduces the profile-error metrics by up to $60.2\,\%$ and $32.2\,\%$ relative to the vanilla and Chebyshev-trunk DeepONets, respectively, while suppressing artificial near-wall oscillations as the P\'eclet or mass-transfer P\'eclet number ranges from $10^{2}$ to $10^{4}$.
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种有理增强切比雪夫（Rationally Enriched Chebyshev, REC）主干结构，用于构建针对奇异摄动、高佩克莱数输运问题的深度算子网络（Deep Operator Network, DeepONet）代理模型，这类问题的解分布具有薄的局域边界层或壁面层特征。REC主干将切比雪夫多项式字典元素与通过自适应Antoulas-Anderson（AAA）算法构建的有理字典元素相结合。本研究在5次独立训练运行中，针对3个奇异摄动参数（扩散-对流比）不同的问题，将REC主干DeepONet与 vanilla DeepONet、仅使用切比雪夫多项式作为预设字典的切比雪夫主干DeepONet进行对比：三个测试问题分别为奇异摄动标量边值问题、指定壁温的热入口问题、壁面为吸收边界的浓度入口问题。在留出的测试分布上，REC主干DeepONet对标量分布的预测效果优于vanilla DeepONet，与切比雪夫主干DeepONet性能相当；当摄动参数处于$1.00\times10^{-4}$到$1.78\times10^{-4}$区间时，其优势最为明显，相比切比雪夫主干DeepONet可将分布误差指标降低最高19.5%。在预测法向壁温与浓度分布时，REC主干DeepONet相比vanilla DeepONet最多可将分布误差指标降低60.2%，相比切比雪夫主干DeepONet最多可降低32.2%，同时在佩克莱数或传质佩克莱数处于$10^{2}$到$10^{4}$区间时，可有效抑制壁面附近的人工振荡。

title: Time-Uniform Self-Normalized Concentration for Discounted Least Squares: Limits and Corrections
title_zh: 折扣最小二乘的时间一致自归一化集中性：边界限制与修正方案
authors: Yi-Shan Wu
abstract: Self-normalized concentration inequalities are standard tools in bandit and reinforcement-learning analyses. A widely used weighted extension claims an analogous time-uniform guarantee for discounted least-squares estimators in non-stationary problems. A simple scalar Gaussian counterexample with a fixed parameter shows that the claimed bounded radius is crossed with probability one. For fixed discount and regularization parameters, we further show that, when $\delta\leq1/2$ and $T/\delta$ is sufficiently large, any deterministic anytime boundary valid uniformly over the stated conditionally sub-Gaussian model class must be at least of order $R\sqrt{\log(T/\delta)}$ at some time by horizon $T$; for nondecreasing boundaries, this order is required at time $T$. We identify the proof error: different terminal times use different Gaussian mixing distributions, so the fixed-time mixtures do not form one supermartingale, and the stopping-time argument does not repair this failure. Finally, we show that the weighted inequality remains valid at each fixed deterministic time, give valid finite- and infinite-horizon corrections, and discuss consequences for downstream analyses.
summary_zh: 自归一化集中不等式是多臂老虎机与强化学习分析领域的标准工具。现有研究中广泛使用的加权扩展结论声称，非平稳场景下的折扣最小二乘估计量也具备类似的时间一致保证。本文构造了一个参数固定的简单标量高斯反例，证明现有结论声称的有界半径会以概率1被突破。本文进一步证明，当折扣系数与正则化参数固定、$\delta\leq1/2$且$T/\delta$足够大时，在指定条件次高斯模型类上一致有效的任意确定性任意时刻边界，在时间范围$T$内的某一时刻至少达到$R\sqrt{\log(T/\delta)}$量级；对于非递减边界，该量级要求在时刻$T$处就必须满足。本文指出了原有证明的错误：不同终止时刻使用不同的高斯混合分布，因此固定时刻的混合序列无法构成一个上鞅，停时参数无法弥补这一逻辑漏洞。最后本文证明，该加权不等式在每个固定的确定性时刻仍然成立，给出了适用于有限时域与无限时域的修正方案，并讨论了该结论对下游分析的影响。

title: Complementary, Not Cumulative: Interaction Effects in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Navier-Stokes Vortex Shedding
title_zh: 互补而非累加：面向纳维-斯托克斯涡脱落问题的物理信息神经网络的交互效应研究
authors: Devesh Shah
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) embed governing partial differential equations directly into the training loss, offering a promising alternative to costly CFD solvers for unsteady flows. Yet the growing list of techniques proposed to improve PINN training is typically validated one at a time, leaving open whether these techniques actually compose. We study this question in depth on the DFG/Schafer-Turek unsteady cylinder wake benchmark. In isolation, nearly every technique performs no better than an untreated baseline. However, combining periodic (SIREN) activations with causal weighting unlocks a previously inaccessible regime, reconstructing velocity and pressure fields to within 4.1% average relative L2 error against an OpenFOAM reference solution. Adding further techniques instead causes catastrophic performance degradation, demonstrating that individually effective PINN interventions can interact nonlinearly and that more elaborate training recipes are not necessarily better.
summary_zh: 物理信息神经网络（Physics-Informed Neural Networks, PINNs）将控制偏微分方程直接嵌入训练损失函数，是替代高计算成本CFD求解器求解非定常流动问题的极具前景的方案。然而现有研究中提出的大量用于改进PINN训练的技术通常仅单独验证有效性，尚未明确这些技术组合使用时是否真的能产生叠加增益。本文针对DFG/Schafer-Turek非定常圆柱尾流基准问题开展深度研究，结果表明：几乎所有技术单独使用时的性能都无法超过未做任何改进的基线模型。但将周期激活（SIREN）函数与因果加权策略相结合后，可解锁此前无法达到的性能区间，其重建得到的速度场与压力场与OpenFOAM参考解相比，平均相对L2误差仅为4.1%。在此基础上叠加更多改进技术反而会导致性能灾难性下降，证明单独使用时有效的PINN优化策略之间可能存在非线性交互效应，更复杂的训练方案并不一定能带来更优的结果。

title: Unregularized Convergence of Single-Loop, Entropy-Regularized Natural Actor-Critic
title_zh: 单循环熵正则化自然行动者-评论家（Natural Actor-Critic）的无正则化收敛性
authors: Zhiqiang Tan
abstract: While entropy regularization is widely used to stabilize and accelerate Natural Policy Gradient methods, its ability to yield faster convergence rates for the unregularized objective remains underexplored. Existing analyses often rely on double-loop architectures and invoke a linear entropy penalty. To bridge the gap between theory and practice, we analyze a single-loop, entropy-regularized Natural Actor-Critic algorithm under compatible linear function approximation. By training an uncentered critic, our critic tracking can remain stable even as the training policy approaches determinism and the Fisher information matrix degenerates. We focus on two primary regimes for the optimization landscape: a Stochastic Regime, where we fuse coupled actor-critic updates into a joint Lyapunov recurrence, and a Deterministic Regime, where we pivot to a Policy Mirror Descent framework to circumvent the collapse of Euclidean geometry. By exploiting a positive Minimal Action Gap in the unregularized Markov decision process, we introduce an Exponential Translation mechanism that maps the regularized gap to the unregularized one up to an exponentially decaying tail. By tuning the fixed temperature, our algorithm achieves accelerated unregularized convergence rates, up to approximation-error terms: $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1})$ in the Stochastic Regime, and $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$ for the average iterate alongside $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1/3})$ for the last iterate in the Deterministic Regime. Here, $T_{total}$ denotes the total number of stochastic critic updates (or Monte Carlo rollouts). Furthermore, in the tabular setting, our positive-action-gap analysis yields a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$ average-iterate rate, surpassing the $\mathcal{O}(T_{total}^{-1/2})$ worst-case statistical barrier that applies without a positive action margin.
summary_zh: 熵正则化被广泛用于稳定和加速自然策略梯度（Natural Policy Gradient）方法，但它能否为无正则化目标带来更快的收敛速率仍有待深入研究。现有分析通常依赖双循环架构，并引入线性熵惩罚项。为填补理论与实践之间的差距，本文在兼容线性函数近似条件下对单循环熵正则化自然行动者-评论家算法展开分析。通过训练非中心化的评论家，即便训练策略趋近于确定性、Fisher信息矩阵发生退化，本文的评论家跟踪过程仍能保持稳定。本文重点关注优化景观的两种主要状态：随机状态下，我们将耦合的行动者-评论家更新融合为联合李雅普诺夫递推；确定性状态下，我们转向策略镜像下降（Policy Mirror Descent）框架以规避欧氏几何的失效。通过利用无正则化马尔可夫决策过程中的正最小动作间隙，本文提出指数平移机制，可将正则化间隙映射为无正则化间隙，映射误差不超过指数衰减尾项。通过调整固定温度参数，本文算法在近似误差项范围内实现了加速的无正则化收敛速率：随机状态下达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1})$，确定性状态下平均迭代的收敛速率为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$，最后一次迭代的收敛速率为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-1/3})$，其中$T_{total}$表示随机评论家更新（或蒙特卡洛 rollout）的总次数。此外，在表格设定下，基于正动作间隙的分析得到平均迭代速率为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T_{total}^{-2/3})$，突破了不存在正动作裕度时适用的$\mathcal{O}(T_{total}^{-1/2})$最坏情况统计壁垒。

title: K\"ahler landscapes for complex neural network descents and guarantees including a search and destroy of the Calabi-Yau manifold
title_zh: 复神经网络梯度下降的凯勒（Kähler）景观及包含卡拉比-丘（Calabi-Yau）流形搜索与消除的理论保证
authors: Andrew Gracyk
abstract: We study landscapes for complex-parameterized networks. Our approach is motivated with an information-theoretic manifold perspective of the parameter and via classical optimization guarantees although of complex geometric variety such as through Dolbeault asymptotics. The descent path admits a K\"ahler information metric under a cross-entropy via the Wirtinger Hessian on the log-likelihood potential. We restrict attention to a descent update rule with natural gradient descent via a differentiated loss scaled by the inverse metric, so the descent path remains in the holomorphic tangent bundle. We emphasize Calabi-Yau information manifolds which profane theoretical guarantees via an ill-curvature-conditioned landscape. Under a Calabi-Yau metric, specifically in a non-compact setting with a global potential so defined geometrically rather than invoking the topological requirements of the Calabi conjecture, a wedged nowhere-vanishing holomorphic form is the top exterior product of the K\"ahler form up to constants, yielding a constant determinant condition.
